touchtone interface.translation: Giao diện Người dùng Điện thoại

telephone user interface.translation: Giao diện Người dùng Điện thoại
telephone user interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interface that is used to navigate the menus of a Unified Messaging (UM) system using DTMF or touchtone inputs.

tui.translation: Giao diện Người dùng Điện thoại
tui.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interface that is used to navigate the menus of a Unified Messaging (UM) system using DTMF or touchtone inputs.

point-to-point protocol over ethernet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A specification for connecting users on an Ethernet network to the Internet through a broadband connection, such as a single DSL line, wireless device, or cable modem. Using PPPoE and a broadband modem, LAN users can gain individual authenticated access to high-speed data networks. By combining Ethernet and Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP), PPPoE provides an efficient way to create a separate connection for each user to a remote server.

pppoe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Using PPPoE and a broadband modem, LAN users can gain individual authenticated access to high-speed data networks. pre-freight amount.translation: số tiền vận chuyển hàng hóa thực
pre-freight amount.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The monetary total amount that is calculated from the detail amount after the percentage order discount and order discount amount are deducted.

ancestor element.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a tree structure, the element of which a given element is a child. Equivalent to a parent element.

ancestor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a tree structure, the element of which a given element is a child. Equivalent to a parent element.

complete pc restore.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool in Windows Vista that restores the entire computer (OS, settings, and files).

label.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tag or string affixed to an item to provide identifying or descriptive information.

link data sources wizard.translation: Trình hướng dẫn Nguồn Dữ liệu Nối kết
link data sources wizard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A wizard dialog title to create a linked data source, where you can link multiple data sources into one single data source such as two different tables in a SQL database.

workflow-enabled.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Automated in such a way that business documents and assignments are routed from one user to another for specific action.

menu.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The icon that provides a navigation bar similar to desktop browsers, as well as an app launcher and flex pane features, and which adjusts to the screen or window size.

macro language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The collection of macro instructions recognized by a given macro processor.

tablet pen.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pointed input device that comes with a mobile device or tablet PC, and is used to navigate through applications and to input information.

pen.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that allows users to use ink to draw using their mouse, finger, or an inking tool, and whose ink resembles traditional pen ink.

stylus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pointed input device that comes with a mobile device or tablet PC, and is used to navigate through applications and to input information.

activity reporting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option on Windows Parental Control that, if selected, creates logs of all the actions performed by a user on the computer.

nickname.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An alternate name a user can give their cards to more easily identify what they are and how they can be used.

business application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any computer application designed primarily for use in business, as opposed to scientific use or entertainment. business software.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any computer application designed primarily for use in business, as opposed to scientific use or entertainment. journal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The application designed for freeform notetaking and journaling using digital pens on Windows devices.

frame.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To arrange visual elements in an image, especially the subject.

mail recipient.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The individual, or account, to whom an email message is sent.

mail.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Outlook app for sending and receiving email.

electronic mail.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of exchanging messages and computer files over a network that does not require the sender and recipient to be online at the same time.

email.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To transmit content such as a message or file through a communications channel.

automatic failover.translation: chuyển đổi dự phòng tự động

multiple-selection list box.translation: hộp danh sách đa lựa chọn
multiple-selection list box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list box that is optimized for making multiple, independent selections.

contingency plan.translation: kế hoạch ứng phó dự phòng
contingency plan.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A plan for addressing recognized risks that may arise during the course of a project. The plan identifies alternative strategies to be used to ensure project success if specified risk events occur.

external content type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object (such as a customer, item, or employee) that shares a set of defined attributes or characteristics, and that is used to manage rules for data.

entity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A class of things that describes information needed to carry out an intent.

health monitor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application included with Windows Small Business Server which provides a view of data collected from the Event Viewer and System monitor.

gesture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A motion made by a player that's intended to be tracked by the sensor.

graph.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To represent data by means of a graph.

content index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The full-text index, pointer to the property store, and other data that describes content across content sources, scopes, and servers.

error code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A return code that begins with E_ or DB_E_ and indicates that the method failed completely and was unable to do any useful work. Usually indicates a programming error.

subscription event rule.translation: quy tắc sự kiện đăng ký
subscription event rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule that processes information for event-driven subscriptions.

control-of-flow language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Transact-SQL keywords that control the flow of execution of SQL statements and statement blocks in triggers, stored procedures, and batches.

trace.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of events and data returned by the Database Engine.

assistive technology program.translation: Chương trình Công nghệ Hỗ trợ

trapping.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In printing, the process of eliminating white lines between colors by printing small areas of overlapping color where colors touch.

main window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The window in which the main interaction with an object takes place.

full-text search index.translation: chỉ mục tìm kiếm toàn văn bản

full-text index.translation: chỉ mục tìm kiếm toàn văn bản
full-text index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An index that enables full-text search for a group of managed properties.

rotate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture represented by placing at least two fingers on an object and rotating your fingers in a clockwise or counterclockwise direction.

macro-free.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to a file format that does not allow for VBA code. Office 12 default file formats are macro-free. Examples of file extensions for macro-free formats are .docx, .pptx, .xlsx.

file rollover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process when a program closes a file, based on a certain event, and creates a new file.

target.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A value that the customer defines, which represents a goal.

target value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: As one aspect of a KPI, the desired level of performance with respect to a specific business goal or strategy. Actual values are evaluated against the target to determine KPI score and status.

accessibility wizard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interactive tool that makes it easier to set up commonly used accessibility features by specifying options by type of disability, rather than by numeric value changes.

private.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to an item that is only visible to an owner, member or other privileged individual.

microsoft® office professional 2007.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A suite of Microsoft productivity software that supports common business tasks, including word processing, email, presentations, and data management and analysis.

box model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cascading style sheet (CSS) model where rectangular boxes are generated for elements in the document tree and laid out according to the visual formatting model.

system color.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A color that is defined by the operating system for a specific type of monitor and video adapter and that is associated with a specific part of the user interface, such as a window title or a menu.

trim.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Text Excel function that removes spaces from text.

bulk rowset provider.translation: trình cung cấp tập dòng hàng loạt
bulk rowset provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A provider used for the OPENROWSET instruction to read data from a file. In SQL Server 2005, OPENROWSET can read from a data file without loading the data into a target table. This enables you to use OPENROWSET with a simple SELECT statement.

x-axis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The horizontal reference line on a grid, chart, or graph that has horizontal and vertical dimensions.

x axis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The horizontal reference line on a grid, chart, or graph that has horizontal and vertical dimensions.

horizontal axis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The horizontal reference line on a grid, chart, or graph that has horizontal and vertical dimensions.

blog.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The checkbox customers select to include their spaces blog in the updates that they share about themselves. This text links to Spaces.

speech recognition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability to interpret vocal commands or convert spoken words into computer-readable text. Speech recognition programs enable you to control an application or enter text by speaking into a microphone, rather than by using a keyboard.

voice recognition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability to interpret vocal commands or convert spoken words into computer-readable text. Speech recognition programs enable you to control an application or enter text by speaking into a microphone, rather than by using a keyboard.

role-based interface.translation: Giao diện Dựa trên Vai trò
role-based interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that customizes the contents of the user interface depending on the security permissions of the user. For example, if the user does not have permission to edit an item, the edit button will not be displayed.

content access account.translation: tài khoản truy nhập nội dung

access account.translation: tài khoản truy nhập nội dung
access account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An account used to crawl Web sites, servers and network resources included in a content index.

crawling account.translation: tài khoản truy nhập nội dung
crawling account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An account used to crawl Web sites, servers and network resources included in a content index.

connectivity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of hardware devices, software packages, or a computer itself to work with network devices or with other hardware devices, software packages, or a computer over a network connection.

refresh.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To update displayed information with current data.

internet server api.translation: Giao diện Lập trình Ứng dụng Máy chủ Internet
internet server api.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application programming interface (API) that resides on a server computer for initiating software services tuned for Windows operating systems. In Microsoft Provisioning System, ISAPI resides on the Web server.

internet server application programming.translation: Giao diện Lập trình Ứng dụng Máy chủ Internet
internet server application programming.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application programming interface (API) that resides on a server computer for initiating software services tuned for Windows operating systems. In Microsoft Provisioning System, ISAPI resides on the Web server.

isapi.translation: Giao diện Lập trình Ứng dụng Máy chủ Internet

property name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string value that is used to identify a named property within a given property set. Note that property names and property IDs are mutually exclusive.

home.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A place where one lives.

cascade.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Microsoft Viva Goals, to pass on OKRs from one level to the next, allowing employees and teams to see how their work directly contributes to the ultimate goals of their organization.

os.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software system that enables applications to interact with hardware and that manages software resources on a computer.

operating system.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software system that enables applications to interact with hardware and that manages software resources on a computer.

snapshot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A screenshot of what's on the user's screen.

shadow copy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A static image of a set of data, such as the records displayed as the result of a query.

wedge.translation: phần của biểu đồ hình tròn

pie slice.translation: phần của biểu đồ hình tròn
pie slice.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One segment of a pie chart.

system area network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A network configuration, usually on a separate Internet Protocol (IP) subnet, that gives data a direct path to system hardware.

san.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A network configuration, usually on a separate Internet Protocol (IP) subnet, that gives data a direct path to system hardware.

launchbar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window where Groove users start new activities. It contains two panels, one for creating and managing workspaces, and the other for managing contacts.

release.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To move an email into a user's inbox from quarantine.

security token.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cryptographically signed data unit that transfers authentication and authorization information, based on a credential.

token.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the context of cryptocurrency, a digital unit of a digital currency that is used as a specific asset or a representation of a particular use on a blockchain.

auth token.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cryptographically signed data unit that transfers authentication and authorization information, based on a credential.

pull.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Trigger activity on the controller.

time-out error.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A condition where an expected character is not received in time. When this condition occurs, the software assumes that the data has been lost and requests that it be resent.

authorize.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To grant a person, computer process, or device access to certain information, services or functionality.

stemmer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Full-Text Search, for a given language, a stemmer generates inflectional forms of a particular word based on the rules of that language. Stemmers are language specific.

ole db provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program in the OLE DB architecture that enables native access to data, instead of accessing data using ODBC or IISAM drivers, which are external ways to access the data.

replica set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One or more shared folders that participates in replication.

horizontal ruler.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A bar marked off in units of measure (such as inches) that is displayed across the top of the document window.

click.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The action of pressing the stick downward.

watermark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that appears as the background to a document. Generally faded and transparent, so that text can be clearly read over it.

creation script.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that adds object-creation statements to a script.

unsubscribe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To remove oneself as a recipient on a mailing list.

data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A representation of concepts such as facts or instructions in a formalized manner, suitable for communication, interpretation or processing.

separator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A line that separates groups of controls (on a surface) or commands (on a menu).

separator bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special type of menu item that appears as a dividing bar between two active menu items.

compatibility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In reference to software, harmony on a task-oriented level among computers and computer programs.

toolbar button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A command button used in a toolbar (or status bar).

home phone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Outlook contact’s residential telephone number (usually a land line).

knowledge base.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Web site that provides customers with access to a database of articles written by Microsoft Support professionals.

knowledge base manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature in Microsoft Dynamics CRM that provides a process for drafting, submitting, reviewing, and publishing knowledge base articles.

kb manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature in Microsoft Dynamics CRM that provides a process for drafting, submitting, reviewing, and publishing knowledge base articles.

community technology preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unsupported, prerelease software version intended to make the latest working build of a particular product available to developers.

ctp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unsupported, prerelease software version intended to make the latest working build of a particular product available to developers.

property bag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A container for storing native SharePoint objects and custom data from first and third parties.

digital rights management.translation: quản lý quyền kỹ thuật số
digital rights management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any technology used to protect the interests of owners of digital content and services (such as copyright owners). Typically, authorized recipients or users must acquire a license in order to use the content.

drm.translation: quản lý quyền kỹ thuật số

source area.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cell range that you consolidate in the destination area you specify.

aggregation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method that summarizes a group of values to return a single value.

reserved word.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A word that has special meaning to a program or in a programming language and can be used only in certain predefined circumstances; it cannot be used in naming documents, files, labels, variables, or user-generated tools such as macros.

tag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In markup languages such as SGML and HTML, a code that identifies an element in a document, such as a heading or a paragraph, for the purposes of formatting, indexing, and linking information in the document.

report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A historical account of information about a topic, feature, or state that includes textual and visual elements and can be exported and shared.

foreign table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table that contains a foreign key.

file manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A module of an operating system or environment that controls the physical placement of and access to a group of program files.

running foot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One or more lines of text in the bottom margin area of a page. A footer may contain elements such as the page number, the name of the file, or the date.

page footer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One or more lines of text in the bottom margin area of a page. A footer may contain elements such as the page number, the name of the file, or the date.

footer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One or more lines of text in the bottom margin area of a page. A footer may contain elements such as the page number, the name of the file, or the date.

rounding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of approximating a number by representing it with a fewer number of digits.

object-oriented.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Of, pertaining to, or being a system or language that supports the use of objects.

property sheet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window used to view or modify the properties of various objects such as tables, queries, fields, forms, reports, data access pages, and controls.

evaluation software.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Typically a demo version of the software that will expire in 120 days after it is installed.

backup set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of files, folders, and other data that have been backed up and stored in a file or on one or more tapes.

blocked encodings list.translation: Danh sách mã hoá bị chặn
blocked encodings list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that allows you to block a language encoding or character set in order to filter out unwanted international email messages that display in a language you don't understand.

junk e-mail protection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that provides options for automatically identifying and filtering out junk email messages.

tco.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An estimate of all direct and indirect costs associated with a purchase, capital investment or acquisition of computer hardware and software.

total cost of ownership.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An estimate of all direct and indirect costs associated with a purchase, capital investment or acquisition of computer hardware and software.

command line.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string of text written in the command language and passed to the command interpreter for execution.

business type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The kind of business organization or sector (such as a public company, a partnership, a private corporation, and so on).

note.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mark or piece of information that you can add to a map, save, and share with others.

scorecard view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hierarchical arrangement of the KPIs and objectives that are contained in a scorecard. A scorecard view also can be configured to include additional data from scorecard data sources.

uninstall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: When referring to a device, to remove the corresponding device drivers from the hard disk and physically remove the device from the computer.

deinstall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: When referring to software, to remove program files and folders from the hard disk and remove related data from the registry so the software or solution is no longer available.

blocked top-level domain list.translation: Danh sách Tên miền Cấp cao nhất Bị chặn
blocked top-level domain list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The button that brings up an international list that allows users to block emails from those domains.

redo.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The phase during recovery that applies (rolls forward) logged changes to a database to bring the data forward in time.

control-break.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A key or combination of keys used to tell a computer to halt, or break out of, whatever it is doing. On IBM PCs and compatibles under DOS, pressing the Pause/ Break or Scroll Lock/Break key while holding down the Ctrl key issues the break command (as does Ctrl-C). On Macintosh computers, the key combination that sends a break code is Command-period.

ctrl+break.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A key or combination of keys used to tell a computer to halt, or break out of, whatever it is doing. On IBM PCs and compatibles under DOS, pressing the Pause/ Break or Scroll Lock/Break key while holding down the Ctrl key issues the break command (as does Ctrl-C). On Macintosh computers, the key combination that sends a break code is Command-period.

break key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A key or combination of keys used to tell a computer to halt, or break out of, whatever it is doing. On IBM PCs and compatibles under DOS, pressing the Pause/ Break or Scroll Lock/Break key while holding down the Ctrl key issues the break command (as does Ctrl-C). file sharing program.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A peer-to-peer file sharing client used to connect to file sharing networks in order to download or share files.

what-if analysis.translation: phân tích cái gì xảy ra nếu
what-if analysis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of changing the values in cells to see how those changes affect the outcome of formulas on a worksheet. For example, varying the interest rate that is used in an amortization table to determine the amount of the payments.

\"what-if\" evaluation.translation: phân tích cái gì xảy ra nếu

web page preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that displays the Web page in a Web browser.

single-precision.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Of or pertaining to a floating-point number having the least precision among two or more options commonly offered by a programming language, such as single-precision versus double-precision.

filter excluding selection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A technique in which you filter records in a form, datasheet, or data access page to retrieve only those records that don't contain the selected value.

parent category.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity used in catalogs to group a set of products in a hierarchy. For example Music is a parent category and Rock Jazz and Classical are child categories.

human interface device.translation: thiết bị giao diện con người
human interface device.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A firmware specification for input and output devices such as drawing tablets, keyboards, USB speakers, and other specialized devices designed to improve accessibility.

hid.translation: thiết bị giao diện con người
hid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A firmware specification for input and output devices such as drawing tablets, keyboards, USB speakers, and other specialized devices designed to improve accessibility.

composite character.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A text element consisting of a base character and a diacritic or accent mark. Although most common in the Latin script, other scripts (including Greek, Devanagari, and Tamil) also have composite characters.

column binding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The binding of an Analysis Services object to a column in a data source view.

two-dimensional.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Existing in reference to two measures, such as height and width--for example, a two-dimensional model drawn with reference to an x-axis and a y-axis, or a two-dimensional array of numbers placed in rows and columns.

2-d.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Existing in reference to two measures, such as height and width--for example, a two-dimensional model drawn with reference to an x-axis and a y-axis, or a two-dimensional array of numbers placed in rows and columns.

move handle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A handle that is displayed on some objects such as toolbars, tables, or on individual rows or columns, that allows the user to drag them to another location.

overhead.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Work or information that provides support - possibly critical support-for a computing process but is not an intrinsic part of the operation or data. Overhead often adds to processing time but is generally necessary.

quick deploy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A designation that the user can apply to a content deployment job to denote that it will be deployed frequently and quickly.

notification area.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The area on the right side of the Windows taskbar. It contains shortcuts to programs and important status information.

status area.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The area on the right side of the Windows taskbar. It contains shortcuts to programs and important status information.

n/a.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to something for which an answer is not available or appropriate.

not applicable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to something for which an answer is not available or appropriate.

suspend.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To temporarily deny account privileges to a user without deleting any of their information.

yield.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Financial Excel function that returns the yield on a security that pays periodic interest.

simple filter tab.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tab, found on the Action menu, in the Filter Report selection, that enables the user to select or filter records with the wanted values.

extended desktop.translation: màn hình máy tính mở rộng
extended desktop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer desktop area that extends across all displays that are connected to a computer.

authorized replicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A partner organization responsible for replicating Microsoft software products onto specified media and packaging it for the specified sales channel.

ar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The technology that allows viewing of a physical, real-world environment enriched by computer-generated sensory input such as sound, video, graphics or GPS data.

call answering.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A voice mail application that answers a call so that a message can be left.

active directory lightweight directory s.translation: Dịch vụ Thư mục Hạng nhẹ Active Directory

ad lds.translation: Dịch vụ Thư mục Hạng nhẹ Active Directory
ad lds.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) directory service that provides flexible support for directory-enabled applications, without the restrictions of Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS).

restore sequence.rule: Microsoft Terminology. media set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ordered collection of backup media written to by one or more backup operations using a constant number of backup devices.

bitwise operation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operation that manipulates a single bit, or tests whether a bit is on or off.

capacity planning.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A procedure for determining the resource capacity requirements that meet the demand of future output during specific time periods.

gross margin.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The difference between the sales and the direct costs of the products sold.

product.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Math and trigonometry Excel function that multiplies its arguments.

cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Information Excel function that returns information about the formatting, location, or contents of a cell.

word processing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The act of entering and editing text with a word processor.

profile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer-based record that contains software settings and identification information.

programmatic identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An identifier in the form OLEServerName.ObjectName (for example, Excel.Sheet or PowerPoint.Slide) that's used by the Windows registry to uniquely identify an object.

progid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An identifier in the form OLEServerName.ObjectName (for example, Excel.Sheet or PowerPoint.Slide) that's used by the Windows registry to uniquely identify an object.

substitute product.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item that can take the place of another item.

substitute.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Text Excel function that substitutes new text for old text in a text string.

stream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Digital media that is delivered in a continuous flow across a network.

data stream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The flow of data from a source to a single receiver that flows through a channel, as opposed to packets, which may be addressed and routed independently, possibly to multiple recipients.

international number format.translation: định dạng số điện thoại quốc tế
international number format.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The string that is used to define how to dial someone from outside of their country/region.

organizational unit.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A logical container into which users, groups, computers, and other units are placed. It can contain objects only from its parent domain.

wavelength.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The distance between successive peaks or troughs in a periodic signal that is propagated through space. Wavelength is symbolized by the Greek letter lambda and can be calculated as speed divided by frequency.

child node.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A subordinate node.

resize.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To change the size of an element on the screen.

view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A common menu item that enables the user to select how the contents of the current program are displayed.

traverse.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In programming, to access in a particular order all of the nodes of a tree or similar data structure.

format file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file containing meta information (such as data type and column size) that is used to interpret data when being read from or written to a data file.

call forwarding off.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The menu item that turns off the automatic forwarding of incoming calls.

blocked contacts.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The privacy relationship setting that prevents a person or domain from adding the user to contact lists, seeing the user's status, or sending instant messages to the user.

blocked.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status that indicates that a user has assigned this contact to the Blocked Contacts privacy relationship.

sequence.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Excel function that generates a list of sequential numbers.

performancepoint planning server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Planning server component of PerformancePoint Server. planning server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Planning server component of PerformancePoint Server. It is an infrastructure that includes everything between the PerformancePoint Server client tier and the SQL Server 2005 databases and SQL Server Analysis Services cubes.

batch.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of documents put together by Office 365 Advanced eDiscovery for review that all have the same theme.

privacy statement.translation: Điều khoản về quyền riêng tư
privacy statement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The link to the Microsoft privacy statement.

copyfitting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The resizing of text to fit into an allotted amount of space.

asynchronous.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to, being, or characteristic of something that is not dependent on timing. async.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to, being, or characteristic of something that is not dependent on timing. Each application or command runs in the specified order, but the specified item does not wait for any previously started processes to finish before an application or command runs.

report execution snapshot.translation: chụp nhanh thực thi báo cáo
report execution snapshot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report snapshot that is cached. Report administrators create report execution snapshots if they want to run reports from static copies.

information rights management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The policy tool that gives authors control over how recipients use the documents and emails they send.

irm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The policy tool that gives authors control over how recipients use the documents and emails they send.

windows sidebar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. switch parameter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A parameter that does not take an argument.

computer browser service.translation: Dịch vụ Trình duyệt Máy tính

placeholder text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Text or some other element used in an application as an indicator that the user should enter in his or her own text.

disclaimer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A notice that warns that the manufacturer of the product limits liability in certain situations/uses.

fraction bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A line that separates the numerator and denominator of a fraction.

phrase list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list of words or phrases that are significant to a particular domain and that provide a signal to a language understanding system that they should be preferred over other interpretations of ambiguous input.

map.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To translate one value into another.

rename group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item that lets a user rename a group, when the group name in the Contacts list is right-clicked.

task input panel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A small space on the To-Do Bar where the user can input tasks directly. The default label reads "Type a new task".

datasheet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Data from a table, form, query, view, or stored procedure, displayed in a row-and-column format.

man.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The emoticon depicting a man waving.

metropolitan area network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A highspeed network that can carry voice, data, and images at up to 200 Mbps or faster over distances of up to 75 km. Based on the network architecture, the transmission speed can be higher for shorter distances. A MAN, which can include one or more LANs as well as telecommunications equipment such as microwave and satellite relay stations, is smaller than a wide area network but generally operates at a higher speed.

high memory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Memory locations addressed by the largest numbers.

readability statistics.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Editor feature that gives users feedback on how easy it is for a reader to understand a written text based on information such as average sentence length and average word length.

powerpoint add-in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An optional Live Meeting tool that allows users to create Live Meeting slides and add a presenter photo as part of a Microsoft PowerPoint file.

source partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Analysis Services partition that is merged into another and is deleted automatically at the end of the merger process.

radar chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of chart that compares the aggregate values of a number of data series.

content template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A design template that also contains text suggestions on each slide. You replace the text suggestions with the text that you want. A content template contains a slide master and an optional title master.

storage subsystem.rule: Microsoft Terminology. markup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Comments and tracked changes such as insertions, deletions, and formatting changes.

alternative text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The field on an image or video card that allows users to add alternative text.

alt text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text string that appears in place of an image when a Web page is loading, when graphics are not being displayed, or when users pause on the image itself with their mouse.

replace.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The REPLACE Text Excel function that replaces characters within text.

audio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Sway button that allows users to insert an audio card.

saturation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In color management, the purity of a color's hue, moving from gray to the pure color.

action.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Microsoft Viva Goals, a group of tasks or work items that align to a team's objectives or key results.

start tag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of markup in markup languages. A start tag is the starting element of a tag pair which contains metainformation about some part of the text.

web client.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer that uses a Web server.

horizontal partitioning.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of segmenting a single table into multiple tables based on selected rows.

select all.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Selects all the content in the current file or page.

asset.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item, such as devices, apps, macros, add-ins and drivers, which Desktop Analytics tests in a deployment plan.

form selector.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The box where the rulers meet, in the upper-left corner of a form in Design view. Use the box to perform form-level operations, such as selecting the form.

open sync center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A button that opens Sync Center.

view type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The basic structure of a view. When you create a view, you must first select one of five view types (table, timeline, day/week/month, card, or icon) to determine how information will be arranged and formatted in your new view.

workload.rule: Microsoft Terminology. sparsity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The relative percentage of a multidimensional structure's cells that do not contain data.

organizer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The account that controls the family settings such as permissions, roles, data sharing, etc.

meeting organizer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user who can schedule meetings, send invitations, do all the sharing activities in a meeting, and admit participants from the lobby.

extract.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To decompress, or pull out, files from a compressed form. glue.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To connect shapes such that they remain connected even when one of the shapes is moved.

typography.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The conversion of unformatted text into camera-ready type, suitable for printing.

microsoft data link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A .UDL text file that stores an OLE DB connectstring (similar to an ODBC file data source).

aspect ratio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The width-to-height ratio of a video or still image, or of the screen on which an image is displayed.

aspect.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The width-to-height ratio of a video or still image, or of the screen on which an image is displayed.

be right back.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The emoticon depicting a sign indicating that the person will return in a moment.

dictionary property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A property whose value can be set to the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the dictionary, an error message, or an empty string if no dictionary URI is found.

report snapshot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A static report that contains data captured at a specific point in time.

drop-down button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A command button that is clicked to display a drop-down menu instead of performing a command.

menu button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The button on the Xbox One controller and remote control that invokes Xbox help and other options from within an app or game.

compatibility mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of a computer or operating system that allows it to run programs written for a different system.

workpane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The area of the workspace that contains the options you select for a given task. Workpanes appear at certain times, such as when a document is opened, or when you click certain items on menus and toolbars.

media file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains audio, video, or script data.

sample data wizard.translation: trình hướng dẫn dữ liệu mẫu

agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application that runs on a Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) managed device. The agent application is the object of management activities. A computer running SNMP agent software is also sometimes referred to as an agent.

client-side.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Occurring on the client side of a client-server system. Java applets can be either server-side or client-side depending on which computer (the server or the client) executes them.

background task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A task that is part of an operating system or program, and is operating without interaction with the user while the user is working on another task.

cloned configuration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The practice of deploying new Edge Transport servers based on the configuration information of a previously configured source server. call tree.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: All modules that might be called by any procedure in the module in which code is currently running.

floating object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic or other object that is inserted in the drawing layer so that you can position it precisely on the page or in front of or behind text or other objects.

granularity attribute.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The single attribute is used to specify the level of granularity for a given dimension in relation to a given measure group.

duplicate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A duplicate document that is an exact copy of another document, including no differences in the formatting.

built-in toolbar.translation: thanh công cụ tích hợp sẵn
built-in toolbar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A toolbar that is part of an application when it's installed on your computer.

virus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Malware that replicates, commonly by infecting other files in the system, thus allowing the execution of the malware code and its propagation when those files are activated.

routing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of selecting paths in a network along which to send network traffic.

uid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An alphanumeric identification used to identify a particular user.

client software.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program that is run on a client computer rather than on a server computer.

prefix characters.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of 1 to 4 bytes that prefix each data field in a native-format bulk-copy data file.

aup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A statement issued by an online service that indicates what activities users may or may not engage in while logged into the service. For example, some providers prohibit users from engaging in commercial activity on the network.

cluster.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest amount of disk space that can be allocated to hold a file.

business task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A work-related action item that can be tracked through completion. A business task may occur once or repeatedly.

declaration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A binding of an identifier to the information that relates to it.

gn.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Personal Area Networks (PAN) that communicate directly between one or more Bluetooth-enabled computers or devices.

alias.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The portion of the email address that appears to the left of the @ symbol.

physical name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The name of the path where a file or mirrored file is located. The default is the path of the Master.dat file followed by the first eight characters of the file's logical name.

granularity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. shapestudio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape-development tool included in the Microsoft Office Visio 2003 SDK, providing a development and test environment that integrates with Visio.

long tones.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A setting for the phone keyboard that causes a key to continue to produce a tone as long as the key is pressed.

sender.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An individual who sends an electronic message.

remote session.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A connection to another computer on a network.

suite b algorithm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of a set of cryptographic algorithms specified by the US National Security Agency to provide an interoperable standard for government and industry.

privacy settings.translation: cài đặt về quyền riêng tư

custom group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item of a custom group field. A custom group contains two or more items from a row or column field.

competition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Businesses that sell similar products or services and compete for the same customer segment.

variation labels.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Sets of language collections with user-defined, language-specific formats and behaviors that can be applied to page layout. CMS supports up to 50 different labels.

alignment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The consistent positioning of text, graphics, and other objects.

configuration manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An administrative tool included in Duet Settings Manager. Users with Administrator privileges on the Duet client computer can use this tool to set and modify the configuration settings for the Duet client components.

details pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane that displays details about an item selected in another portion of the user interface. For example, in Microsoft Management Console (MMC), the details pane is the right pane that displays details for the selected item in the console tree.

results pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane that displays details about an item selected in another portion of the user interface. For example, in Microsoft Management Console (MMC), the details pane is the right pane that displays details for the selected item in the console tree.

federated user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An external user who has valid credentials from a federated partner, which is a trusted outside organization that is enabled for access to your Lync Server or Office Communications Server deployment.

microsoft® office project 2007.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Microsoft project management software used to plan, manage, and communicate a project schedule and other information among workgroup members, project managers, and other stakeholders.

simple recovery model.translation: mô hình phục hồi đơn giản
simple recovery model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database recovery mode that minimally logs all transactions sufficiently to ensure database consistency after a system crash or after restoring a data backup. The database is recoverable only up to the time of its most recent data backup, and restoring individual pages is unsupported.

encapsulated postscript.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Post-Script file format that can be used as an independent entity. The EPS image must be incorporated into the Post-Script output of an application such as a desktop publisher. Many high-quality clip-art packages consist of such images.

eps.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The portion of a company's profit allocated to each outstanding share of common stock. Earnings per share serves as an indicator of a company's profitability.

language code identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 32-bit value which consists of the language ID in the low word (bits 0-15) and the sorting ID (bits 16-19) and a reserved value (bits 20-31) in the high word.

locale id.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 32-bit value which consists of the language ID in the low word (bits 0-15) and the sorting ID (bits 16-19) and a reserved value (bits 20-31) in the high word.

lcid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 32-bit value which consists of the language ID in the low word (bits 0-15) and the sorting ID (bits 16-19) and a reserved value (bits 20-31) in the high word.

locale identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 32-bit value which consists of the language ID in the low word (bits 0-15) and the sorting ID (bits 16-19) and a reserved value (bits 20-31) in the high word.

item-level role assignment.translation: gán vai trò cấp độ mục
item-level role assignment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security policy that applies to an item in the report server folder namespace.

screen dump.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that shows all or part of a computer screen or other display.

screen shot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that shows all or part of a computer screen or other display.

screen capture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that shows all or part of a computer screen or other display.

screen clipping.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that shows all or part of a computer screen or other display.

screenshot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image that shows all or part of a computer screen or other display.

application database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu ứng dụng
application database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The database that stores user and system data for one application. The application database contains the events, subscriptions, and notifications for the application. It also contains system metadata, including the schemas for the events, subscriptions, and notifications for the application; and the match rules for the application.

form module.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A module that includes code for all event procedures triggered by events occurring on a specific form or its controls.

solve order.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The order of evaluation (from highest to lowest solve order) and calculation (from lowest to highest solve order) for calculated members, custom members, custom rollup formulas, and calculated cells in a single calculation pass of a multidimensional cube.

informational announcement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An audio message that is played when a user first dials in to a Unified Messaging system that describes some temporary condition of interest to all users.

referral.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A recommendation from a third party about a person or company with which to do business.

subform.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A form contained within another form or a report.

overflow area.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An area that holds overflow text and is not visible on the screen.

cluster network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of computers that work together to provide a common set of services and present a single-system image to clients for the purpose of enhancing availability and scalability.

event category.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In SQL Trace, a grouping of similar and logically related event classes.

predefined object.translation: đối tượng được xác định trước
predefined object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system-generated object.

browse mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A function that lets you scan database rows and update their values one row at a time.

detail section.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report section used to contain the main body of a form or report. This section usually contains controls bound to the fields in the record source, but can also contain unbound controls, such as labels that identify a field's contents.

zoom.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To move the camera forward or backwards, to zoom in and out the 3D object.

zoom in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To enlarge a selected portion of a graphical image or document to fill a window or the screen.

system locale.translation: ngôn ngữ cho chương trình phi Unicode
system locale.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Regional and Language Options setting that specifies the default code pages and associated bitmap font files for a specific computer that affects all of that computer's users. The default code pages and fonts enable a non-Unicode application written for one operating system language version to run correctly on another operating system language version.

language for non-unicode programs.translation: ngôn ngữ cho chương trình phi Unicode
language for non-unicode programs.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Regional and Language Options setting that specifies the default code pages and associated bitmap font files for a specific computer that affects all of that computer's users. The default code pages and fonts enable a non-Unicode application written for one operating system language version to run correctly on another operating system language version.

mouse over.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To pause the mouse pointer on a particular area of the screen, without clicking.

autorestart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process that can automatically restart the system after the occurrence of certain types of errors or a power system failure or the installation of an update.

service ticket.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A ticket issued by the Kerberos V5 ticket-granting service (TGS) that allows a user to authenticate to a specific service in the domain.

fact table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A central table in a data warehouse schema that contains numerical measures and keys relating facts to dimension tables.

endpoint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A consumer in a Web Part connection that receives data from a provider, used in connections for PerformancePoint Web Parts.

caps lock.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A toggle key that, when on, shifts the alphabetic characters on the keyboard to uppercase.

caps lock key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A toggle key that, when on, shifts the alphabetic characters on the keyboard to uppercase.

massively multiplayer on-line game.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A game conducted over the Internet in which a large number of players (hundreds or thousands) participate simultaneously.

mmog.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A game conducted over the Internet in which a large number of players (hundreds or thousands) participate simultaneously.

default instance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The instance of SQL Server that uses the same name as the computer name on which it is installed.

toolbar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A row, column, or block of buttons or icons, usually displayed across the top of the screen, that represent tasks or commands within the program. The toolbar buttons provide shortcuts to common tasks frequently accessed from the menus.

rich-text box.translation: hộp văn bản có định dạng
rich-text box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard Windows control that is similar to a standard text box, except that it also supports individual character and paragraph properties.

parent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a tree structure, an element that contains subordinate elements called child elements.

prediction.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A forecast of a value from a machine learning model.

dns name server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that maintains information about a portion of the DNS database and that responds to and resolves DNS queries.

dns server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that maintains information about a portion of the DNS database and that responds to and resolves DNS queries.

domain name server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that maintains information about a portion of the DNS database and that responds to and resolves DNS queries.

name server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that maintains information about a portion of the DNS database and that responds to and resolves DNS queries.

domain name system server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that maintains information about a portion of the DNS database and that responds to and resolves DNS queries.

zoom box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control in the upper right corner of the frame of a window on the Macintosh screen. When the user clicks on the zoom box, the window toggles between the maximum size and the size the user has set for it by dragging.

array formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formula that performs multiple calculations on one or more sets of values, and then returns either a single result or multiple results.

concurrency.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process that allows multiple users to access and change shared data at the same time. The Entity Framework implements an optimistic concurrency model.

help topic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The primary unit of information in a Help (.HLP) file. A topic is a self-contained body of text and graphics, similar to a page in a book.

raw file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A native format for fast reading and writing of data.

system stored procedures.translation: các thủ tục đã lưu trữ của hệ thống
system stored procedures.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of SQL Server-supplied stored procedures that can be used for actions such as retrieving information from the system catalog or performing administration tasks.

embedded chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart that is placed on a worksheet rather than on a separate chart sheet. Embedded charts are beneficial when you want to view or print a chart or a PivotChart report with its source data or other information in a worksheet.

oltp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system for processing transactions as soon as the computer receives them and updating master files immediately in a database management system. OLTP is useful in financial record keeping and inventory tracking.

online transaction processing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system for processing transactions as soon as the computer receives them and updating master files immediately in a database management system. OLTP is useful in financial record keeping and inventory tracking.

relay server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server that manages the exchange of messages or information among different users.

chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Sway button that allows users to insert a chart card.

joint photographic experts group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A raster graphics file format for displaying high-resolution color graphics on the World Wide Web. JPEG graphics apply a user-specified compression scheme that can significantly reduce the file sizes of photo-realistic color graphics. A higher level of compression results in lower quality, whereas a lower level of compression results in higher quality. JPEG-format files have a .jpg file name extension.

jpeg.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A raster graphics file format for displaying high-resolution color graphics on the World Wide Web. JPEG graphics apply a user-specified compression scheme that can significantly reduce the file sizes of photo-realistic color graphics. A higher level of compression results in lower quality, whereas a lower level of compression results in higher quality. JPEG-format files have a .jpg file name extension.

draft.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A preliminary version.

view generation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A repository engine feature that is used to create relational views based on classes, interfaces, and relationships in an information model.

full-text service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The SQL Server component that performs the full-text querying.

event source.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The point of origin of an event.

drop-down list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that can be opened to reveal all choices for a given field.

picklist.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that can be opened to reveal all choices for a given field.

dropdown list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that can be opened to reveal all choices for a given field.

switched network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A communications network that uses switching to establish a connection between parties, such as the dial-up telephone system.

unshare.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To make resources, such as folders, printers, records, etc., unavailable to others.

class.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A team type in Microsoft Teams for Education that allows teachers and students to collaborate on group projects, assignments, and more.

object class.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of objects that share a common set of characteristics.

remote partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A partition whose data is stored on a server running an instance of Analysis Services, other than the one used to store the metadata of the partition.

value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Text Excel function that converts a text argument to a number.

blittable type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data type that has a unique characteristic and an identical presentation in memory for both managed and unmanaged environments. It can be directly shared.

web project.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of files that specifies elements of a Web application.

seal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To store data in such a way that it can be retrieved later by the same security support component, and only by that security support component.

benchmark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard or point of reference against which things may be compared or assessed.

business note.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Outlook item that can be attached to a record's history log. Typically a note contains information regarding a conversation with a customer or other people in the company they work for.

local object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table, query, form, report, macro, or module that remains in the replica or Design Master where it was created. Neither the object nor changes to the object are copied to other members in the replica set.

translation management library.translation: Thư viện Quản lý Chuyển tiếp
translation management library.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A WSS / Office Server library used to organize and track documents in multiple languages throughout the translation workflow.

mark as final.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that applies a read-only state to a document inside client applications.

flag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic that indicates follow-up action is required, or otherwise identifies an important item.

compression utility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software program that reduces a file's size for storage on a disk. If a compressed file is too large to fit onto a single disk, the compression utility copies it onto multiple disks.

not valid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Erroneous or unrecognizable because of a flaw in reasoning or an error in input. Invalid results, for example, might occur if the logic in a program is faulty.

invalid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Erroneous or unrecognizable because of a flaw in reasoning or an error in input. Invalid results, for example, might occur if the logic in a program is faulty.

outlook e-mail postmark.translation: Dấu Email Gửi đi của Outlook
outlook e-mail postmark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computational proof that Outlook applies to outgoing messages to help recipient messaging systems distinguish legitimate email from junk email.

resistance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability to impede (resist) the flow of electric current. With the exception of superconductors, all substances have a greater or lesser degree of resistance. Substances with very low resistance, such as metals, conduct electricity well and are called conductors. Substances with very high resistance, such as glass and rubber, conduct electricity poorly and are called nonconductors or insulators.

panning hand.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A menu item in Internet Explorer that turns on the tool for Tablet PC users that allows the user to move the content of the page up and down, like a mouse scroll wheel.

roll back.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To reverse changes.

pure log backup.translation: sao lưu nhật ký thuần túy
pure log backup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A backup containing only the transaction log covering an interval without any bulk changes.

browsing history.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user’s private information such as temporary files, history, passwords, web form entries, and cookies that captures Internet surfing and other online activities.

security token service.translation: dịch vụ thông báo bảo mật
security token service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web service that issues security tokens. It makes assertions based on evidence that it trusts to whoever trusts it.

sts.translation: dịch vụ thông báo bảo mật
sts.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web service that issues security tokens. It makes assertions based on evidence that it trusts to whoever trusts it.

copyright symbol.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The © character. Normally included at the beginning of a copyright notice.

pickup directory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directory that receives RFC-822 compliant files from the file system for the purpose of creating message objects that can be passed to the Submission queue.

notes pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The pane in normal view in which you type notes that you want to accompany a slide. You print these notes as notes pages or have them display when you save a presentation as a Web page.

support.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item that is printed with a model to support and balance a model while it prints.

domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of possible values for an independent variable in a function or for a database attribute.

top-level domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the Internet and other networks, the highest subdivision of a domain name in a network address, which identifies the type of entity owning the address (for example, .com for commercial users or .edu for educational institutions) or the geographical location of the address (for example, .fr for France or .sg for Singapore). The domain is the last part of the address (for example, www.acm.org).

tld.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the Internet and other networks, the highest subdivision of a domain name in a network address, which identifies the type of entity owning the address (for example, .com for commercial users or .edu for educational institutions) or the geographical location of the address (for example, .fr for France or .sg for Singapore). The domain is the last part of the address (for example, www.acm.org).

promote.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To indicate that a document or search result is highly relevant for a particular keyword, causing it to be ranked more highly than it otherwise would have been.

software licensing commerce client.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service or feature of Windows that enables licensing at the feature level; thereby broadening the distribution and licensing options for retailers, ISVs, and OEMs. New business models may include: trials, subscriptions, gifting, transfers, or pay-for-use.

slcc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. execution tree.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The path of data in the data flow of a SQL Server 2005 Integration Services package from sources through transformations to destinations.

e-mail settings.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Options that allow members to change their email address, message delivery, community report delivery, requested notifications, and email format.

document type definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of syntax rules for mark-up tags and their interpretation.
