Originally developed for use with Standard Generalized Markup Language (SGML), DTD defines the relationships between document elements.

dtd.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of syntax rules for mark-up tags and their interpretation. Within an HTML (or XML) document, a DTD provides specific information on what tags are used in the document (and in what order those tags should appear), which tags can appear inside other ones, which tags have attributes, and so forth. Originally developed for use with Standard Generalized Markup Language (SGML), DTD defines the relationships between document elements.

wifi.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of standards for delivering digital information over high-frequency, wireless local area networks, defined by IEEE 802.11.

wireless fidelity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of standards for delivering digital information over high-frequency, wireless local area networks, defined by IEEE 802.11.

wi-fi.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of standards for delivering digital information over high-frequency, wireless local area networks, defined by IEEE 802.11.

recovery interval.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The maximum amount of time that the Database Engine should require to recover a database.

bulk export.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To copy a large set of data rows out of a SQL Server table into a data file.

control group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of controls that are related either conceptually or logically.

email account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The server name, user name, password, and email address used to connect to an email service. You create the email account using information provided by your mail administrator or Internet service provider (ISP).

voip gateway.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer device that converts between circuit switch telephony protocols and VoIP protocols.

sign in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UI element that creates a user session or establishes user access to a service.

regression line.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A straight line that represents the relationship between matched pairs of data from two collections of data. The equation of the line is derived using the least-squares method of linear regression.

active messaging protection.translation: Bảo vệ Gửi thư Chủ động
active messaging protection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process by which antivirus and anti-spam agents and filters are applied to email messages for the purpose of stopping unsolicited or malicious emails from entering the organization.

system integrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity that develops enterprise applications by integrating hardware or software provided by independent vendors.

systems integrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity that develops enterprise applications by integrating hardware or software provided by independent vendors.

line item order.translation: Thứ tự Đơn hàng Chi tiết
line item order.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The display name of an attribute that specifies the position of an item in the list of contract line items.

multimedia clip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A single media file, including art, sound, animation, or movies.

media clip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A single media file, including art, sound, animation, or movies.

clip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A single media file, including art, sound, animation, or movies.

conference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A conversation between three or more people, where the communications technology is unknown or not specified.

sign up.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To enroll in a service, often resulting in setting up a new account.

title case.translation: viết hoa chữ cái đầu của mỗi từ
title case.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A case distinction in which every word's first character is uppercase and the remaining letters are lower case.

language reference.translation: tài liệu tham khảo ngôn ngữ
language reference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of reference material supporting a programming language.

index entry.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A field code that marks specific text for inclusion in an index. When you mark text as an index entry, Microsoft Office Word inserts an XE (Index Entry) field formatted as hidden text.

network center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control panel that provides the status of your network and access to networking activities.

data table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A range of cells that shows how changing certain values in your formulas affects the results of the formulas.

luminance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The perceived brightness component of a given color, as opposed to its hue or its saturation.

luminosity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The perceived brightness component of a given color, as opposed to its hue or its saturation.

administration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. This feature also allows users to switch to Microsoft FrontPage for creating their Web pages and to select a time zone for their Shared Sites.

paste.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To insert content, such as text or a graphic, that has been cut or copied from one document into a different location in the same or a different document.

pilot identifier.translation: ký hiệu nhận dạng chỉ dẫn
pilot identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The string that is received with a new call that is used to associate the call with a dial plan.

editor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The collection of Office intelligent features that find issues in writing in documents and suggest corrections or alternatives to improve it in some way.

text editor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program that creates files or makes changes to existing files.

voice messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system that sends and receives messages in the form of sound recordings.

table data region.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report item on a report layout that displays data in a columnar format.

relational olap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A storage mode that uses tables in a relational database to store multidimensional structures.

back up.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To make a duplicate copy of a program, a disk, or data.

layout cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cell in a layout table.

content page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A page that contains the content to be merged with a master page in order to render as complete web page.

knowledge worker.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An individual whose job centers on using a computer to collect, process, and apply information, especially when meaningful value is added to purely factual information. A knowledge worker is someone with both formal education and the ability to apply that education knowledge in a work situation.

evaluation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The determination, by a program, of the value of an expression or the action that a program statement specifies. Evaluation can take place at compile time or at run time.

left-to-right.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to keyboard settings, document views, user interface objects, and languages for which text is displayed in a left-to-right direction. English and most other European languages are left-to-right languages.

list box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control in Windows that enables the user to choose one option from a list of possibilities.

business project.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A project that is created in Business Contact Manager for Outlook. A business project is made up of one or several project tasks.

hyperlink display text.translation: văn bản hiển thị siêu kết nối
hyperlink display text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The part of a hyperlink in a document or Web page that displays as text on the screen.

retire.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To remove managed hardware, software, or an IT service, from a production environment by using a controlled process.

button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic element that appears similar to a physical button or keyboard key in the UI. A button is "pressed" by clicking on it with a mouse, by hitting ENTER or RETURN on the keyboard (if the button has the focus) or tapping by a finger.

mouse button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A movable piece on a device that is pressed to activate some function.

personalization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature with which you can direct Web-based content or email messages to customers based on their user profile data and their previous requests for content.

absolute positioning.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Placement of an element relative to either the element's parent or, if there isn't one, the body. Values for the element's Left and Top properties are relative to the upper-left corner of the element's parent.

fixed positioning.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Placement of an element relative to either the element's parent or, if there isn't one, the body. Values for the element's Left and Top properties are relative to the upper-left corner of the element's parent.

alert.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that notifies a user when there is a change to posted content, workflow status, or when other user-defined criteria are met.

derived column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A transformation that creates new column values by applying expressions to transformation input columns.

business intelligence.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of theories, methodologies, processes, architectures, and technologies that transform raw data into meaningful and useful information for business purposes.

identity increment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The incremental value that is added to the identity value of the previous row that was loaded.

history log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The section in an Account, Business Contact, or Opportunity record that contains all items (such as phone logs, business notes, and email messages) that are linked to the record.

advanced find.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool used to search for specific records and activities. With Advanced Find, users can specify fields, conditions, and values to search on, in order to receive a detailed result list of records and activities.

sensitive cursor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cursor that can reflect data modifications made to underlying data by other users while the cursor is open.

delivery channel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pipeline between a distributor and a delivery service.

print preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view of a document as it will appear when you print it.

strong password.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A password that cannot be easily guessed or cracked and which is at least eight characters long, does not contain all or part of the user's account name, and contains at least three of the four following categories of characters: uppercase characters, lowercase characters, numbers, and symbols found on the keyboard (such as !, @, #).

external table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table outside the open database or project.

message body.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The content that is delivered in an email message.

signing services for office.translation: Dịch vụ Ký dành cho Office
signing services for office.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The digital signature functionality including Digital Signatures, electronic signatures, Mark As Final and Electronic Postmarks.

external network number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 4-byte hexadecimal number used for addressing and routing purposes on NetWare networks. The external network number is associated with physical network adapters and networks.

scorecard indicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of graphics, text, and colors for defining different levels of performance when comparing an actual value and a target value within a KPI.

indicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dial or light that displays information about the status of a device, such as a light connected to a disk drive that glows when the disk is being accessed.

audit trail.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A time-stamped record of all the changes that users make to a record.

audit log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A time-stamped record of all the changes that users make to a record.

fqdn.translation: tên miền đầy đủ tiêu chuẩn
fqdn.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A DNS name that specifies its absolute location in the domain namespace tree.

fully qualified domain name.translation: tên miền đầy đủ tiêu chuẩn
fully qualified domain name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A DNS name that specifies its absolute location in the domain namespace tree.

switch user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UI command used to switch between accounts on a device.

carriage return.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ASCII control character (13) that tells a computer or printer to return to the beginning of the current line.

cr.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ASCII control character (13) that tells a computer or printer to return to the beginning of the current line.

active directory contact.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Active Directory object that contains information about an individual such as name, address, and job title. It can include a foreign email address.

native format.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data format that maintains the native data types of a database. Native format is recommended when you bulk transfer data between multiple instances of Microsoft SQL Server using a data file that does not contain any extended/double-byte character set (DBCS) characters.

layout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ribbon tab that provides users with options to change the page structure.

repaginate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To recalculate the page breaks in a document.

bold.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to characters that are formatted to appear darker and heavier than the surrounding text.

ddl trigger.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special kind of trigger that executes in response to Data Definition Language (DDL) statements.

security extension.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component in Reporting Services that authenticates a user or group to a report server.

video card.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The electronic components that generate the video signal sent through a cable to a video display. The video adapter is usually located on the computer's main system board or on an expansion board, but it is sometimes built into the terminal.

display adapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The electronic components that generate the video signal sent through a cable to a video display. The video adapter is usually located on the computer's main system board or on an expansion board, but it is sometimes built into the terminal.

application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of instructions that a computer or device uses to perform a specific task, such as word processing, accounting, or data management.

data packet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unit of information transmitted as a whole from one device to another on a network.

managed code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Code that is executed by the common language runtime environment rather than directly by the operating system. Managed code applications gain common language runtime services such as automatic garbage collection, runtime type checking and security support, and so on. These services help provide uniform platform- and language-independent behavior of managed-code applications.

safe code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Code that is executed by the common language runtime environment rather than directly by the operating system. Managed code applications gain common language runtime services such as automatic garbage collection, runtime type checking and security support, and so on. These services help provide uniform platform- and language-independent behavior of managed-code applications.

postmaster.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The logon name (and therefore the email address) of an account that is responsible for maintaining email services on a mail server. When an account holder is having trouble with email, a message to postmaster or "postmaster@machine.org.domain.name" will usually reach a human who can solve the problem.

discretionary access control list.translation: danh mục kiểm soát truy cập theo ý muốn
discretionary access control list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An access control list that is controlled by the owner of an object and that specifies the access particular users or groups can have to the object.

dacl.translation: danh mục kiểm soát truy cập theo ý muốn
dacl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An access control list that is controlled by the owner of an object and that specifies the access particular users or groups can have to the object.

remote access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Part of the integrated Routing and Remote Access service that provides remote networking for telecommuters, mobile workers, and system administrators who monitor and manage servers at multiple branch offices. Users can use Network Connections to dial in to remotely access their networks for services such as file and printer sharing, electronic mail, scheduling, and SQL database access.

scale factor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number determining the degree to which a shape or image will be inflated or deflated.

scaling factor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number determining the degree to which a shape or image will be inflated or deflated.

instant messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to a message sent in real time through a network to a private chat area.

im.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A message sent in real time through a network to a private chat area.

service request.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A request from a customer for a service.

sr.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A request from a customer for a service.

internet connection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A connection between the user's device and a server that provides access to the Internet, typically through an Internet service provider.

web connection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A connection between the user's device and a server that provides access to the Internet, typically through an Internet service provider.

content indexing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of creating an index of the content.

semiconductor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A substance, commonly silicon or germanium, whose ability to conduct electricity falls between that of a conductor and that of a nonconductor (insulator). The term is used loosely to refer to electronic components made from semiconductor materials.

internet storage name service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A lightweight protocol designed to make the automated discovery, management, and configuration of iSCSI and Fiber Channel Protocol (FCP) devices on a TCP/IP network easier by providing a common mechanism for initiators and targets to discover one another and for handling zoning and authentication of both targets and initiators.

isns.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A lightweight protocol designed to make the automated discovery, management, and configuration of iSCSI and Fiber Channel Protocol (FCP) devices on a TCP/IP network easier by providing a common mechanism for initiators and targets to discover one another and for handling zoning and authentication of both targets and initiators.

table pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The area of the Query window that displays the tables in a query. Each table displays the fields from which you can retrieve data.

pivottable data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a PivotTable report, the summarized data calculated from the data fields of a source list or table.

path.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the MARS user interface, a logical course through a task in CRM, such as creating an account or qualifying a lead, leading to the conclusion of that task.

subscribe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To start using the services of a service provider, e.g. an Internet access provider.

page view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The request by a user's browser for a Web page. The number of requests to view a page can indicate the frequency with which an ad is viewed.

api.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An out-of-band, non-intrusive deployment mode that integrates directly into the framework of enterprise cloud applications, taking only a few minutes per application to set up.

application program interface.translation: giao diện lập trình ứng dụng
application program interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of routines that an application uses to request and carry out lower-level services performed by a computer's or device's operating system. These routines usually carry out maintenance tasks such as managing files and displaying information.

application programming interface.translation: giao diện lập trình ứng dụng
application programming interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of routines that an application uses to request and carry out lower-level services performed by a computer's or device's operating system. These routines usually carry out maintenance tasks such as managing files and displaying information.

non-printable character.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A character used to control the format of displayed or printed information, rather than to represent a particular letter, digit, or other special character. The space ( ) is one of the more important nonprinting characters.

nonprinting character.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A character used to control the format of displayed or printed information, rather than to represent a particular letter, digit, or other special character. The space ( ) is one of the more important nonprinting characters.

grayscale.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A filter effect in Windows Movie Maker.

browse.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of Copilot prompts that helps users find and understand content.

browse for.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To scan a database, a list of files, or the Internet, either for a particular item or for anything that seems to be of interest.

infrared light.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Light that is beyond red in the color spectrum. While the light is not visible to the human eye, infrared transmitters and receivers can send and receive infrared signals.

infrared.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Having a frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum in the range just below that of red light.

ir.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A first email or phone interaction created after an incident has been logged and a ticket generated.

cross product.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operator in the relational algebra used in database management that, when applied to two existing relations (tables), results in the creation of a new table containing all possible ordered concatenations (combinations) of tuples (rows) from the first relation with tuples from the second. The number of rows in the resulting relation is the product of the number of rows in the two source relations.

cartesian product.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operator in the relational algebra used in database management that, when applied to two existing relations (tables), results in the creation of a new table containing all possible ordered concatenations (combinations) of tuples (rows) from the first relation with tuples from the second. The number of rows in the resulting relation is the product of the number of rows in the two source relations.

registered user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Someone who visits a Web site and purposefully supplies personal information, such as name, address, and phone number.

font subsetting.translation: nhúng tập hợp con của phông
font subsetting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Embedding a limited number of characters specific to one font, reducing file size.

forward mailbox.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mailbox used by the E-mail Router to route incoming Microsoft Dynamics CRM email messages and create activities for individual users.

hold.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A button on Phone Controls that places the current phone call on hold.

address rewriting inbound agent.translation: Tác nhân Ghi lại Địa chỉ
address rewriting inbound agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Address Rewriting agent for messages that enter an Exchange Server 2007 organization.

delivery.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The supply or release of a product or a service.

deployment package.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of files that can be delivered as a unit to a client computer or device for installation.

windows defender firewall.translation: Tường lửa của Bộ bảo vệ Windows
windows defender firewall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Control Panel feature that is used to set restrictions on what traffic is allowed to enter your network from the Internet.

phishing website.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web site that impersonates a trustworthy Web site to obtain user's personal or financial information.

base language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The language used for the installation of software.

windows explorer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A utility that enables the user to locate and open files and folders.

file explorer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A utility that enables the user to locate and open files and folders.

declarations section.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The section of a module containing declarations that apply to every procedure in the module. It can include declarations for variables, constants, user-defined data types, and external procedures in a dynamic-link library.

repository engine.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Object-oriented software that provides management support for and customer access to a repository database.

clean shutdown.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system shutdown that occurs without errors.

internet site.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A web site available on the Internet.

keyword.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A designation that is produced in the output of a search for text in a corpus, and that has special significance in the context of this search.

insertion point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The location where text or graphics will be inserted. Also used for text box controls to indicate input focus.

system caret.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The location where text or graphics will be inserted. Also used for text box controls to indicate input focus.

item type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The data definition for a class of items stored in a Web application. An item type consists of its name and references to the default set of fields (properties) associated with items of that class.

outlook voice access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that allows a Unified Messaging-enabled user to access their Microsoft Exchange Server mailbox over the telephone and navigate through their mailboxes by using telephone-key or speech input.

out of office.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status applied to blocks of time in a user's Calendar to indicate that the user will be away.

background color.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The color against which characters and graphics are displayed.

sticky button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An on/off control within a graphical user interface that when clicked remains "down" (appearing to be pressed) until it is clicked again.

toggle button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An on/off control within a graphical user interface that when clicked remains "down" (appearing to be pressed) until it is clicked again.

toggle switch.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An on/off control within a graphical user interface that when clicked remains "down" (appearing to be pressed) until it is clicked again.

intrinsic constant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A constant that is part of Microsoft Access or a referenced library.

recurring.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to items that occur repeatedly. For example, an appointment or task that occurs on a regular basis, such as a weekly status meeting or a monthly haircut, can be designated as recurring.

settings modifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Software that changes settings without adequate consent.

update query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An action query that changes a set of records according to criteria you specify. An update query does not return any records.

fat.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file system used by MS-DOS and Microsoft Windows operating systems to organize and manage files.

file allocation table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file system used by MS-DOS and Microsoft Windows operating systems to organize and manage files.

tamper.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To maliciously modify data.

safe recipients list.translation: Danh sách người nhận an toàn
safe recipients list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that includes the email addresses of mailing lists for which you want to be a recipient. Messages sent to such a mailing list and received by you will not be treated as junk email.

data execution prevention.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security feature that monitors programs on a computer to determine if they use system memory safely.

dep.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security feature that monitors programs on a computer to determine if they use system memory safely.

base character.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A character that has meaning independent of other characters, or any graphical character that is not a diacritical mark.

theta join.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A join based on a comparison of scalar values.

object variable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A variable that contains a reference to an object.

share.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directory or folder made available to users over the network.

trojan ftp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of trojan that uses an FTP server to allow an attacker to download files to and from a computer.

float.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data type used in some programming languages, notably C, to declare variables that can store floating-point numbers.

snapshot viewer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program you use to view, print, and electronically mail a snapshot, such as a report snapshot.

managed default folder.translation: thư mục mặc định được quản lý
managed default folder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed folder that appears in Outlook by default, to which messaging records management has been applied, and whose the retention and journaling is controlled by managed content settings that are applied to the folder.

smart host.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A designated server through which Exchange routes all outgoing messages. The smart host then makes the remote connection. If a smart host is designated, the Exchange server only needs to transmit to the smart host, instead of repeatedly contacting the domain until a connection is made.

relay host.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A designated server through which Exchange routes all outgoing messages. The smart host then makes the remote connection. If a smart host is designated, the Exchange server only needs to transmit to the smart host, instead of repeatedly contacting the domain until a connection is made.

subsidiary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A company controlled by another company or corporation.

compress.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To reduce the size of a set of data, such as a file or a communications message, so that it can be stored in less space or transmitted with less bandwidth.

team resources.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows task work to be assigned to a group at the resource level to rather than to an individual. The total work load of the team resource includes both each individual's and the team's. These are not project teams.

public im service provider.translation: nhà cung cấp dịch vụ IM công cộng
public im service provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization providing IM (instant messaging) services to the public.

microsoft® office sharepoint® server 200.translation: Microsoft® Office SharePoint® Server 2007 Standard CAL
microsoft® office sharepoint® server 200.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft client access license (CAL) for Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2007.

default shape.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A virtual shape that contains default formatting properties for new shapes. Each presentation contains one default shape.

performance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The degree to which a product or service executes its specified function.

page sorter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One or more page-shaped controls, located in the lower left corner of the Publisher window, that represent each page of the publication and can be used to go to, rearrange, or work with publication pages.

query window.translation: thời gian dành cho truy vấn
query window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reserved time for performing large, resource-intensive queries for a computer, server farm, or server cluster.

access control list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based systems, a list of access control entries (ACE) that apply to an entire object, a set of the object's properties, or an individual property of an object, and that define the access granted to one or more security principals.

acl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based systems, a list of access control entries (ACE) that apply to an entire object, a set of the object's properties, or an individual property of an object, and that define the access granted to one or more security principals.

notes page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A printed page that displays author notes beneath the slide that the notes accompany.

single copy cluster.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A clustered Exchange deployment that uses shared storage and can have multiple active and passive servers (referred to as nodes) dedicated to a clustered mailbox server.

scc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A clustered Exchange deployment that uses shared storage and can have multiple active and passive servers (referred to as nodes) dedicated to a clustered mailbox server.

mail flow rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule that is defined for an Exchange Online organization and that takes actions on messages before they are delivered to mailboxes based on specified conditions.

transport rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule that is defined for an Exchange Online organization and that takes actions on messages before they are delivered to mailboxes based on specified conditions.

grabber.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device used in computer graphics that uses a video camera, rather than a scan head, to capture a video image and then stores it in memory with the aid of a special-purpose circuit board.

video digitizer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device used in computer graphics that uses a video camera, rather than a scan head, to capture a video image and then stores it in memory with the aid of a special-purpose circuit board.

frame grabber.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device used in computer graphics that uses a video camera, rather than a scan head, to capture a video image and then stores it in memory with the aid of a special-purpose circuit board.

calendar data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Free or busy information for internal or federated contacts obtained by Lync or Office Communicator from Microsoft Outlook via a web service.

key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The emoticon depicting an old key.

forward.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A navigation button used to return to a page from which the user has navigated away via the web browser Back command.

coalesce.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A function that returns the first non-null expression from a list of arguments.

access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ability to view data or navigate to or within a physical or virtual computer environment.

snapshot share.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A share available for the storage of snapshot files. Snapshot files contain the schema and data for published tables.

publication retention period.translation: thời gian lưu giữ ấn bản
publication retention period.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In merge replication, the amount of time a subscription can remain unsynchronized.

balloon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A small pop-up window that informs users of a non-critical problem or special condition in a control.

markup balloon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An outlined container that displays a markup element, such as a comment or revision, in the margin of a document.

linked measure group.translation: nhóm giá trị đo được liên kết
linked measure group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reference in a cube to a measure group in a different cube (that is, a cube with a different data source view that exists in the same or a different Analysis Services database). A linked measure group can only be edited in the source database.

launch.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To activate an application program (especially on the Macintosh) from the operating system's user interface.

vl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A way to obtain and manage multiple software product licenses and to allow for multiple installations of the software product.

volume licensing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A way to obtain and manage multiple software product licenses and to allow for multiple installations of the software product.

digital locker.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft web-based service that provides customized accounts to users so that they can select, purchase, download, and update software applicable to Microsoft Windows from multiple retailers.

baseline.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the printing and display of characters on the screen, an imaginary horizontal line with which the base of each character, excluding descenders, is aligned.

outline numbered list.translation: danh sách đánh số dàn bài
outline numbered list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list created to apply a hierarchical structure to any list or document. A document can have up to nine levels, and Microsoft Office Word does not apply built-in heading styles to the items in the list.

ole object link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An OLE data format that describes a linked object, identifying the class, document name, and name of an object. Each of these data items is a null-terminated string.

object link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An OLE data format that describes a linked object, identifying the class, document name, and name of an object. Each of these data items is a null-terminated string.

envelope.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Header and footer information, or header information only, which encapsulates or precedes document data for transport.

discussion group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A forum on the Internet for discussions on a specified range of subjects.

newsgroup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A forum on the Internet for discussions on a specified range of subjects.

client-side rendering.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Technology that enables rendering operations to be handled by the client.

csr.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The responsibility of a company for the impacts of its decisions and activities on society and the environment, through transparent and ethical behaviour that contributes to sustainable development, takes into account the expectations of stakeholders, is in compliance with applicable law and consistent with international norms of behavior, and is integrated throughout the organization and practised in its relationships, as based on ISO 26000:2010.

delete level.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Data Transformation Services, the amount and kind of data to remove from a data warehouse.

query plan.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An internal strategy by which a database server tries to create result sets quickly.

chapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a DVD or a video, a portion of a title, such as a scene or sequence. A title can contain one or more chapters.

system role definition.translation: định nghĩa vai trò hệ thống
system role definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Role definition that conveys site-wide authority.

document panel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane that displays document property information for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files stored in a WSS library. The pane is displayed below the ribbon and is actually a hosted custom InfoPath form. Information is synced automatically between the document and the WSS library.

document information panel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane that displays document property information for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files stored in a WSS library. The pane is displayed below the ribbon and is actually a hosted custom InfoPath form. Information is synced automatically between the document and the WSS library.

text label.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Descriptive text that you can add to a form, worksheet, chart, or other document.

action statement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest executable entity within a programming language.

statement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A compiled T-SQL query.

audio cd.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A compact disc containing audio information (as opposed to a CD-ROM containing data and files).

relevancy ranking.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of ordering search results to reflect their degree of relatedness to the search query.

relevance ranking.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of ordering search results to reflect their degree of relatedness to the search query.

price quote.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formal offer for products or services, proposed at specific prices and related payment terms.

quote.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The preset motion title in Clipchamp that adds animated text elements in video editing projects.

quotation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formal offer for products or services, proposed at specific prices and related payment terms.

estimate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formal offer for products or services, proposed at specific prices and related payment terms.

case.translation: trường hợp quản lý rủi ro từ nội bộ
case.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A record that is manually created from insider risk alerts in the situations where further action is needed to address a compliance-related issue for an employee. Each case is scoped to a single employee and multiple alerts for the employee can be added to an existing case or to a new case.

job.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A regular paid position.

contract.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Service Broker object that defines the message types that can be exchanged within a given conversation.

session initiation protocol.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard signaling protocol for establishing multi-media communications sessions between two or more users over an IP network.

sip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard signaling protocol for establishing multi-media communications sessions between two or more users over an IP network.

time slice.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A brief period of time during which a particular task is given control of the microprocessor in a time-sharing multitasking environment.

security protocol.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A specification that defines security-related data objects and rules about how the objects are used to maintain security on a computer system.

server copy.translation: bản sao trên máy phục vụ
server copy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A copy of a file that has been saved to a server.

line screen frequency.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The fineness or coarseness of a halftone screen represented by lines per inch (LPI).

rc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A version of a build that has been tested and is ready for release.

release candidate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A version of a build that has been tested and is ready for release.

folder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that allows users to group tiles and Live Tiles on the Start Screen and keep apps better organized.

wordart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Text objects you create with ready-made effects to which you can apply additional formatting options.

bifurcation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The act of splitting a single copy of a message to multiple copies of the message.

running text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text that forms the major content of a publication. Does not include titles, headlines, pull quotes, and captions, for example.

body text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text that forms the major content of a publication. Does not include titles, headlines, pull quotes, and captions, for example.

security group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group that can be listed in discretionary access control lists (DACLs) used to define permissions on resources and objects. mining model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that contains the definition of a data mining process and the results of the training activity. unsigned integer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data type that can only hold a whole number with a value greater than, or equal to, zero. In this implementation, the maximum value that an unsigned integer can hold is 0xFFFFFFFF (4,294,967,295).

synchronous.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to applications or commands run in the order listed and that must finish before the next application or command is run.

sync.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of reconciling the differences between data stored in one location and a copy of the same data stored in another location.

onion diagram.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of block diagram with concentric and partial layer shapes.

timeline.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A place in Recall feature where users can scroll through their past snapshots to find things they've seen on their Windows computer.

unified messaging server role.translation: vai trò máy chủ Unified Messaging

postscript file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file created with PostScript page-description language. Nearly all high-resolution files are PostScript.

skyscraper.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic ad that is the full height of a page and normally 120 pixels wide.

skyscraper banner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic ad that is the full height of a page and normally 120 pixels wide.

chaining.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In computers, the linking of two or more entities so that they are dependent upon one another for operation.

administrator-approved form template.translation: mẫu biểu mẫu được người quản trị chấp thuận

community.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The global meeting place (App, Social Media, and website) for Windows users to find more information about Windows, engage with each other and the Windows Engineering team, and provide feedback.

online community.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collective of people who interact through or use online resources.

interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Software that enables a program to work with the user (the user interface, which can be a command-line interface, menu-driven, or a graphical user interface), with another program such as the operating system, or with the computer's hardware.

entity relationship.translation: mối quan hệ của thực thể

classic view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SharePoint view that renders in HTML format, or a similar markup language such as CHTML or WML, and provides backward compatibility for mobile browsers that cannot support the contemporary view.

security id.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based systems, a unique value that identifies a user, group, or computer account within an enterprise. Every account is issued a SID when it is created.

sid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based systems, a unique value that identifies a user, group, or computer account within an enterprise. Every account is issued a SID when it is created.

security identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based systems, a unique value that identifies a user, group, or computer account within an enterprise. Every account is issued a SID when it is created.

quiesce.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To bring a form, service, server farm, or form template offline gradually by not accepting new user sessions and allowing existing sessions to finish.

usage analysis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables data collection to evaluate how Web sites on your server are being used.

sales pipeline.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A potential sales transaction in process.

pipeline.rule: Microsoft Terminology. smalldatetime.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A date and time data type that is less precise than the datetime data type. Data values range from January 1, 1900, through June 6, 2079, to an accuracy of one minute.

reflexive relationship.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A relationship from a column or combination of columns in a table to other columns in that same table.

trace definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A statement that defines a trace.

resistor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A circuit component designed to provide a specific amount of resistance to current flow.

irp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Data structures that drivers use to communicate with each other.

connection point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A handle on a shape to which you can glue the endpoints of a 1-D shape such as a connector shape.

high-density multichip interconnect.translation: giao diện đa phương tiện phân giải cao

hdmi.translation: giao diện đa phương tiện phân giải cao
hdmi.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A digital interface specification for delivering digital content and connecting consumer electronic devices.

high-definition multimedia interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A digital interface specification for delivering digital content and connecting consumer electronic devices.

microsoft® office outlook® 2007 with bus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Microsoft supplemental software that adds small-business contact management capabilities to Office Outlook 2007. macro window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The window in which you create and modify macros.

actual value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A value for a KPI that is compared to a predefined target value.

contact.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An individual who is interested in doing business or who currently does business with your organization. A contact may or may not be part of a larger organization (account).

missed call notification.translation: thông báo cuộc gọi bị lỡ
missed call notification.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An email message that is sent to a Unified Messaging subscriber that indicates that someone called but did not leave a message.

8-bit color.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A display setting that holds up to 256 specific color entries. Any color palette attached to a picture is by definition an 8-bit palette.

remote stored procedure.translation: thủ tục được lưu trữ từ xa
remote stored procedure.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A stored procedure located on one instance of SQL Server that is executed by a statement on another instance of SQL Server.

buffer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A quantity of time or materials maintained in the work flow as a cushion against fluctuations in throughput.

field terminator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In bulk copy, one or more characters marking the end of a field or row, separating one field or row in the data file from the next.

printer driver.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The device that communicates between your software program and your printer.

embedded object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object created with one program and embedded into a document created by another. matched name selection method.translation: phương pháp chọn tên trùng khớp
matched name selection method.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The mechanism used to help a caller differentiate between users with names that match the touch-tone or speech input.

defender antivirus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Microsoft's antimalware solution that provides next generation protection for desktops, portable computers, and servers.

delimited text file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file containing data where individual field values are separated by a character, such as a comma or a tab.

hierarchical.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Of, relating to, or organized as a hierarchy.

change font.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A button that opens the Change Font dialog box, where the user can select a new font, style, size, and effects for instant messages.

ime.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that lets you enter complex characters and symbols, such as those used in East Asian written languages, using a standard keyboard.

input method editor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that lets you enter complex characters and symbols, such as those used in East Asian written languages, using a standard keyboard.

venn diagram.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A diagram that is used to show areas of overlap between and among elements.

site map.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A store, such as a file, that describes the logical layout of a Web site (as distinct from the physical layout of pages).

status reason.translation: lý do dẫn đến trạng thái
status reason.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The description of the status of a record or activity. The options available are based on what record type is open and in which module.

right-to-left.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to keyboard settings, document views, user interface objects, languages, etc. for which text is displayed in a right-to-left direction.

rtl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to keyboard settings, document views, user interface objects, languages, etc. for which text is displayed in a right-to-left direction.

microsoft office live.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft set of business productivity services that provides a secure online workspace for organizing and managing information and a complete set of tools that integrate with existing Microsoft Office programs.

update list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that includes the name of the person who originally sent a task request plus the names of everyone who received the task request, reassigned the task to someone else, or chose to keep an updated copy of the task in their task list.

rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of conditions that hold back elements or modify the appearance of an existing list or data set in order to view a specific subset of the data.

rule line.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A line printed above, below, or to the side of some element, either to set that item off from the remainder of the page or to improve the look of the page. Footnotes, for example, often appear below a short rule that sets them off from the main text on the page. The thickness of a rule is typically measured in points. (A point is approximately 1/72 inch.)

hibernation file cleaner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows deletion of the files created during hibernation.

overlap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To extend over and cover a part of something.

system info.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The information about a computer that's derived from the System Information program.

globalization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of designing and developing a software product to function in multiple locales. Globalization involves identifying the locales that must be supported, designing features that support those locales, and writing code that functions equally well in any of the supported locales.

owner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user who is responsible for a particular record in the system and is frequently allowed to perform actions on the record that other users cannot.

system.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any application or process that you want to model. Examples of systems include a computer game, a process for assembling microchips, and a library information system.

title master.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The slide that stores information from the design template pertaining to styles on title slides, including placeholder sizes and positions, background design, and color schemes.

mirror margins.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Margins of the left page are a mirror image of those of the right page. That is, the inside margins are the same width, and the outside margins are the same width.

ethernet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A networking standard that uses cables to provide network access. Ethernet is the most widely installed technology for connecting computers.

balance sheet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A statement of the financial position of an organization that reports the state of assets, liabilities, and equity on a specified date.

unicode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Text Excel function that returns the number (code point) that corresponds to the first character of the text.

lcd.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of display that uses a liquid compound having a polar molecular structure, sandwiched between two transparent electrodes. A polarized filter laminated over the electrodes blocks polarized light. In this way, a grid of electrodes can selectively "turn on" a cell, or a pixel, containing the liquid crystal material, turning it dark.

liquid crystal display.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of display that uses a liquid compound having a polar molecular structure, sandwiched between two transparent electrodes. When an electric field is applied, the molecules align with the field, forming a crystalline arrangement that polarizes the light passing through it. A polarized filter laminated over the electrodes blocks polarized light. In this way, a grid of electrodes can selectively "turn on" a cell, or a pixel, containing the liquid crystal material, turning it dark.

federated.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to a contact who is external to the user's organization or enterprise but with whom the user's organization or enterprise is linked.

lost data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Information that cannot be found or recovered.

3-d reference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reference to a range that spans two or more worksheets in a workbook.

raster image.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A display image formed by patterns of light and dark or differently colored pixels in a rectangular array.

invoice.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The bill provided by the seller to the buyer for items or services that have been purchased.

network place.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A folder on a Web server.

semantic validation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of confirming that the elements of an XML file are logically valid.

breakpoint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A location in a program at which execution is halted so that a programmer can examine the program's status, the contents of variables, and so on.

cash flow.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The amount of money coming into and going out of a company and the timing of these flows.

external database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu bên ngoài
external database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The source of the table that is to be linked or imported to the current database, or the destination of a table that is to be exported.

empty.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The state of an uninitialized Variant variable (which returns a VarType of 0).

currency.rule: Microsoft Terminology. warm standby server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standby server that contains a copy of a database that is asynchronously updated, and that can be brought online fairly quickly.

reference data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A member in a dimension in the context of a dimension table in a relational database.

file menu.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A common drop-down menu that includes commands for file operations, such as Open, Save, and Print.

message envelope.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The information contained in an email message that is required to send and deliver a message between messaging servers by using SMTP protocol commands. The message envelope contains the sender email address and the recipient email address information. Recipients never see the message envelope, because it is not part of the message content, and it is discarded when the message reaches its destination. The X.400 messaging standard equivalent to the message envelope is called the "P1 header." The message envelope is often referred to as the "P1 header."

line of business.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The type of enterprise in which businesses or organizations are engaged.

parent domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: For DNS and Active Directory, domains that are located in the namespace tree directly above other derivative domain names (child domains).

clock setting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The time to which a clock is set.

color wheel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows the user to select a group of colors that compliment each other well, by making one click on the wheel.

milestone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A point on the project schedule at which the project team assesses progress and quality, and reviews deviations in scope and specifications. External milestones or major milestones typically occur at the end of major phases of work and are associated with the completion of major deliverables. External milestones are the points where the team and customer review work to date and agree to proceed with the project, appear as a task with a duration of zero work units, and are exposed on customer reports.

flowchart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphic map that can document procedures, analyze processes, indicate work or information flow, or track cost and efficiency.

topology.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directed acyclic graph in Apache Storm that defines how data flows between spouts and bolts.
