time formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An expression that is created following the Simple Time Period Syntax. It takes the form of a time unit plus or minus a whole number, such as Year-1 or Month-6. It is the formula that is applied when you are using time intelligence on a dashboard.

time intelligence filter.translation: bộ lọc điều khiển theo thời gian thông minh
time intelligence filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dynamic dashboard filter that can be linked to scorecards and reports so that they will update automatically relative to the current time.

unattended service account.translation: tài khoản dịch vụ không được giám sát
unattended service account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The security account that is used when a data source is configured to connect as a single shared identity for all users.

sharepoint list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A site element that stores and displays a collection of data that team members and other site users can share.

swash.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A decorative glyph that uses elaborate ornamentation often associated with calligraphy.

garbage collection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process for automatic recovery of heap memory. Blocks of memory that had been allocated but are no longer in use are freed, and blocks of memory still in use may be moved to consolidate the free memory into larger blocks.

gc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process for automatic recovery of heap memory. Blocks of memory that had been allocated but are no longer in use are freed, and blocks of memory still in use may be moved to consolidate the free memory into larger blocks.

machine.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer, either physical or virtual, capable of processing information to produce a desired result.

authoritative server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to, or characteristic of, a DNS server that hosts a primary or secondary copy of a DNS zone. When a DNS server is configured to host a zone, it is said to be authoritative for names within that zone.

infinite loop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A loop that is intentionally written with no explicit termination condition but will terminate as a result of side effects or direct intervention.

custom recipient.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Exchange 5.5 and earlier, a custom recipient is a user who is not hosted by Exchange. In Exchange 2003, such users can be added to Active Directory as contacts, Windows users, or users whose Windows accounts are disabled. In any case, they are mail-enabled, but not mailbox-enabled, because their mailboxes are hosted on another messaging system.

web request throttling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that offers improved reliability by throttling client requests and notifying SharePoint administrators when performance is in jeopardy. It monitors parameters such as available memory, number of requests in the queue, and wait times, and rejects incoming requests if performance values cross predefined thresholds.

claims-based identity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique identifier that represents a specific user, application, computer, or other entity, enabling it to gain access to multiple resources, such as applications and network resources, without entering credentials multiple times. It also enables resources to validate requests from an entity.

claims identity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique identifier that represents a specific user, application, computer, or other entity, enabling it to gain access to multiple resources, such as applications and network resources, without entering credentials multiple times. It also enables resources to validate requests from an entity.

integration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A calculation of a numerical value of a definite integral.

intermediate language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer language used as an intermediate step between the original source language, usually a high-level language, and the target language, usually machine code. Some high-level compilers use assembly language as an intermediate language.

il.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer language used as an intermediate step between the original source language, usually a high-level language, and the target language, usually machine code. Some high-level compilers use assembly language as an intermediate language.

custom calculation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of summarizing values in the data area of a PivotTable report by using the values in other cells in the data area. Use the Show data as list on the PivotTable Field dialog for a data field to create custom calculations.

microsoft office fluent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Characterized by design and functional elements introduced in the 2007 Microsoft Office suite user interface.

office fluent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Characterized by design and functional elements introduced in the 2007 Microsoft Office suite user interface.

fluent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft design language developed in 2017 that contains a set of UWP features and guidelines for creating UWP apps that perform beautifully across devices, inputs, and dimensions. The guidelines are divided into several categories: layout, style, controls, input and devices, and usability.

locked file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file on which one or more of the usual types of manipulative operation cannot be performed: typically, one that cannot be altered by additions or deletions.

enterprise wiki.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A wiki that allows people across a company or organization to capture and share knowledge using a solution that is integrated into and enhanced by their SharePoint environment.

full-height number.translation: số có chiều cao đầy đủ
full-height number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number represented in a style where all numeric glyphs are the same height and position and do not extend below the baseline.

uppercase number.translation: số có chiều cao đầy đủ
uppercase number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number represented in a style where all numeric glyphs are the same height and position and do not extend below the baseline.

design accents.translation: Bộ sưu tập các Điểm nhấn Thiết kế
design accents.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gallery of design elements that can be used to embellish publications.

embedded video clip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A video clip that has been inserted into another file or Web page.

embedded audio clip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An audio clip that has been inserted into another file or Web page.

list relationships.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that supports referential integrity between two lists via the lookup field.

feature upgrade.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows IT pros and developers to upgrade features such as UI, lists, content types, actions, and workflows.

qualified component.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of identifying a component in an MSI database indirectly by a pair "component category GUID, string qualifier" instead of identifying it directly by the component identifier.

tab control.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard control that resembles a notebook and lets the user navigate different sections of information without leaving the current element on the screen.

multiplier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In arithmetic, the number that indicates how many times another number (the multiplicand) is multiplied.

browser-compatible mode.translation: chế độ tương thích với trình duyệt
browser-compatible mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mode that displays the necessary ribbons, tools and functionality so that the resulting application is Web-compatible.

factor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To factor a number means to break it up into numbers that can be multiplied together to get the original number. EXAMPLES: 6 = 3 x 2 so, factors of 6 are 3 and 2; 9 = 3 x 3 so, factors of 9 are 3 and 3.

interprocess communication.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of one task or process to communicate with another in a multitasking operating system. Common methods include pipes, semaphores, shared memory, queues, signals, and mailboxes.

ipc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft technology that is implemented by Azure Rights Management service through a set of methods and capabilities to control how data is used and distributed beyond the use of simple access control and prevent accidental and unauthorized distribution of sensitive information.

family member.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An account holder who is a parent or a child.

add.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To combine thereby increasing the quantity or size of something.

manage.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of Copilot prompts that enables users to reduce repetitive setup tasks by allowing them to set defaults in applications.

search box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A text box in which someone types words to begin a search.

range name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A name assigned to a cell or group of cells.

tab page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of a tab control that consists of the tab UI element and the display area, which acts as a container for data or other controls, such as text boxes, combo boxes, and command buttons.

popular queries report.translation: Báo cáo Truy vấn Phổ biến
popular queries report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web analytics report that provides information on the most popular searches.

number of queries report.translation: Số lượng báo cáo Truy vấn
number of queries report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web analytics report that provides information on the number searches performed.

storage usage report.translation: Báo cáo Sử dụng Bộ nhớ
storage usage report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web analytics report that provides information about storage usage trends.

resource throttling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A resource management method that prevents an application from overshooting its allocated budget of computer resources, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network I/O.

page performance console.translation: Bảng điều khiển Hiệu suất Trang
page performance console.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A troubleshooting tool used for per-page performance testing.

user solution packaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An approach that packages together all content deployable to SharePoint -- list templates, list instance, site template, files and declarative workflows.

joint list view.translation: Dạng xem Danh sách Liên kết
joint list view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows a view to be created from multiple lists of stored data.

list style.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A combination of list formatting options identified by a style name.

planar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In computer graphics, lying within a plane.

online storage.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Storage space provided over the Internet that's allotted to users for keeping digital information, such as photos or documents.

live mesh.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A “software-plus-services” platform and experience that enables PCs and other devices to “come alive” by making them aware of each other through the Internet, enabling individuals and organizations to manage, access, and share their files and applications seamlessly on the Web and across their world of devices.

windows live mesh.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A “software-plus-services” platform and experience that enables PCs and other devices to “come alive” by making them aware of each other through the Internet, enabling individuals and organizations to manage, access, and share their files and applications seamlessly on the Web and across their world of devices.

data model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of related object types, operators, and integrity rules that form the abstract entity supported by a database management system (DBMS). Thus, one speaks of a relational DBMS, a network DBMS, and so on, depending on the type of data model a DBMS supports. In general, a DBMS supports only one data model as a practical rather than a theoretical restriction.

search key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The value that is to be searched for in a document or any collection of data.

spindle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any drive included within the chassis of a laptop or other portable computer. A laptop including a floppy disk drive and a hard drive would be considered a two-spindle machine.

tick.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A regular, rapidly recurring signal emitted by a clocking circuit.

trunk.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In communications, a channel connecting two switching stations. A trunk usually carries a large number of calls at the same time.

voice trunk.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In communications, a channel connecting two switching stations. A trunk usually carries a large number of calls at the same time.

margin guide.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the layout guides on the top, bottom, left, and right sides of a page that is used to define its margins.

bevel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A three-dimensional edge effect that is applied to the border of an object.

temporary memory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any temporary storage space used within or in conjunction with a computer, such as RAM or a USB flash drive.

memory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature of the Calculator app that allows the user to store a figure for use in future calculations.

single-user computer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A microcomputer designed for use by one person at a time. Personal computers do not need to share the processing, disk, and printer resources of another computer.

pc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A microcomputer designed for use by one person at a time. Personal computers do not need to share the processing, disk, and printer resources of another computer.

personal computer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A microcomputer designed for use by one person at a time. Personal computers do not need to share the processing, disk, and printer resources of another computer.

overlay.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UI or media segment that can display on top of or play concurrently with another UI or media segment.

relative date.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A range of dates that is specified by using comparison operators and return data for a range of dates.

workstation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A high-performance computer designed for professional work.

wish list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: On retailer websites, a collection of desired products or items a customer saves to their user account for future reference.

edgesync.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of processes that are run on the Exchange Server 2007 Hub Transport server role to establish one-way replication of recipient and configuration information from the Active Directory directory service to the Active Directory Application Mode (ADAM) instance on a computer that has the Edge Transport server role installed. EdgeSync copies only the information that is required for the Edge Transport server to perform anti-spam and message security configuration tasks, and information about the Send connector configuration that is required to enable mail flow from the Exchange 2007 organization's Hub Transport servers to the Internet through one or more Edge Transport servers. EdgeSync performs scheduled updates so that the information in ADAM remains current.

middleware.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Software that provides a common application programming interface (API). Applications written using that API will run in the same computer systems as the middleware.

simplex.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Communication that takes place only from sender to receiver.

spx.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Communication that takes place only from sender to receiver.

battery level.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The amount of battery power left on the system.

battery charge.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The amount of battery power left on the system.

recover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To put back into a stable condition. A computer user may be able to recover lost or damaged data by using a program to search for and salvage whatever information remains in storage. A database may be recovered by restoring its integrity after some problem has damaged it, such as abnormal termination of the database management program.

redraw.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To retrace a video screen at frequent intervals, even if the image does not change, so as to keep the phosphors irradiated.

service quality metrics.translation: số liệu chất lượng dịch vụ
service quality metrics.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of statistics that indicates the degree to which a service meets performance, usage, and other demands for the service.

code access security (cas) policy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of rules that defines security permissions for a collection of assemblies by associating attributes of those assemblies, such as location and signature, with a set of code access security permissions.

cas policy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of rules that defines security permissions for a collection of assemblies by associating attributes of those assemblies, such as location and signature, with a set of code access security permissions.

code access security policy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of rules that defines security permissions for a collection of assemblies by associating attributes of those assemblies, such as location and signature, with a set of code access security permissions.

partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A section of space on a physical disk that functions as if it were a separate disk.

diagnostic provider.translation: công cụ cung cấp chẩn đoán
diagnostic provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component that monitors and collects statistics about a system. Those statistics can be compared to a set of thresholds to assess system performance, identify and resolve problems, and perform other diagnostic and administrative tasks.

activity feed.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A continuously supplied summary of activity.

newsfeed.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Deliveries, exchanges, or distributions of newsgroup articles to and from news servers. Newsfeeds are accomplished through cooperating news servers, which communicate via NNTP through network connections.

xbox activity feed.translation: nguồn cấp dữ liệu hoạt động
xbox activity feed.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feed that provides users with information, notifications and updates based on people, documents, and tags they are following.

asynchronous event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event whose handler runs in a different processing thread from the action that raised the event. The event handler and the action are processed simultaneously.

synchronous event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event whose handler runs in the same processing thread as the action that raised the event. The action cannot continue until processing is complete for the event handler.

after event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An asynchronous event whose handler runs only after the action that raised the event is complete.

post-event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An asynchronous event whose handler runs only after the action that raised the event is complete.

before event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A synchronous event whose handler runs completely before the action that raised the event starts.

pre-event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A synchronous event whose handler runs completely before the action that raised the event starts.

application map.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mapping between file name extensions and HTTP request handlers that enables Web hosting applications to determine which handler responds to requests for specific types of files.

bookmarklet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A script-based applet that is stored as a favorite or bookmark in a web browser, or is accessed through a hyperlink on a webpage.

feature stapling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of associating a feature with a site definition, without modifying the site definition itself or using code routines. The associated feature is added automatically to new sites that are based on that site definition.

stapling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of associating a feature with a site definition, without modifying the site definition itself or using code routines. The associated feature is added automatically to new sites that are based on that site definition.

health status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of statistics that indicates the degree to which a computer, server farm, or server cluster meets security, capacity, performance, usage, and other demands.

alternate key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A candidate key that is not designated as the primary key and is used to uniquely identify records in a database table.

inheritance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The transfer of certain properties, such as open files, from a parent program or process to another program or process that the parent causes to run.

rich-text editor.translation: trình soạn thảo văn bản đa dạng thức
rich-text editor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A text-editing program that lets users create instant messages or blog posts that contain rich text elements, such as text formatting and embedded images.

report abuse.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The link to the form where a user can report violations of the terms of use. Contextually, it's understood that the abuse in question is poor conduct, such as obscene language or threats.

code of conduct.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The link to the code of conduct, which contains rules that explain how someone should behave while using a service or product.

update rollup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tested, cumulative set of hotfixes, security updates, critical updates, and updates packaged together for easy deployment. A rollup generally targets a specific area, such as security, or component of a product, such as Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS).

authorization code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A code that grants rights to an individual, for example to use a system or access stored data.

highlight viewer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An available button for Windows Live Toolbar that highlights, in color, search words on the search results page. It also highlights the search words on the websites included in the search results.

database mirroring.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software solution that increases database availability by transferring logs from the principal database to the mirror database continuously.

mirroring.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software solution that increases database availability by transferring logs from the principal database to the mirror database continuously.

office 365 admin center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The web portal from which each company’s service administrator can manage user accounts and settings for each of the Office 365 services to which they subscribe.

delegate control.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control on a page or master page that can be replaced with another control or content.

editor part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control that can be used to set the properties for and to manipulate Web Parts on a Web Parts page.

feature activation dependency.translation: phụ thuộc kích hoạt tính năng
feature activation dependency.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A relationship in which a feature is activated automatically when another feature is activated or a feature must be activated manually before another feature can be activated.

javascript object notation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text-based, data interchange format that is used to transmit structured data, typically in Ajax Web applications.

json.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text-based, data interchange format that is used to transmit structured data, typically in Ajax Web applications.

privileged task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operation that requires more resources than are allowed by a threshold, based on the number of items or amount of information that is processed during the operation.

page output cache.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special storage location of templatized pages for performance enhancement.

expiration date.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The date after which information or a resource is no longer valid.

resource-intensive task.translation: nhiệm vụ cần tài nguyên chuyên sâu
resource-intensive task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process, thread, or set of related processes or threads that requires significant system resources or time, or requires exclusive access to large amounts of data.

workflow foundation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An extensible programming model and components that can be used to design and implement custom applications for common business processes, such as document approval. Components include version control, tracking, and reporting.

client context.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The object that is used to initiate any actions with the client-side object model. It is the primary entry point for the client object model, and the primary object for coordinating requests against corresponding objects in a site collection.

connector framework.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software component that can be used to connect to a data source, and index and include data from that source in search results.

feature event receiver.translation: bộ nhận sự kiện tính năng
feature event receiver.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server-side code routine that is called when a feature is activated, deactivated, installed, uninstalled, or upgraded on a computer, server farm, or server cluster.

health tracking indicator.translation: chỉ số theo dõi tình trạng thích ứng
health tracking indicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A statistic that indicates the degree to which a computer, server farm, or server cluster meets a specific demand for that configuration. It also indicates which log information to copy to a central location for review.

item-based content type.translation: loại nội dung dựa trên mục
item-based content type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A content type that inherits settings from a base content type that was designed for any type of SharePoint list item.

document-based content type.translation: loại nội dung dựa trên tài liệu
document-based content type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A content type that inherits settings from a base content type that was designed for document libraries.

sandboxed solution.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom solution that can be deployed to a site by a site collection administrator, without approval from the farm administrator. Without that approval, the solution has full access to the immediate site and restricted access to system resources and other sites.

job definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A persistent container that defines and stores instructions for a job to be run on a server, server farm, or server cluster. To run, a job must have an associated job definition, and a definition must be associated with a service or a Web application.

timer account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dedicated, administrator-level user account that performs scheduled administrative tasks.

solution package.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A compressed file that can be deployed to a server farm or a site. It can contain assemblies, resource files, site and feature definitions, templates, code access security policies, and Web Parts.

social tag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom keyword or description and shortcut to a Web page or item on a SharePoint site or the Internet. All of these tags can be viewed, managed, and shared by using My Site.

social data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of features that can be used to store and share comments, shortcuts, descriptions, and other information about Web pages and items on a SharePoint site or the Internet.

service window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reserved time for performing administrative tasks on a computer, server farm, or server cluster.

query-size threshold.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An administrative setting that limits the number of query results for SharePoint lists, sites, and site collections that contain a large number of items.

note board.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An area for storing comments about a Web page. A note board can appear on a Web page or in a separate dialog box. The notes can be viewed, managed, and shared by using My Site.

logging database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu ký sự
logging database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft SQL Server, MSDE, or WMSDE database that stores health monitoring and usage data temporarily, and can be used for reporting and diagnostics.

quality-of-service indicator.translation: chỉ báo chất lượng dịch vụ
quality-of-service indicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A statistic that indicates the degree to which a computer, server farm, or server cluster meets usage demands for that configuration.

windows live installer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The software that installs the Windows Live software someone selects on the installation webpage.

windows live home.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The main landing or start page on Windows Live.

phone call.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A function that enables a user to make a call to a phone, as opposed to calling another computer or using a webcam.

color scheme.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A predefined set of harmonized colors that you can apply to text and objects. Text and objects with an applied scheme color will change automatically when you switch to a new color scheme or modify the current color scheme.

bridge.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device that connects networks using the same communications protocols so that information can be passed from one to the other.

application library caching.translation: lưu trữ đệm thư viện ứng dụng
application library caching.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, a feature that enables applications to use external library assemblies retrieved from the server or from the local browser cache.

application extension services.translation: các dịch vụ mở rộng ứng dụng
application extension services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, classes that extend the application model by providing services that can participate in the application life cycle.

pantone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A widely-used color-matching system that defines hundreds of spot-color inks or process colors made up of CMYK inks.

local messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, a feature that enables communication between two Silverlight-based applications running on the same computer.

out-of-browser.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to, or characteristic of, a Silverlight-based application that a user installs from a Web page and runs outside the browser.

search button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The button next to a search box that someone clicks to search for something.

search preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that displays a thumbnail preview next to each search result. Pointing to the preview enlarges it.

filtered view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view to which a set of conditions have been applied to reduce the total number of displayed objects.

secure store service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The shared service that securely stores credential sets for external data sources and associates those credential sets to identities of individuals or to group identities. This service can be used to support a variety of solutions. For example, the stored credentials can be leveraged by certain applications to enable single sign-on.

sss.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The shared service that securely stores credential sets for external data sources and associates those credential sets to identities of individuals or to group identities. This service can be used to support a variety of solutions. For example, the stored credentials can be leveraged by certain applications to enable single sign-on.

secure store.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The shared service that securely stores credential sets for external data sources and associates those credential sets to identities of individuals or to group identities. This service can be used to support a variety of solutions. For example, the stored credentials can be leveraged by certain applications to enable single sign-on.

unpublish.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To remove an item from public view.

external content type designer.translation: Trình thiết kế Loại Nội dung Bên ngoài
external content type designer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A modeling tool in SharePoint Designer that enables users to create external content types, external lists and forms without writing code.

social feedback.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Feedback about any content, page, or site that is provided using social bookmarks, tags or comments.

sharepoint web analytics.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of features that provides data analysis and reporting on Web traffic, search, and SharePoint assets. This information can be used to tailor systems to meet users’ needs, optimize how they use and discover information, and to create targeted content.

web analytics.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of features that provides data analysis and reporting on Web traffic, search, and SharePoint assets. This information can be used to tailor systems to meet users’ needs, optimize how they use and discover information, and to create targeted content.

text telephony.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables those who are deaf or speech impaired to use the telephone with a teletypewriter.

latest version.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The most recent or current version of a software release.

service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An activity, such as consulting or design, performed for sale or purchase by one or more resources.

repo.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A central storage location that stores specific data, such as files under source control, container images, and so on.

appear offline.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status that a user can select while signed in to make it appear to as if he/she were Offline.

nesting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The enclosure of one file, list item, loop, formula, etc. within another.

.csv.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The file name extension of a comma-delimited text file.

.dll.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The file name extension of a dynamic-link library.

application life cycle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The stages an application used in an organization goes through: deployable, installable, executable, and executing.

msn mobile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: MSN optimized for mobile devices. The layout and the links are specially crafted to display well on small displays.

.zip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The file name extension of a compressed archive file encoded in ZIP format, as by PKZIP.
