regressor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An input variable that has a linear relationship with the output variable.

microsoft word 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2010 edition of the Microsoft word processing software for creating Web, email, and print documents.

microsoft word home and student 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2010 edition of the Microsoft word processing software program for creating Web, email, and print documents, designed for home and students.

word home and student 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2010 edition of the Microsoft word processing software program for creating Web, email, and print documents, designed for home and students.

microsoft word mobile 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2010 edition of the Microsoft word processing software for creating Web, email, and print documents, designed for use with handheld computing devices.

word mobile 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2010 edition of the Microsoft word processing software for creating Web, email, and print documents, designed for use with handheld computing devices.

cyclic protection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of protection between two DPM servers where each server protects the data on the other.

sql server utility viewpoints.translation: Điểm xem Tiện ích SQL Server
sql server utility viewpoints.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of SQL Server Utility that provides administrators a holistic view of resource health through an instance of SQL Server that serves as a utility control point (UCP).

replication management objects.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed code assembly that encapsulates replication functionalities for SQL Server.

rmo.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed code assembly that encapsulates replication functionalities for SQL Server.

sweep angle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The number of degrees, between 0 and 360 that the scale will sweep in a circle. A sweep angle of 360 degrees produces a scale that is a complete circle.

active directory management agent.translation: Tác nhân Quản lý Active Directory
active directory management agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Identity Lifecycle Manager management agent provided by Microsoft to connect to Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) or Active Directory directory service.

adma.translation: Tác nhân Quản lý Active Directory
adma.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Identity Lifecycle Manager management agent provided by Microsoft to connect to Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) or Active Directory directory service.

scale-out deployment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A deployment model in which an installation configuration has multiple report server instances sharing a single report server database.

virtual shared folder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mailbox folder structure on some IMAP servers in which mail folders are accessed with the administrator username and password, and shell login access to the mail server is not allowed. Access to specific mailboxes is managed by access control lists. This means that users are assigned the permissions to only access their mailbox folder, while an administrator has access to all mailboxes. This allows organizations to use administrative credentials to migrate email from an IMAP server to Outlook Live.

register.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To provide your name and contact information to an organization so that you can receive product information, updates, and special offers.

photo fuse.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Photo Gallery feature that replaces a section of one photo with a similar section of another, providing there are areas of overlap in both. For example, if someone has two photos of a group of people, and in Photo 1 everyone is smiling but one person has their eyes closed, they can include the section of Photo 2 where that person has their eyes open.

microsoft dynamics crm for microsoft off.translation: Microsoft Dynamics CRM dành cho Microsoft Office Outlook
microsoft dynamics crm for microsoft off.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The desktop client version of the Microsoft Dynamics CRM product suite for Microsoft Office Outlook.

microsoft dynamics crm for microsoft off.translation: Microsoft Dynamics CRM dành cho Microsoft Office Outlook có Quyền truy cập Ngoại tuyến
microsoft dynamics crm for microsoft off.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The laptop client version of the Microsoft Dynamics CRM product suite for Microsoft Office Outlook.

integer data type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A fundamental data type that holds integers. An Integer variable is stored as a 16-bit (2-byte) number ranging in value from -32,768 to 32,767.

evict.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To place a windows Live ID in a forced rename state, while the Windows Live ID and all of its existing settings, including the password, Xbox Live points, or Zune points are preserved. The user can sign in using the Windows Live ID and its password, but they're immediately asked to rename the Windows Live ID. They must specify an email address that's outside the Outlook Live domain.

sandboxed code service.translation: Microsoft SharePoint Foundation Sandboxed Code Service
sandboxed code service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The service in Microsoft Sharepoint Foundation that needs to be started to allow for a sandboxed solution to be deployed.

microsoft sharepoint foundation sandboxe.translation: Microsoft SharePoint Foundation Sandboxed Code Service
microsoft sharepoint foundation sandboxe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The service in Microsoft Sharepoint Foundation that needs to be started to allow for a sandboxed solution to be deployed.

hard error.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An error that causes the system or a program to fail abruptly with no hope of recovery. An example of a fatal error is an uncaught exception that cannot be handled.

fatal error.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An error that causes the system or a program to fail abruptly with no hope of recovery. An example of a fatal error is an uncaught exception that cannot be handled.

unrecoverable error.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An error that causes the system or a program to fail abruptly with no hope of recovery. An example of a fatal error is an uncaught exception that cannot be handled.

catastrophic error.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An error that causes the system or a program to fail abruptly with no hope of recovery. An example of a fatal error is an uncaught exception that cannot be handled.

record status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The condition, at a particular time, of a record.

workflow status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The condition, at a particular time, of a workflow.

bing bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A toolbar including the Bing search box installed for the variety of common-used browsers, like Internet Explorer, Firefox, etc.

heat map.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphical representation of data where the intensity of color corresponds to the related analytical data. For example, low values in a range appear as blue (cold) and high values as red (hot).

heatmap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphical representation of data where the intensity of color corresponds to the related analytical data. For example, low values in a range appear as blue (cold) and high values as red (hot).

victim.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The longest running transaction that has not generated row versions when tempdb runs out of space and the Database Engine forces the version stores to shrink. A message 3967 is generated in the error log for each victim transaction. If a transaction is marked as a victim, it can no longer read the row versions in the version store.

itanium.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Intel microprocessor that uses explicitly parallel instruction set computing and 64-bit memory addressing. "Itanium-based" refers to systems or platforms that are based on the Itanium processor. "Itanium2-based" refers to systems or platforms that are based on the Itanium2 processor. "Itanium architecture-based" refers to systems or platforms that are based on the Itanium and Itanium2 processors.

social network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An online community where members can virtually socialize by posting and commenting on a newsfeed, by chatting, and by sharing photos, images, articles, and other content.

network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of devices that communicate either wirelessly or via a physical connection.

manage relationships.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UI element that enables a user to view, delete or create new relationships in a model.

technology adoption program.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft program designed to provide a consistent experience for Microsoft partners to obtain real-world customer feedback on Microsoft pre-release products.

abstract.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A short summary of the contents of a document that gives the reader a quick overview of its topic and purpose.

object cache.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cache that is used internally to optimize page rendering by storing properties of sites, page layouts, and pages. It reduces the amount of traffic between the Web server and a SQL database. This results in higher throughput of rendered pages, thereby increasing the number of pages that can be delivered to clients.

record type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The representation of all the instances of a particular record. When changes are made to a record type, those changes will affect all individual records of that type.

module-level variable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A variable that's declared in the Declarations section of a module by using the Private keyword. These variables are available to all procedures in the module.

html bridge.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, an integrated set of types and methods that enable you to expose managed types to JavaScript and call JavaScript event handlers from managed types.

deep zoom.translation: Phóng to Thu nhỏ theo Chiều sâu
deep zoom.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, a technology that enables users to interactively view high-resolution images. With Deep Zoom, users can zoom in, zoom out, and pan images rapidly.

trusted application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, an out-of-browser application to which a user grants elevated trust upon installation, providing greater access to the local system.

sandboxed application.translation: ứng dụng chạy trong hộp cát
sandboxed application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, an in-browser application or an out-of-browser application that has not been granted elevated trust.

elevated trust.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Silverlight, a security level that gives out-of-browser applications greater access to the local system.

recursive hierarchy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hierarchy of data in which all parent-child relationships are represented in the data.

compute.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The family of compute services in Microsoft Azure.

radius.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The proposed Internet protocol in which an authentication server provides authorization and authentication information to a network server to which a user is attempting to link.

remote authentication dial-in user servi.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The proposed Internet protocol in which an authentication server provides authorization and authentication information to a network server to which a user is attempting to link.

consolidate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To merge information from multiple places into one.

visio graphics service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft SharePoint Server 2010 service application that allows users to share and view Visio web drawings using Visio Services. The service application also enables data-connected Microsoft Visio 2010 web drawings to be refreshed and updated from a variety of data sources.

visio web access.translation: Phần Web Truy cập Web Visio
visio web access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part that enables users to view (in full fidelity) and share Visio files in SharePoint Server without having the Visio client installed.

visio web access web part.translation: Phần Web Truy cập Web Visio
visio web access web part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part that enables users to view (in full fidelity) and share Visio files in SharePoint Server without having the Visio client installed.

outlook social connector.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of features that incorporates elements of social networking into the Outlook experience. It provides relevant contextual information about the people whom users interact with in Outlook, based on local data (email and calendar items) and social activity (news feeds and status updates).

osc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of features that incorporates elements of social networking into the Outlook experience. It provides relevant contextual information about the people whom users interact with in Outlook, based on local data (email and calendar items) and social activity (news feeds and status updates).

people pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane in Outlook that displays a selected contact along with relevant information (photos, status messages or feeds, calendar items, etc.) from Outlook and other networks.

gallery view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view that displays a profile photo of everyone who is part of an email thread or calendar item.

character set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of characters that have some relationship in common.

charset.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of characters that have some relationship in common.

hierarchical address book.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Outlook that allows members of an organization to be displayed in a tree view control, grouped by department.

hab.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Outlook that allows members of an organization to be displayed in a tree view control, grouped by department.

log shipping job.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A job performing one of the following log-shipping operations: backing up the transaction log of the primary database at the primary server (the backup job), copying the transaction log file to a secondary server (the copy job), or restoring the log backup to the secondary database on a secondary server (the restore job). The backup job resides on the primary server; the copy and restore jobs reside on each of the secondary servers. See also: primary database, primary server, secondary database, secondary server.

download-only article.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An article in a merge publication that can be updated only at the Publisher or at a Subscriber that uses a server subscription.

skiplisting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of bypassing the connecting IP address in the mail header for the purposes of assessing the likelihood that the message is spam and instead inspecting the previous IP address listed in the header.

external url mapping.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A URL mapping for objects that are not part of the WSS system.

sparse column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A column that reduces the storage requirement for null values at the cost of more overhead to retrieve nonnull values.

column set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An untyped XML representation that combines all the sparse columns of a table into a structured output.

microsoft visual studio tools for applic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The family of Microsoft Visual Studio add-in software that allows developers to use Visual Basic and Visual C# to develop and customize applications built on the Microsoft .NET Framework.

visual studio tools for applications.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The family of Microsoft Visual Studio add-in software that allows developers to use Visual Basic and Visual C# to develop and customize applications built on the Microsoft .NET Framework.

vsta.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The family of Microsoft Visual Studio add-in software that allows developers to use Visual Basic and Visual C# to develop and customize applications built on the Microsoft .NET Framework.

data profile viewer.translation: Trình xem Hồ sơ Dữ liệu
data profile viewer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A stand-alone utility that displays the profile output in both summary and detail format with optional drilldown capability.

execute package utility.translation: Tiện ích Gói Thực thi SQL Server
execute package utility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphical user interface that is used to run a Integration Services package.

sql server execute package utility.translation: Tiện ích Gói Thực thi SQL Server
sql server execute package utility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphical user interface that is used to run a Integration Services package.

column pattern profile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report containing a set of regular expressions that cover the specified percentage of values in a string column.

query designer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that helps a user create the query command that specifies the data the user wants in a report dataset.

conferencing announcement service.translation: Ứng dụng Thông báo về hội thảo
conferencing announcement service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unified communications application that plays tones and prompts users on certain actions when dialing into a conference.

conferencing announcement application.translation: Ứng dụng Thông báo về hội thảo
conferencing announcement application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unified communications application that plays tones and prompts users on certain actions when dialing into a conference.

conferencing announcement.translation: Ứng dụng Thông báo về hội thảo
conferencing announcement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unified communications application that plays tones and prompts users on certain actions when dialing into a conference.

session border controller.translation: Bộ điều khiển vùng biên theo phiên
session border controller.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that manages VoIP traffic in much the same way that a NAT or firewall manages generic IP traffic. The service usually runs on a computer that is located outside the firewall and primary NAT.

sbc.translation: Bộ điều khiển vùng biên theo phiên
sbc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that manages VoIP traffic in much the same way that a NAT or firewall manages generic IP traffic. The service usually runs on a computer that is located outside the firewall and primary NAT.

multiple points of presence.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of a single user to sign in to a Lync Server or Office Communications Server server with multiple clients.

mpop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of a single user to sign in to a Lync Server or Office Communications Server server with multiple clients.

measurement converter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An action that can be enabled to identify and provide conversions for international units of measurement.

needle cap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the two appearance properties that can be applied to a radial gauge.

dynamic routing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Routing that adjusts automatically to the current conditions of a network. Dynamic routing typically uses one of several dynamic-routing protocols such as Routing Information Protocol (RIP) and Border Gateway Protocol (BGP). Compare static routing.

adaptive routing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Routing that adjusts automatically to the current conditions of a network. Dynamic routing typically uses one of several dynamic-routing protocols such as Routing Information Protocol (RIP) and Border Gateway Protocol (BGP). Compare static routing.

undo file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that saves the content of the pages in a database after they've been modified by uncommitted, rolled back transactions and before recovery restores them to their previous state. The undo file prevents the changes performed by uncommitted transactions from being lost.

event routing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows Presentation Foundation and Silverlight, the movement of an event in a tree of elements. There are three types of event routing: direct, bubbling, and tunneling. With direct routing, the event does not move in the tree. With bubbling, the event moves up to the top of the tree. With tunneling, the event starts at the top of the tree and moves down to the source of the event. In Silverlight,  event routing and routed events are used, but tunneling is not implemented.

edge event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event whose event payload is valid for a given interval; however, only the start time is known upon arrival to the CEP server. The valid end time of the event is provided later in a separate edge event.

point event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event occurrence as of a single point in time. Only the start time is required for the event. The CEP server infers the valid end time by adding a tick (the smallest unit of time in the underlying time data type) to the start time to set the valid time interval for the event. Point events are valid only for this single instant of time.

hopping window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of window in which consecutive windows "hop" forward in time by a fixed period. The window is defined by two time spans: the period P and the window length L. For every P time unit a new window of size L is created.

tumbling window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hopping window whose hop size is equal to the window size.

software transformer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software module or routine that modifies the events (data) into a format expected by the output device, and emits the data to that device.

refiner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An advanced feature that enables a user to apply filters on properties such as people, folder, and attachments.

visual best bet.translation: Lựa chọn Trực quan Tốt nhất
visual best bet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Best Bet that can contain rich visual data, such as a video, image, or piece of HTML code, in addition to text or links.

social rating synchronization job.translation: Công việc Đồng bộ hóa Xếp hạng Xã hội
social rating synchronization job.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A timer job that synchronizes rating values between the social database and content database.

enable referential integrity.translation: Bật Tính toàn vẹn Tham chiếu
enable referential integrity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A property that enables referential integrity.

pipebind.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special object that is unique to Windows PowerShell for SharePoint and provides a second layer of specialized parameter sets that are optimized for SharePoint Foundation.

pipebind object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special object that is unique to Windows PowerShell for SharePoint and provides a second layer of specialized parameter sets that are optimized for SharePoint Foundation.

search application topology.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A section in the search administration page.

search topology.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The architecture of a search system.

dual chinese search.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A search feature that allows a user to query on a word in Simplified Chinese and have results returned for that word and also for the same word in Traditional Chinese, or vice versa.

social database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu xã hội
social database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that is used to store social tagging information for a user, i.e. Social Comment or Social Tag or Social Rating.

orphaned term.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A term that was reused and whose source term was deleted.

interval event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event whose payload is valid for a given period of time. The metadata of the interval event requires that both the start and end time of the interval be provided in the event metadata. Interval events are valid only for this specific interval.

excel web services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Excel Services component that provides programmatic access to its Web service.

overprint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To print an element of one color over one of another color without removing, or knocking out, the material underneath.

wall-time.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The total time taken by a computer to complete a task which is the sum of CPU time, I/O time, and the communication channel delay.

webmaster tools.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of tools that is used to troubleshoot the crawling and indexing of Web sites.

query binder.translation: đối tượng liên kết truy vấn
query binder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that binds an existing StreamInsight query template to specific input and output adapters.

mailing list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list of names and email addresses that are grouped under a single name.

vertical scroll bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The vertical bar at the right of a window that users can click to move through a document.

vertical scrollbar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The vertical bar at the right of a window that users can click to move through a document.

application assemblies gallery.translation: Bộ sưu tập các Tập hợp Ứng dụng
application assemblies gallery.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The site collection level gallery containing the binary assemblies that are used by code method business data actions, or External Data Parts.

language service scanner.translation: trình quét dịch vụ ngôn ngữ
language service scanner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component that is used to identify types of tokens in source code. This information is used for syntax highlighting and for quickly identifying token types that can trigger other operations, for example, brace matching.

master data manager.translation: Trình quản lý Dữ liệu Chính
master data manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component of the Master Data Services application for managing and accessing master data.

database engine.translation: bộ máy cơ sở dữ liệu
database engine.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The program module or modules that provide access to a database management system (DBMS).

web resource.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Web content that can be stored on the server and executed in the browser.

language service parser.translation: trình phân tích cú pháp dịch vụ ngôn ngữ
language service parser.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component that is used to describe the functions and scope of the tokens in source code.

prepare.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of Copilot prompts that help users identify and focus on priorities.

call script.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dialog scenario to be used in a telephone interaction situation.

spreadsheet program.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application commonly used for budgets, forecasting, and other finance-related tasks that organizes data values using cells, where the relationships between cells are defined by formulas. A change to one cell produces changes to related cells. Spreadsheet programs usually provide graphing capabilities for output and a variety of formatting options for text, numeric values, and graph features.

spreadsheet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application commonly used for budgets, forecasting, and other finance-related tasks that organizes data values using cells, where the relationships between cells are defined by formulas. A change to one cell produces changes to related cells. Spreadsheet programs usually provide graphing capabilities for output and a variety of formatting options for text, numeric values, and graph features.

microsoft office 365 desktop setup.translation: Chương trình cài đặt cho máy tính sử dụng Microsoft Office 365
microsoft office 365 desktop setup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program that downloads and installs Microsoft updates that are recommended for users running Microsoft Online Services services.

opendocument presentation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A version of the OpenDocument Format (ODF) v1.1 file format for presentations.

visio workflow interchange.translation: Trao đổi Dòng công việc của Visio
visio workflow interchange.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file format that allows a file created in Visio to be loaded and displayed in SharePoint Designer.

interest rate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rate which defines the amount of money a borrower needs to pay a borrowee for borrowing money.

user profile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains configuration information for a specific user, such as desktop settings, persistent network connections, and application settings.

federated domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A domain that is engaged in a trust relationship with another domain, which is also called a federation. This relationship is between two federation servers, and allows a system to provide controlled access to its resources or services to a user that belongs to another security realm without requiring the user to authenticate directly to the system and without the two systems sharing a database of user identities or passwords.

trusted domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A domain that is engaged in a trust relationship with another domain, which is also called a federation. This relationship is between two federation servers, and allows a system to provide controlled access to its resources or services to a user that belongs to another security realm without requiring the user to authenticate directly to the system and without the two systems sharing a database of user identities or passwords.

srv record.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of data in the Internet Domain Name System that specifies information on available services. The SRV record is used to locate domain controllers for Active Directory.

service record.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category of data in the Internet Domain Name System that specifies information on available services. The SRV record is used to locate domain controllers for Active Directory.

term end date.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The date at the end of a subscription. For example, in Microsoft Online Services, there are a variety of services that a customer may subscribe to, and each subscription has its own term length (e.g., 6 months, 12 months) and term end date.

communications language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The language chosen by a company in which they want to receive email messages and other business communications from Microsoft.

partner id.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ID assigned to businesses when they sign up as partners in the Microsoft Partner Network. This ID is used by Microsoft and its customers to identify the correct partner.

reserved domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A domain that cannot be associated with a Windows Live ID.

email notification.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A message automatically generated by the occurrence of an event.

bulk add.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A procedure by which an administrator can add a group of users (or properties for users) to an account.

current conversation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A conversation that you are currently having, as opposed to a past conversation.

autoregressive integrated moving average.translation: trung bình trượt tích hợp tự hồi quy
autoregressive integrated moving average.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method for determining dependencies in observations taken sequentially in time, that also supports multiplicative seasonality.

arima.translation: trung bình trượt tích hợp tự hồi quy
arima.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method for determining dependencies in observations taken sequentially in time, that also supports multiplicative seasonality.

uml model diagram.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A visual model of a software system which is created using the Unified Modeling Language (UML).

plant layout.translation: bố trí mặt bằng sản xuất
plant layout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A detailed manufacturing plant design, including the building, machinery, storage, and shipping and receiving facilities.

commodity channel index formula.translation: công thức lập chỉ mục kênh hàng hóa
commodity channel index formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formula that calculates the mean deviation of the daily average price of a commodity from the moving average. A value above 100 indicates that the commodity is overbought, and a value below -100 indicates that the commodity is oversold.

cci formula.translation: công thức lập chỉ mục kênh hàng hóa
cci formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formula that calculates the mean deviation of the daily average price of a commodity from the moving average. A value above 100 indicates that the commodity is overbought, and a value below -100 indicates that the commodity is oversold.

step into.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To execute the current statement and enter Break mode, stepping into the next procedure whenever a call for another procedure is reached.

envelopes formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A financial formula that calculates "envelopes" above and below a moving average using a specified percentage as the shift. The envelopes indicator is used to create signals for buying and selling. You can specify the percentage the formula uses to calculate the envelopes.

manual failover.translation: chuyển đổi dự phòng thủ công
manual failover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a database mirroring session, a failover initiated by the database owner, while the principal server is still running, that transfers service from the principal database to the mirror database while they are in a synchronized state.

number scaling specifier.translation: bộ xác định chia tỷ lệ số
number scaling specifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ',' character that appears in a format string and specifies how a number will be formatted. Each time this character occurs in the format string, the number to be formatted is divided by a thousand. For example, if the format string "#,," is used to format the number 100 million, the output is 100.

syndication format.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A format used for publishing data on blogs and web sites.

bar pointer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pointer that is displayed as a bar, that is to which the bar type has been applied.

windows live hotmail plus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A premium subscription service that provides additional online storage for Hotmail messages, and the suppression of graphical ads within Hotmail.

print friendly.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to content, e.g. a web page or a screen, formatted for printing on a sheet of paper.

printer friendly.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to content, e.g. a web page or a screen, formatted for printing on a sheet of paper.

permanent time zone move mode.translation: Chế độ Chuyển Múi Giờ Vĩnh viễn
permanent time zone move mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A menu item which enables the user to permanently move a calendar to a different time zone.

memory clerk.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A memory management component that allocates memory.

runaway query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A query with an excessive running time, that can lead to a blocking problem. Runaway queries usually do not use use a query or lock time out.

contact group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of email addresses that is treated as a single recipient for email distribution purposes, and that is created by and available to an individual Outlook user.

artist.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A performer of a song or other audio recording.

off work.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status that indicates a user is not working but is on personal time.

from time.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A menu item in Microsoft Powerpoint which enables the user to start the sound at a certain point in its playing time.

fail over.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To switch processing from a failed component to its backup component.

custom volume.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A volume that is not in the DPM storage pool and is specified to store the replica and recovery points for a protection group member.

dpm client.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Data Protection Manager (DPM) Client enables the user to protect and recover their data as per the company protection policy configured by their backup administrator.

dpm management shell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The command shell, based on Windows PowerShell (Powershell.exe), that makes available the cmdlets that perform functions in Data Protection Manager.

dpm self-service recovery configuration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that enables DPM administrators to authorize end users to perform self-service recovery of data by creating and managing DPM roles (grouping of users, objects, and permissions).

ssrct.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that enables DPM administrators to authorize end users to perform self-service recovery of data by creating and managing DPM roles (grouping of users, objects, and permissions).

dpm self-service recovery tool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that is used by end users to recover backups from DPM, without any action required from the DPM administrator.

ssrt.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that is used by end users to recover backups from DPM, without any action required from the DPM administrator.

enterprise license.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A license that authorizes protection of both file and application resources on a single computer.

primary dpm server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A DPM server that protects file or application data sources.

protected computer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer that contains data sources that are protection group members.

protected member.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data source within a protection group.

secondary dpm server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A DPM server that protects one or more primary DPM servers in addition to file and application data.

suspect tape.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tape that has conflicting identification information, such as the barcode or the on-media identifier.

unknown tape.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Tape that has not been identified by the DPM server.

mic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The central pod with permissions to query the Kubernetes API server and checks for an Azure identity mapping that corresponds to a pod.

microphone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The microphone component of the Kinect sensor.

mike.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An electronic device that converts sound waves into electrical signals.

message bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A yellow bar with a warning icon appearing below the ribbon that provides information or alerts the user. Information can be security alerts, errors, or notifications.

exponential moving average.translation: trung bình di chuyển số mũ
exponential moving average.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A moving average of data that gives more weight to the more recent data in the period and less weight to the older data in the period. The formula applies weighting factors which decrease exponentially. The weighting for each older data point decreases exponentially, giving much more importance to recent observations while still not discarding older observations entirely.

installation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of adding software to a computer system.

binder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office program that you can use to organize related documents. You can check spelling, number pages consecutively across all documents in the binder, and print the documents.

powerpoint viewing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that enables viewing of PowerPoint documents from a Web browser.

application definition file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML file that fully describes a single Notification Services application. The ADF file contains the schemas for the events, subscriptions, and notifications; the rules for matching events with subscriptions; and may provide the name of the XSLT file used to format generated notifications.

global administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The unlimited administrator role that can manage all aspects of Azure Active Directory and Microsoft services that use Azure Active Directory identities.

slicer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interactive and flexible data filter that conveys the current filtering state.

table slicer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interactive and flexible data filter that conveys the current filtering state.

include.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To have as an element.

host distribution rule.translation: quy tắc phân bổ máy chủ
host distribution rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule that applies to a specific host and a specific crawl component. It is used to ensure that documents from that host are crawled by that crawl component.

alignment tab.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tab character that can be inserted in headers and footers for aligning data relative to the margin or indent. If you change the margin/indent, the text is realigned automatically.

configuration tools.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In SQL Server, a menu item which allows the user to enable, disable, start, or stop the features, services, and remote connectivity of the SQL Server installations.

basic logging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of logging available to capture information about mailbox searches that includes information about the search and who performed it.

full logging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of logging available to capture information about mailbox searches that includes information about all results that meet the search criteria.

browser window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window that serves as an interface between the user and the browser.

built-in role group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A role group that ships by default as opposed to a customized role group that a admin would customize specifically for the needs of their organization

hosted management agent.translation: tác nhân quản lý đã lưu
hosted management agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Identity Lifecycle Management (ILM) component that consists of properties, rules, and rule extensions that determine how an object is processed and that provides services to client computers or organizations that connect from remote locations.

mailbox search.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instance of a multi-mailbox search.

project application service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that needs to be started on servers that are meant to be Project Server application servers.

user profile service.translation: dịch vụ Hồ sơ Người dùng
user profile service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shared service in Microsoft SharePoint Server that enables the creation and management of user profiles that can be accessed from multiple sites and farms.

web analytics service application.translation: Ứng dụng Dịch vụ Phân tích Web
web analytics service application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SharePoint service application that collects, reports, and analyzes the usage and effectiveness of SharePoint Server sites.

search administration web service.translation: Dịch vụ Web Quản trị Tìm kiếm
search administration web service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service over which the administration (that is all the methods necessary to control the Search service, such as starting content source index crawls, updating scopes, etc.) of the Microsoft Office SharePoint Search service takes place.

striped media set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A media set that uses multiple devices, among which each backup is distributed.
