present.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To share a photo with others on a mobile device.

poll.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Kaizala Action that allows users to create a poll and send it to people on their contact list.

sandbox processing service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that provides an isolated environment to allow for the execution of custom code, such as plug-ins. This isolated environment reduces the possibility of custom code affecting the operation of the organizations in the application's deployment.

deployment web service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server role that provides the components that are required to manage the deployment by using the methods described in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM Deployment Software Development Kit (SDK), such as for creating an organization or for removing a Deployment Administrator role from a user.

organization web service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A role that provides the components that are needed to run applications that use the methods described in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM Software Development Kit (SDK).

sharepoint integration service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A role that provides SharePoint integration with Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

web application server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A role that lets users access data and content through the web application client and Microsoft Dynamics CRM for Outlook.

suite.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of application programs sold as a package, usually at a lower price than that of the individual applications sold separately. A suite for office work, for example, might contain a word processing program, a spreadsheet, a database management program, and a communications program.

application suite.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of application programs sold as a package, usually at a lower price than that of the individual applications sold separately. A suite for office work, for example, might contain a word processing program, a spreadsheet, a database management program, and a communications program.

pile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A series of equations that are stacked vertically, and that can be aligned at a particular character if desired.

slot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A space in a template where a user can type text or insert symbols.

text slot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A slot where the user can type text.

outlook profile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A defined set of values that Microsoft Office Outlook uses to keep track of user accounts.

terms of service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Rules by which one must agree to abide by in order to use a service. The accompanying Microsoft software includes computer software and may include associated media, printed materials, “online” or electronic documentation, and Internet-based services for use with a Microsoft software product (collectively, the “ADD-IN SOFTWARE”).

call delegation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows a user to answer a call for another user or make calls on behalf of the other user.

group schedule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The combined schedule of a number of people or resources.

public safety answering point.translation: Điểm trả lời an toàn công cộng
public safety answering point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A call center for answering emergency calls and providing emergency services.

psap.translation: Điểm trả lời an toàn công cộng
psap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A call center for answering emergency calls and providing emergency services.

ddos attack.translation: tấn công từ chối dịch vụ phân tán
ddos attack.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A denial of service attack in which an attacker uses malicious code installed on various computers to attack a single target.

distributed denial of service attack.translation: tấn công từ chối dịch vụ phân tán
distributed denial of service attack.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A denial of service attack in which an attacker uses malicious code installed on various computers to attack a single target.

opportunity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A potential revenue-generating event, or sale to an account, that needs to be tracked through a sales process to completion.

farm configuration wizard.translation: trình hướng dẫn cấu hình cụm máy chủ
farm configuration wizard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that allows the administrator to configure the State Service.

english assistance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of integrated linguistic references and resources that are designed to help Office users for whom English is not a first language to write better English text.

mailbox audit log.translation: nhật ký kiểm tra hộp thư
mailbox audit log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A log that is generated for each mailbox that has mailbox audit logging enabled. Log entries are stored in the Audits subfolder of the audited mailbox Recoverable Items folder.

internet service provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization that provides a connection to the internet and services related to that.

isp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization that provides a connection to the internet and services related to that.

access provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization that provides a connection to the internet and services related to that.

service provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity which provides some services.

internet access provider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization that provides a connection to the internet and services related to that.

iap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An organization that provides a connection to the internet and services related to that.

approve.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To authorize the occurrence of future events in a system.

journalize.translation: ghi sổ nhật ký kế toán
journalize.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To record the financial consequences of accounting events in the subledger journal.

attack surface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The collective of attack vectors through which a system can be attacked successfully.

one-way agreement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In BizTalk Server, an agreement between the two partners that establishes a uni-directional communication channel, either for receiving messages or for sending messages. The specific source and target addresses are specified in the "one-way agreement" tabs when creating an Agreement.

microsoft office screentip language.translation: Ngôn ngữ Mẹo Màn hình Microsoft Office
microsoft office screentip language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A functionality that allows the user to add an additional language for ScreenTips in Microsoft Office.

expense.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cost incurred by a business in an attempt to obtain revenue.

complex event processing.translation: xử lý sự kiện phức tạp
complex event processing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The continuous and incremental processing of event streams from multiple sources based on declarative query and pattern specifications with near-zero latency.

cep.translation: xử lý sự kiện phức tạp
cep.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The continuous and incremental processing of event streams from multiple sources based on declarative query and pattern specifications with near-zero latency.

cti event.translation: sự kiện gia tăng thời gian hiện tại
cti event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special punctuation event that indicates the completeness of the existing events.

current time increment event.translation: sự kiện gia tăng thời gian hiện tại
current time increment event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special punctuation event that indicates the completeness of the existing events.

oim.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An information model published by the Metadata Coalition (MDC) and widely supported by software vendors. The OIM is a formal description of metadata constructs organized by subject area.

open information model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An information model published by the Metadata Coalition (MDC) and widely supported by software vendors. The OIM is a formal description of metadata constructs organized by subject area.

adapter host.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The root abstract class Adapter, which defines the handshake between the adapter and the StreamInsight server in the ENQUEUE interaction point. It provides all the required adapter services such as memory management, and exception handling.

bound stream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event stream that contains all the information needed to produce events. Either the information is an already instantiated data source, or the information is sufficient for the StreamInsight server to start the data source.

composable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to the ability to form complex queries by using query components (objects or operators) as reusable building blocks. This is done by linking query components together or encapsulating query components within each other.

count window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window with a variable window size that moves along a timeline with each distinct event start time.

event kind.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Event metadata that defines the event type.

event header.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The portion of an event that defines the temporal properties of the event and the event kind. Temporal properties include a valid start time and end time associated with the event.

event model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The event metadata that defines the temporal characteristics (shape) of the event.

event payload.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The data portion of an event in which the data fields are defined as CLR (common language runtime) types. An event payload is a typed structure.

database mirroring partner.translation: đối tác phản chiếu cơ sở dữ liệu
database mirroring partner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One in a pair of server instances that act as role-switching partners for a mirrored database.

input adapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An adapter that accepts incoming event streams from external sources such as databases, files, ticker feeds, network ports, manufacturing devices and so on.

animation manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A core component of an animation application and the central programmatic interface for managing (creating, scheduling, and controlling) animations.

insert event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The event kind used to signify the arrival of an event into the stream. The insert event type consists of metadata that defines the valid lifetime of the event and the payload (data) fields of the event.

interval event model.translation: mô hình sự kiện định kỳ
interval event model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The event model of an interval event.

explicit cap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An explicit hierarchy used as the top level of a derived hierarchy structure.

failover partner.translation: đối tác chuyển đổi dự phòng
failover partner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The server used if the connection to the partner server fails.

output adapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An adapter that receives events processed by the server, transforms the events into a format expected by the output device (a database, text file, PDA, or other device), and emits the data to that device.

point event model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The event model of a point event.

query binding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of binding instances of input adapters and instances of output adapters to an instance of a query template.

query template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The fundamental unit of query composition. A query template defines the business logic required to continuously analyze and process events submitted to and emitted by the StreamInsight server.

expense report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document that provides an itemized summary and tracking of work-related expenses for reimbursement.

retract event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An internal event kind used to modify an existing insert event by modifying the end time of the event.

snapshot window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window that is defined according to the start and end times of the event in the stream, instead of a fixed grid along the timeline.

sliding window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window of fixed length L that moves along a timeline according to the stream’s events. With every event on the timeline, a new window is created, starting at the event’s start time.

sql trace.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set Transact-SQL system stored procedures to create traces on an instance of the SQL Server Database Engine.

sql server trace.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set Transact-SQL system stored procedures to create traces on an instance of the SQL Server Database Engine.

standing query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instantiation of a query template that runs within the StreamInsight server performing continuous computation over the incoming events.

stream consumer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The structure or device that consumes the output of a query. Examples are an output adapter or another running query.

anchor cap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A line cap where the width of the cap is bigger than the width of the line.

typed event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event for which the structure of the event payload provided by the source or consumed by the sink is known, and the input or output adapter is designed around this specific event structure.

streaminsight event flow debugger.translation: Trình gỡ lỗi Dòng Sự kiện StreamInsight
streaminsight event flow debugger.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A stand-alone tool in the Microsoft StreamInsight platform that provides event-flow debugging and analysis.

streaminsight platform.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The platform, consisting of the StreamInsight server, Event Flow Debugging tool, Visual Studio IDE, and other components, for the development of complex event processing applications.

microsoft streaminsight.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The platform, consisting of the StreamInsight server, Event Flow Debugging tool, Visual Studio IDE, and other components, for the development of complex event processing applications.

streaminsight.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The platform, consisting of the StreamInsight server, Event Flow Debugging tool, Visual Studio IDE, and other components, for the development of complex event processing applications.

streaminsight server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The core engine and adapter framework components of Microsoft StreamInsight. The StreamInsight server can be used to process and analyze the event streams associated with a complex event processing application.

cep engine.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The core engine and adapter framework components of Microsoft StreamInsight. The StreamInsight server can be used to process and analyze the event streams associated with a complex event processing application.

time interval.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A period of time in which a given event is valid. The valid time interval includes the valid start time, and all moments of time up to, but not including the valid end time.

calculation pass number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ordinal position used to refer to a calculation pass.

typed adapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An adapter that emits only a single event type.

untyped adapter.translation: bộ điều hợp không theo loại
untyped adapter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An adapter that accepts or emits multiple event types in which the payload structure or the type of fields in the payload are not known in advance. Examples are events from a CSV or text file, a SQL table, or a socket.

carousel view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view where the preview area is centered and the thumbnails that immediately precede and follow the current thumbnail are adjacent to the preview area.

collocate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To select a partitioned table that contains related data and join with this table on the partitioning column.

graphics primitive.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A basic shape (a point, a line, circle, curve, or polygon) that a graphics adapter can manipulate as a discrete entity.

key range lock.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A lock that is used to lock ranges between records in a table to prevent phantom additions to, or deletions from, a set of records. Ensures serializable transactions.

report builder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The application that provides a productive report-authoring environment for IT professionals and power users.

microsoft sql server reporting services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report authoring tool that features a Microsoft Office-like authoring environment and features such as new sparkline, data bar, and indicator data visualizations, the ability to save report items as report parts, a wizard for creating maps, aggregates of aggregates, and enhanced support for expressions.

slipstream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To integrate updates, patches or service packs into the base installation files of the original software, so that the resulting files will allow a single step installation of the updated software.

hard-coded.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Depending on values embedded in the program code rather than on values that can be input and changed by the user.

dedicated administrator connection.translation: kết nối quản trị viên chuyên dụng
dedicated administrator connection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dedicated connection that allows an administrator to connect to a server when the Database Engine will not respond to regular connections.

start cap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The start of a line.

tabular query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard operation such as search, sort, filter or transform on data in a table.

theater view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view where the preview is centered in a PowerPivot Gallery SharePoint document library and lets you rotate through the available worksheets. Smaller thumbnails of each worksheet appear lower on the page, on either side.

tile server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A map image caching engine that caches and serves pregenerated, fixed-size map image tiles.

utility reader.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A privilege that allows the user account to connect to the SQL Server Utility, see all viewpoints in the Utility Explorer in SSMS and see settings on the Utility Administration node in Utility Explorer in SSMS.

worm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Self-propagating malicious software that can automatically distribute itself from one computer to another through network connections. A worm can take harmful action, such as consuming network or local system resources, possibly causing a denial of service attack.

distinct count measure.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A measure commonly used to determine for each member of a dimension how many distinct, lowest-level members of another dimension share rows in the fact table.

windows nt integrated security.translation: Bảo mật Tích hợp Windows NT
windows nt integrated security.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security mode that leverages the Windows NT authentication process.

job history.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Log that keeps a historical record of jobs.

parameterized query.translation: truy vấn được tham số hóa
parameterized query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A query that accepts input values through parameters.

queue reader agent.translation: Tác nhân Bộ đọc Hàng đợi
queue reader agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The replication agent which is used with transactional replication with the queued updating option. The agent runs at the distributor and moves changes made at the subscriber back to the publisher.

row versioning.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In 0nline index operations, a feature that isolates the index operation from the effects of modifications that are made by other transactions.

stored procedure resolver.translation: trình giải quyết thủ tục đã lưu trữ
stored procedure resolver.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program that is invoked to handle row change-based conflicts that are encountered in an article to which the resolver was registered.

conditional split.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A restore of a full database backup, the most recent differential database backup (if any), and the log backups (if any) taken since the full database backup.

window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rectangular area on a computer screen in which programs and content appear.

discrete signal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A time series consisting of a sequence of quantities, that is a time series that is a function over a domain of discrete integers.

equirectangular projection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a map report item, a very simple equidistant cylindrical projection in which the horizontal coordinate is the longitude and the vertical coordinate is the latitude.

explicit hierarchy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Master Data Services, a hierarchy that uses consolidated members to group other consolidated and leaf members.

phantom.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to the insertion of a new row or the deletion of an existing row in a range of rows that were previously read by another task, where that task has not yet committed its transaction.

fold count.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A value that represents the number of partitions that will be created within the original data set.

outlook web app web part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A piece of the user interface (UI) in Outlook Web Access that can be hosted in iframes as part of other Web applications such as SharePoint Portal Server portals. Outlook Web Access exposes a set of Outlook Web Access Web Part URLs that allow other applications to request certain portions of the Outlook Web Access UI. For example, another application can load the Outlook Web Access Web Part URL for the Inbox, Calendar, or Contact folder into an iframe hosted in that application.

sort.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Excel function that sorts the contents of a range or array.

outdialing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process in which Unified Messaging dials calls. Unified Messaging generally receives calls, but sometimes dials calls. For example, outdialing occurs when Unified Messaging transfers a call to an auto attendant or a subscriber uses Play-on-Phone from Outlook.

kagi chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart, mostly independent of time, used to track price movements and to make decisions on purchasing stock.

lazy schema validation.translation: xác thực sơ đồ tự động
lazy schema validation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that delays checking the remote schema to validate its metadata against a query until execution in order to increase performance.

lightweight pooling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that provides a means of reducing the system overhead associated with the excessive context switching sometimes seen in symmetric multiprocessing (SMP) environments by performing the context switching inline, thus helping to reduce user/kernel ring transitions.

line layer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The layer in a map report that displays spatial data as lines, for example, lines that indicate paths or routes.

map resolution.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The accuracy at which the location and shape of map features can be depicted for a given map scale. In a large scale map (e.g. a map scale of 1:1) there is less reduction of features than those shown on a small scale map (e.g. 1:1,000,000).

map viewport.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The area of the map to display in the map report item. For example, a map for the entire United States might be embedded in a report, but only the area for the northwestern states are displayed.

media header.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A label that provides information about the backup media.

minor tick mark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tick mark that corresponds to a minor scaling unit on an axis.

pad index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option that specifies the space to leave open on each page in the intermediate levels of the index.

point and figure chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart that plots day-to-day price movements without taking into consideration the passage of time.

priority boost.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An advanced option that specifies whether Microsoft® SQL Server™ should run at a higher Microsoft Windows NT® scheduling priority than other processes on the same computer.

taskpad.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The list of tasks in Calendar.

range partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table partition that is defined by specific and customizable ranges of data.

aggregate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Math and trigonometry Excel function that returns an aggregate in a list or database.

unpivot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To expand values from multiple columns in a single record into multiple records with the same values in a single column.

luring attack.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An attack in which the client is lured to voluntarily connect to the attacker.

atom feed.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML structure that contains metadata about content, such as the language version and the date when the content was last modified, and is sent to subscribers by using the Atom Publishing Protocol (AtomPub).

urgent interruptions only.translation: Chỉ liên lạc khi khẩn cấp
urgent interruptions only.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status that indicates a user should be contacted only for urgent issues.

certificate of authenticity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security label that accompanies all Microsoft products distributed by original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

staging process.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process that uses an intermediate store to store data temporarily during the loading process.

staging queue.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The batch table in SQL Server Master Data Services where staged records are queued as batches to be processed into the Master Data Services database.

unbound stream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event stream that contains the definition of the event model or payload type, but does not define the data source.

cluster disk resource.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A disk on a cluster storage device.

cluster repair.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A repair operation in which all missing or corrupt files are replaced, all missing or corrupt registry keys are replaced and all missing or invalid configuration values are set to default values.

deal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A discount, coupon, or other sorts of promotions.

backing stream.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The existing stream that the new stream will be based on.

database explorer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A simple database administration tool that lets the user perform database operations such as creating new tables, querying and modifying existing data, and other database development functions.

firewall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security solution that segregates one portion of a network from another portion, allowing only authorized network traffic to pass through according to traffic filtering rules.

security-edge gateway.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security solution that segregates one portion of a network from another portion, allowing only authorized network traffic to pass through according to traffic filtering rules.

failover clustering.translation: phân cụm chuyển đổi dự phòng
failover clustering.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A high availability process in which an instance of an application or a service, running over one machine, can fail-over onto another machine in the failover cluster in the case the first one fails.

vat.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tax on products at each stage of their production based on the value added during that stage.

key column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A column whose contents uniquely identify every row in a table.

microsoft sql server system clr types.translation: Microsoft SQL Server System CLR Types
microsoft sql server system clr types.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A stand-alone package, part of SQL Server 2008 R2 Feature Pack, that contains the components implementing the geometry, geography, and hierarchy id types in SQL Server.

pickup folder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The directory from which messages are picked up.

switch in table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The staging table the user wants to use to switch in their data. The staging table needs to be created before switching partitions with the Manage PartitionsWizard.

switch out table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The staging table the user wants to use for the partition to switch out of the current source table.

running total.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The total of all records up to and including the current record, displayed on a record by record basis.

gap depth.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A measure that specifies the distance between data series that are displayed along distinct rows, as a result of clustering.

hint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option or strategy specified for enforcement by the SQL Server query processor on SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE statements. The hint overrides any execution plan the query optimizer might select for a query.

mapper.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component that maps objects.

median price formula.translation: công thức tính giá trung bình
median price formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formula that calculates the average of the high and low prices.

point depth.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The depth of data points displayed in a 3D chart area.

query hint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hint that specifies that the indicated hints should be used throughout the query. Query hints affect all operators in the statement.

start angle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The angle of rotation, between 0 and 360, at which the scale will begin. The zero (0) position is located at the bottom of the gauge, and the start angle rotates clockwise. For example, a start angle of 90 degrees starts the scale at the 9 o'clock position.

weighted close formula.translation: công thức đóng theo trọng số
weighted close formula.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formula that calculates the average of the high, low, and close prices, while giving extra weight to the close price.

recording manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables you to manage Lync 2010 conversations and meetings that you have recorded. From within Lync Recording Manager, you can play or rename recordings, or create a video format to share with others.

wiki library.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document library in which users can easily edit any page, providing a low-maintenance way to record knowledge.

adomd.net.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A .NET managed data provider that provides access to multidimensional data sources, such as Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services.

activex data objects multidimensional.ne.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A .NET managed data provider that provides access to multidimensional data sources, such as Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services.

tunneling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows Presentation Foundation, an event routing strategy where the event instance moves down the element tree (starting at the root of the visual tree and ending with the source). The names of events that use this routing strategy are prefixed with the word "Preview". These events have the same signature as their counterparts that use the bubbling event routing strategy.

synced user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user account in a cloud service or other separate system that is synchronized with the local Active Directory directory service.

upper bound.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The upper limit in a permitted range of values.

identity federation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process in Microsoft Online Services that uses Active Directory Federation Services 2.0 and Microsoft Federation Gateway to securely represent identities in the cloud and tie those identities to corporate credentials (user name and password). Users can then use their corporate credentials to sign in once to access the services in Microsoft Online Services.

activex kill bit.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A registry value that contains the CLSID of all controls that are vulnerable to security flaws.

kill bit.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A registry value that contains the CLSID of all controls that are vulnerable to security flaws.

data mining extension.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Analysis Services, a statement that performs mining tasks programmatically.

dmx.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Analysis Services, a statement that performs mining tasks programmatically.

tracking number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique identifying number assigned to a shipment.

reference field.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A field that is associated with another field so that their properties always match. If the properties in one field are changed, the properties in the other field are updated automatically.

sign-in blocked users.translation: người dùng bị chặn đăng nhập
sign-in blocked users.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of users of Office 365 who have their sign-in priveleges blocked. It is also the name of a view in the users and groups section of Office 365.

sign-in allowed users.translation: người dùng được cho phép đăng nhập
sign-in allowed users.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of users of Office 365 who have their sign-in privileges allowed. It is also the name of a view in the users and groups section of Office 365.

single-use code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A code, which can be used only once, that can be used in place of a password to sign in.

trusted pc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer that a customer adds to their Windows Live account security information from which they can reset a forgotten password without providing further information.

telnet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A protocol that enables an Internet user to log on to and enter commands on a remote computer linked to the Internet, as if the user were using a text-based terminal directly attached to that computer. Telnet is part of the TCP/IP suite of protocols.

microsoft.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The public multinational corporation that develops, manufactures, licenses, and supports a wide range of products and services predominantly related to computing.

microsoft corporation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The public multinational corporation that develops, manufactures, licenses, and supports a wide range of products and services predominantly related to computing.

msft.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The public multinational corporation that develops, manufactures, licenses, and supports a wide range of products and services predominantly related to computing.

windows live sms services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An SMS-based service that lets users complete various Windows Live tasks by sending, receiving, and replying to SMS messages.

smart matching.translation: kết nối tương quan thông minh
smart matching.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process by which the system extracts information that is associated with an incoming email message (subject, sender address, and recipient's addresses) that link the email activity to other Microsoft Dynamics CRM records.

cold standby.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A second data center that can provide availability within hours or days.

symbolic link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A disk directory entry that takes the place of a directory entry for a file but is actually a reference to a file in a different directory.

symlink.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A disk directory entry that takes the place of a directory entry for a file but is actually a reference to a file in a different directory.

soft link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A disk directory entry that takes the place of a directory entry for a file but is actually a reference to a file in a different directory.

exchange hybrid deployment.translation: phương thức triển khai kết hợp của Exchange

split view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view that allows the user to see both a form and a datasheet at the same time.

destination url.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The URL of the webpage that opens when a display URL is clicked.

editorial review.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A verification process that helps ensure advertiser adherence to Bing Ads Policies.

interest.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A subject or activity, such as a specific sport or hobby, by which potential customers can be categorized for targeted advertising.

keyword research.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The analysis of keywords by using Bing Ads keyword research tools to generate keywords and to view data about keywords, such as the frequency of searches and the demographics associated with those keywords.

sharepoint deployment planning services.translation: Dịch vụ Lập kế hoạch Triển khai Sharepoint
sharepoint deployment planning services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of services designed to help evaluate organizations' environments, develop customized Microsoft SharePoint deployment plans, and that is part of software assurance coverage.

sdps.translation: Dịch vụ Lập kế hoạch Triển khai Sharepoint
sdps.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of services designed to help evaluate organizations' environments, develop customized Microsoft SharePoint deployment plans, and that is part of software assurance coverage.

microsoft desktop deployment planning se.translation: Dịch vụ Lập kế hoạch Triển khai Sharepoint Microsoft Desktop
microsoft desktop deployment planning se.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Software Assurance benefit delivered by Microsoft Certified Partner that consists of one to fifteen days of planning the deployment of Microsoft Office Software for a specific organization.

public user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user of public IM service providers, or providers and servers that use Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP), who has credentials and who therefore is handled as authenticated.

non-contained database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu không chứa
non-contained database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SQL Server database that stores database settings and metadata with the instance of SQL Server Database Engine where the database is installed, and requires logins in the master database for authentication.

contained database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SQL Server database that includes all of the user authentication, database settings, and metadata required to define and access the database, and has no configuration dependencies on the instance of the SQL Server Database Engine where the database is installed.

service principal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity that represents a service at the Key Distribution Center (KDC). The service principal has a name and an associated key. A subclass of principal, a service principal generally does not correspond to a human user of the system, but rather to an automated service providing a resource, such as a file server.

marker.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A visual indicator that identifies a data point. In a map report, a marker is the visual indicator that identifies the location of each point on the point layer.

point layer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The layer in a map report that displays spatial data as points, for examples, points that indicate cities or points of interest.

polygon layer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The layer in a map report that displays spatial data as areas, for example, areas that indicate geographical regions such as counties.

microsoft office for mac 2011.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2011 edition of Microsoft Office that runs on the Mac operating system.

office for mac 2011.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The year 2011 edition of Microsoft Office that runs on the Mac operating system.

pivot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document that is the most representative in a set of near duplicate documents.

graphic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image generated from a mathematical description that determines the position, length, and direction in which lines are drawn. A vector graphic is created as a collection of lines rather than as a pattern of individual dots or pixels.

incoming link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hyperlink on an outside domain that points into the user's domain.

subscription database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu đăng ký
subscription database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database at the Subscriber that receives data and database objects published by a Publisher.

flatten.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To convert a nested structure into a flat structure.

password stealer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A trojan that captures and/or transmits passwords to an attacker.

esp ieee standard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard for providing integrity and confidentiality to IP (Internet Protocol) datagrams. In some circumstances, it can also provide authentication to IP datagrams.

encapsulating security payload.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard for providing integrity and confidentiality to IP (Internet Protocol) datagrams. In some circumstances, it can also provide authentication to IP datagrams.

esp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standard for providing integrity and confidentiality to IP (Internet Protocol) datagrams. In some circumstances, it can also provide authentication to IP datagrams.

wiremap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A location map that determines a caller's location, and is configured by a VoIP administrator.

microsoft points.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A digital micropayment and loyalty service that enables efficient micropayments and prepaid purchase for cash based consumers (including kids/teens, as well as emerging and developing markets), and provides a mechanism to directly reward loyal customers.

dock position.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The configuration in which an interface element, such as a toolbar or panel, is docked to another interface element, typically a window or pane.

international date line west.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A standardized time zone where the local time is 12 hours earlier than Coordinated Universal Time/Greenwich Mean Time.

fiber.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Windows NT lightweight thread scheduled within a single OS thread.

mixed mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operating mode setting that allows interoperability between versions.

reinstallation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process of repeated installation of a product, feature, tool, kit, pack, etc.

built-in administrator account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: On Windows-based computers, a user account that is a member of the computer’s local Administrators group or a member of a group that is a member of the local Administrators group, such as the Domain Admins group in a Windows domain. This is the first account that is created when you install an operating system on a new workstation, stand-alone server, or member server. By default, this account has the highest level of administrative access to the local computer.

built-in administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: On Windows-based computers, a user account that is a member of the computer’s local Administrators group or a member of a group that is a member of the local Administrators group, such as the Domain Admins group in a Windows domain. This is the first account that is created when you install an operating system on a new workstation, stand-alone server, or member server. By default, this account has the highest level of administrative access to the local computer.

billing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The act of being charged money for a particular service.

bar code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The special identification code printed as a set of vertical bars of differing widths on books, grocery products, and other merchandise. Used for rapid, error-free input in such facilities as libraries, hospitals, and grocery stores, bar codes represent binary information that can be read by an optical scanner. The coding can include numbers, letters, or a combination of the two; some codes include built-in error checking and can be read in either direction.

barcode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The special identification code printed as a set of vertical bars of differing widths on books, grocery products, and other merchandise. Used for rapid, error-free input in such facilities as libraries, hospitals, and grocery stores, bar codes represent binary information that can be read by an optical scanner. The coding can include numbers, letters, or a combination of the two; some codes include built-in error checking and can be read in either direction.

exchange online (plan 1).rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The offer from Microsoft Office 365 for messaging, calendaring, and email archiving that is accessible from Outlook on PCs, the web, and mobile devices.

exchange online (plan 2).rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The offer from Microsoft Office 365 that is the best messaging and calendaring plan accessible from PCs, the web, and mobile devices with advanced archiving, compliance, and integrated voicemail capabilities.

sharepoint online partner access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The SharePoint Online offer that provides access to an authenticated environment to collaborate with partners, customers, and external stakeholders.

office online with sharepoint plan 1.translation: Office Web Apps with SharePoint Gói 1
office online with sharepoint plan 1.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The offer from Microsoft Office 365 of the online companions to Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote to do light editing of documents directly from your web browser with Microsoft SharePoint Online capabilities.

office online with sharepoint plan 2.translation: Office Web Apps with SharePoint Gói 2
office online with sharepoint plan 2.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An offer from Microsoft Office 365 of these online companions to Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote to do light editing of documents directly from your web browser with advanced Microsoft SharePoint Online capabilities.

lync online (plan 2).rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The offer from Microsoft Office 365 that provides a unified communications plan with advanced capabilities, including enterprise instant messaging, presence, and online meetings with audio and video conferencing and multiparty data sharing.

tamper label.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A label for sealing packaging that makes it possible to tell if the package has been opened.

failover cluster.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of servers that are in one location and that are networked together for the purpose of providing live backup in case one of the servers fails.

amount.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A definite magnitude of currency, a quantity of currency, or an indefinite magnitude of an uncountable substance or quality.

extended price.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The price of a quantity of product expressed in purchase units calculated from the sales unit price, multiplied by the product quantity in purchase units, divided by the sales unit quantity.

public cloud.translation: nền tảng điện toán đám mây công cộng
public cloud.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cloud infrastructure typically owned and managed by an organization that sells cloud services. The resources are shared by the general public or a group of customers in order to optimize utilization rates.

antialiasing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software technique for smoothing the jagged appearance of curved or diagonal lines caused by poor resolution on a display screen by adjusting the brightness or color of surrounding pixels.

anti-aliasing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software technique for smoothing the jagged appearance of curved or diagonal lines caused by poor resolution on a display screen by adjusting the brightness or color of surrounding pixels.

aa.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software technique for smoothing the jagged appearance of curved or diagonal lines caused by poor resolution on a display screen by adjusting the brightness or color of surrounding pixels.

anti aliasing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software technique for smoothing the jagged appearance of curved or diagonal lines caused by poor resolution on a display screen by adjusting the brightness or color of surrounding pixels.

microsoft azure active directory module.translation: Mô-đun Microsoft Azure AD cho Windows PowerShell
microsoft azure active directory module.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of cmdlets used to administer Microsoft Azure Active Directory. You can use these cmdlets to manage users, groups, domains, cloud service subscriptions, licenses, directory sync, single sign-on, and more.

microsoft azure ad module for windows po.translation: Mô-đun Microsoft Azure AD cho Windows PowerShell
microsoft azure ad module for windows po.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of cmdlets used to administer Microsoft Azure Active Directory. You can use these cmdlets to manage users, groups, domains, cloud service subscriptions, licenses, directory sync, single sign-on, and more.

microsoft online services sign-in assist.translation: Trình Trợ giúp Đăng nhập vào Microsoft Online Services
microsoft online services sign-in assist.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A required update for Microsoft Online Services that enables your computer’s sign-in functionality for multiple user IDs.

microsoft online services sign-in add-on.translation: Phần bổ trợ Đăng nhập Microsoft Online Services
microsoft online services sign-in add-on.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A required update for Microsoft Online Services that updates the Microsoft Online Services ID Sign-In Assistant to work with other Office programs.

active mailbox migration.translation: di chuyển hộp thư hiện hoạt
active mailbox migration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The stage during the email migration when the migration service is actively provisioning new cloud-based mailboxes.

administrator audit log.translation: nhật ký kiểm tra của người quản trị
administrator audit log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An auditing record that records any action, based on a Windows PowerShell cmdlet, performed by an administrator. This can help the administrator troubleshoot configuration issues or identify the cause of security- or compliance-related problems.

microsoft sharepoint foundation 2010.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Web-based team collaboration environment that provides the ability to create and access virtual workspaces for managing documents, discussions, lists, surveys and other important contextual information, such as team member status and presence.

cutover migration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An email migration process that provisions new cloud-based mailboxes and then migrates mailbox data to the cloud.

envelope journaling.translation: ghi nhật ký thông tin trên bì thư
envelope journaling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of message journaling in which the original unaltered message is included as an attachment in the journal report.

group naming policy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A template applied to the distribution group names in your Microsoft Exchange organization. Specifically, you can specify that a prefix, a suffix, or both be applied to all distribution group names. You can also block certain words from being used in the names.

multicast server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that manages zero or more multicast groups and distributes multicast data sent to it by clients of those multicast groups through point-to-multipoint connections.

mcs.translation: Dịch vụ Tư vấn của Microsoft
mcs.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft service that packages apps for use with Microsoft Managed Desktop.

incremental synchronization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In email migration, the stage when the mailboxes in the on-premises Exchange organization and the corresponding cloud-based mailboxes are synchronized every 24 hours, after the initial synchronization. This means that any new messages sent to the mailboxes on the Exchange server are copied to the corresponding cloud-based mailboxes. Incremental synchronization continues until the administrator completes the overall migration.

journal report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The message that is generated when a message matches a journal rule. The body of the journal report contains information from the original message such as the sender email address, message subject, message-ID, and recipient email addresses. The journal report also includes the original unaltered message as an attachment.

journal rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Exchange rule that is used to record the email messages sent to or from specific recipients.

staged migration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of email migration that migrates a subset of on-premises mailboxes to the cloud. This type of migration allows the admin to maintain coexistence between their on-premises and cloud-based email organizations.

deduplication.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of saving only one copy of duplicate items in the search results

immutable id.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique user identifier that must not change for the user over the lifetime of the user being in the system.

bing shopping.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to online shopping.

campaign code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An alpha-numeric identifier for a marketing campaign that is distinct from its name.

bing finance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to finance.

bing games.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to online games.

bing video games.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to video games.

bing videos.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to videos.

bing music.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to music.

bing weather.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to weather.

classification.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of an AI model that predicts the type of content in a document by learning from example files with the same type of content.

microsoft ai cloud partner program.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The site program for Microsoft partners.

question template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A structure that describes a set of questions that can be asked using a particular relationship or set of relationships.

liquidity classification.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A systematic organization of time intervals that predict the liquidity of a party.

accounting event liquidity classificatio.translation: thể loại thanh khoản của sự kiện kế toán
accounting event liquidity classificatio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The liquidity classification of an accounting event.

inproc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Referring to a COM object’s code that is loaded from a DLL file and is located in the same process as the client.

context pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tree view included in the Table Designer that lists objects related to a table.

script pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text editor portion of the Table Designer.

autopolling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of periodically determining the status of each device in a set so that the active program can process the events generated by each device, such as whether a mouse button was pressed or whether new data is available at a serial port. This can be contrasted with event-driven processing, in which the operating system alerts a program or routine to the occurrence of an event by means of an interrupt or message rather than having to check each device in turn.

polling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of periodically determining the status of each device in a set so that the active program can process the events generated by each device, such as whether a mouse button was pressed or whether new data is available at a serial port. This can be contrasted with event-driven processing, in which the operating system alerts a program or routine to the occurrence of an event by means of an interrupt or message rather than having to check each device in turn.

columns grid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An editable grid structure in the Table Designer that lists the columns of a table and additional information about each column.

table designer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A visual design surface that is used to create and edit TSQL tables and table related objects.

tsql pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the tabs that hosts the editor control to allow TSQL code editing.

messages pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the tabs that hosts the messages returned from SQL Server after a TSQL query has been executed.

execution plan pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the tabs that hosts the output for an estimated or actual execution plan that SQL Server uses.

client statistics pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the tabs that hosts the output of the client statistics information.

vertical split.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A vertical orientation of the CIDER shell.

horizontal split.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A horizontal orientation of the CIDER shell.

wais.translation: Máy chủ thông tin diện rộng
wais.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UNIX-based document search and retrieval system used to query WAIS libraries for indexed files that match keywords and that can be used on individual websites as a search engine.

wide area information server.translation: Máy chủ thông tin diện rộng
wide area information server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A UNIX-based document search and retrieval system used to query WAIS libraries for indexed files that match keywords and that can be used on individual websites as a search engine.

accounting category.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A classifier used to group journal account entries according to their economic characteristics.

check box.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interactive controls often found in graphical user interfaces used to enable or disable one or more features or options from a set.

native boot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An operating-system installation and configuration that uses a virtual hard disk as the running operating system. There is no host operating system or hypervisor in a native-boot configuration.

mouse.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An input device with the following features: a flat-bottomed casing designed to be gripped by one hand; one or more buttons on the top; a multidirectional detection device (a ball, laser or optical device) on the bottom; and a cable or wireless connection to the computer.

accounts payable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A subclassification of a liability account classification that describes the changes in value owed to vendors or creditors.

accounts receivable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A subclassification of an asset account classification that describes the changes in value owed by customers.

cost of goods sold.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An accounting category used to sum the financial consequences of manufacturing products and carrying inventory.

cogs.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An accounting category used to sum the financial consequences of manufacturing products and carrying inventory.

rebate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A refund of an amount after the full amount has been paid.

mde file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Microsoft Access database (.mdb) file with all modules compiled and all editable source code removed.

moving picture experts group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The committee that creates international standards for coding audio-visual information to a digital, compressed format.

mpeg.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The committee that creates international standards for coding audio-visual information to a digital, compressed format.

microsoft® office communicator mobile.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mobile Microsoft Office-integrated client for Microsoft Office Live Communications Server that provides access to all contacts from the desktop version of Office Communicator and full instant messaging capabilities from the mobile device.

recovery model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database property that controls the basic behavior of backup and restore operations for a database. For instance, the recovery model controls how transactions are logged, whether the transaction log requires backing up, and what kinds of restore operations are available.

custom domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A domain name whose purpose is to express the individuality of the person on whose behalf it is registered. Custom domains are often subdomains, and contrast with domain names which resolve to an organization (e.g. a company) or a service that organization offers.

total.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The result of adding a list of entities together.

hub.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A combination of a home page that aggregates news and activities across multiple sites in an intranet, with a common navigational structure, look and feel, and search shared by those sites.

diacritical mark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mark placed over, under, or through a character, usually to indicate a change in phonetic value from the unmarked state.

diacritic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mark placed over, under, or through a character, usually to indicate a change in phonetic value from the unmarked state.

comma-delimited text file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data file consisting of fields and records, stored as text, in which the fields are separated from each other by commas.

comma delimited file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data file consisting of fields and records, stored as text, in which the fields are separated from each other by commas.
