csv.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data file consisting of fields and records, stored as text, in which the fields are separated from each other by commas.

comma-separated values file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data file consisting of fields and records, stored as text, in which the fields are separated from each other by commas.

error list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The pane that shows T-SQL syntax or dependency errors.

commit preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The title of a window that displays actions to be taken during the commit operation.

first run.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A client bootstrapping Group Policy setting that must exist in the registry before any end user signs in for the first time.

heartbeat.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A message generated by an agent that tells its management server that the agent is functioning. It also informs Operations Manager about the current rules that are evaluated by the agent, and if it is necessary, it requests updates.

lync web app.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A client based on Microsoft Silverlight that replaces Communicator Web Access.

performance reviews.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A template that addresses, from a Human Resources perspective, the general activities that define the typical quarterly or annual performance review cycle. This template assumes a performance review process has previously been established and assumes that performance is not tied to compensation.

lync call.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A call made from the user's computer (using Voice over Internet Protocol, or VoIP) to a contact who is also running Lync.

platform layer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The layer that includes the physical servers and services that support the services layer. The platform layer consists of many instances of SQL Server, each of which is managed by the SQL Azure fabric.

tool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A utility or feature that aids in accomplishing a task or set of tasks.

slate.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tablet-style portable computer that's designed for touch input and that lacks an integrated physical keyboard.

bing tv.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to TV.

bing movies.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Bing search engine dedicated to movies.

bing news.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The part of the Bing search engine dedicated to news.

bing dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Bing service that provides dictionary search.

subscription advisor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft partner who is authorized to sell subscriptions for Microsoft Online Services. The subscription advisor may have additional authorization to offer technical support. Internally, a subscription advisor may be referred to as a "reseller," "partner of record", or "breadth partner."

microsoft intune.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The cloud-based endpoint management solution which manages user access and simplifies app and device management across your devices, including mobile devices, desktop computers, and virtual endpoints.

intune.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The solution that allows you to manage and protect corporate apps and data across devices with Microsoft Intune.

compact disc-recordable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of CD-ROM that can be written (only once) on a CD recorder and read on a CD-ROM drive.

cd-r.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of CD-ROM that can be written (only once) on a CD recorder and read on a CD-ROM drive.

user store.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A logical grouping of users, groups, and content permissions for a third-party security or content system that is accessed by FAST Search Authorization.

public filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The search security filter in FSA that finds documents that all users have access to.

managed keyword.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A word or phrase that is added to a SharePoint item, either as a value in the Managed Keyword column or as a social tag.

access url.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The internal URL that is used by a crawler to identify and access an item.

active selection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The current selection of cells, rows, or columns that includes the active cell in a datasheet.

adjacent cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cell that is in the same row as and adjoins the current cell in a worksheet.

network database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that runs on a network.

anchor crawl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of adding anchor text that is in links between items to the full-text index catalog.

audience rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of logical conditions that determine whether a user profile can be a member of an audience.

authority level.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A floating-point number that designates that a specific Web page is more relevant than other Web pages. Allowed values are 0, 1, or 2. Zero (0) signifies the most valuable authoritative page level.

available site template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based collection of predefined or user-defined settings that are stored as a site definition configuration or a site template, and can be used when creating a site.

axis label.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text or number that identifies the categories or the scaling of an axis. The axis label usually appears below or to the left of the axis.

xml signature.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based digital signature that can be used to secure the data contained in XML documents. XML Signatures are a standard governed by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

basic page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Parts page that contains only one Web Part zone and, by default, a Content Editor Web Part.

blank site.translation: Đối tượng Quản lý Phân tích
blank site.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A site that was created by using the "Blank" site template.

collaborative application markup languag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based language that is used to describe various elements, such as queries and views, in sites that are based on Microsoft® SharePoint® Products and Technologies.

caml.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based language that is used to describe various elements, such as queries and views, in sites that are based on Microsoft® SharePoint® Products and Technologies.

catalog reset.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of removing information about all crawled items from a full-text index catalog.

cell formatting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of properties that, as a whole, specify the appearance of a cell, such as font characteristics and fill color.

content migration package.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A package of XML-formatted files that is used to migrate content between site collections, sites, and lists.

content placeholder.translation: chỗ dành sẵn cho nội dung
content placeholder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A region within a page layout that is populated dynamically with the value of the publishing page field to which it is bound.

content type group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A named category of content types that is used to organize content types of a similar purpose.

content type identifier.translation: mã định danh loại nội dung
content type identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique identifier that is assigned to a content type.

content type order.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The sequence in which content types are displayed.

zero-length string.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string that contains no characters.

context site.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A site that corresponds to the context of the current request.

context type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that is used as a classification for an event receiver.

crawl log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of properties that provides information about the results of crawling a display URL. The information includes whether the crawl was successful, the content source to which the display URL belongs, and the level, message, time, and identifier for any errors that occur.

crawl queue.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data structure that stores the list of items to crawl next.

crawl status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The state of a crawl operation.

crawl type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A setting that specifies whether to evaluate all of the users and member groups in the directory service that is crawled, or only those users and member groups that were modified after the last crawl.

wildcard search.translation: tìm kiếm theo ký tự đại diện
wildcard search.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A search for data in a table or field using placeholders (such as * or ?).

crawl url history.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data structure that stores a list of URLs and their properties, such as when a URL was last crawled.

crawled property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of metadata that can be discovered during a crawl and applied to one or more items. It can be mapped to a managed property.

crawled property category.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of crawled properties for a specific type of item.

current user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The authenticated user during processing operations in a front-end Web server and a back-end database server.

data view web part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part that is used to display items in a list.

default list view.translation: dạng xem danh sách mặc định
default list view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The view of a list that is defined by the owner of the list to appear when users browse to the list without specifying a view.

default mobile list view.translation: dạng xem danh sách di động mặc định
default mobile list view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The view of a list that is defined by the owner of the list to appear when users browse to the list from a mobile device without specifying a view.

descending order.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A sort order in which text strings are arranged in reverse alphabetical order, numerical values are arranged from largest to smallest, and dates and times are arranged from newest to oldest.

z to a.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A sort order in which text strings are arranged in reverse alphabetical order, numerical values are arranged from largest to smallest, and dates and times are arranged from newest to oldest.

duplicate result removal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of grouping that removes documents with duplicate or near-duplicate content from search results.

duplicate removal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of grouping that removes documents with duplicate or near-duplicate content from search results.

duplicate trimming.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of grouping that removes documents with duplicate or near-duplicate content from search results.

excluded item.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An item that is excluded from a crawl by the administrator of the host site or the search administrator of the crawler.

external reference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reference to a cell, range, defined name, or other object in another worksheet or workbook.

external workbook.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A workbook, other than the active workbook, that is on disk or in memory and to which a dependency is implied or intended.

farm administrators group.translation: nhóm Quản trị Cụm máy chủ
farm administrators group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of users that has permission to manage all of the servers in a server farm. Members of the Farm Administrators group can perform command-line operations and all of the administrative tasks in Central Administration for the server or server farm.

feature definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML fragment that defines a feature and its attributes.

feature identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that identifies a feature.

feature property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A property that is associated with an active feature at a particular scope.

feature scope.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The scope at which a feature can be activated.

result source.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A source that returns a set of search results for a given search query. The source can be a search service in the local server farm or another server farm, or another search engine that is compliant with the OpenSearch protocol.

federated location definition.translation: định nghĩa vị trí liên kết
federated location definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The configuration settings that describe how to issue a query for a given federated location and display the search results.

field internal name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string that uniquely identifies a field in a content type or a SharePoint list.

first-stage recycle bin.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A container for items that are deleted. Items in this container are visible to users with the appropriate permissions and to site collection administrators.

generic list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list whose base type is Generic List.

ghosted.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The condition of a document whose content is stored in a location other than the content database. If a document is ghosted, the front-end Web server determines the location of the content by using the SetupPath value for the document.

graph object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that represents a chart and the datasheet that contains the data for the chart.

hidden cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A cell that no longer appears in a worksheet view because it is contained within a hidden row or a hidden column.

hidden column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A column that does not appear in a worksheet view because its width is set to zero (0). A column can be hidden if an outline is collapsed.

hidden row.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A row that does not appear in a worksheet view because its height is set to zero (0). A row can be hidden if a user is filtering or if an outline is collapsed.

named pipe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A portion of memory that can be used by one process to pass information to another process, so that the output of one is the input of the other. The second process can be local (on the same computer as the first) or remote (on a networked computer).

horizontal alignment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A formatting setting that specifies how content is positioned within the horizontal space of a cell, object, or page. Content can be aligned along the left or right edge, or distributed evenly across the horizontal space.

host depth.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The number of allowable host hops for a content source.

inverted index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: For each token that is encountered in a corpus of indexed items, a data structure that stores a list of postings that identify which documents matched and a list of occurrences that identify which position in each document.

list folder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A folder that is contained within a SharePoint list. A list folder can contain documents or list items, and it retains the characteristics of other items in the list, such as a customizable schema.

list form web part.translation: Phần Web Biểu mẫu Danh sách
list form web part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part that is used to display, edit, or view an item in a list.

list level.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A condition of a paragraph that specifies which numbering system and indentation to use, relative to other paragraphs in a bulleted or numbered list.

list template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based definition of list settings, including fields and views, and optionally list items. List templates are stored in .stp files in the content database.

list view page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part Page that displays a view of a list.

list view web part.translation: Biểu mẫu Web Dạng xem Danh sách
list view web part.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reusable component that generates HTML-based views of items in a SharePoint list.

localized name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The descriptive name of a MetadataObject for a specific locale.

member group source.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A qualified domain name, such as domain.corp.microsoft.com, that identifies the source of a member group.

members group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A default group of users on a SharePoint site. By default, the Members group is assigned the Contribute permission level.

metadata model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of semantically-related MetadataObjects that define how to interact with a specific line-of-business (LOB) system.

metadata schema.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A schema that is used to manage information about an item.

moderated object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object for which a moderator reviews and either approves or rejects additions or changes to that object. New objects and changes to existing objects can be seen by other users only after they have been approved by the moderator.

input table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table that contains data to be processed.

moderation status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A content approval status of an item in a list.

multivalue property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A property that can contain multiple values of the same variant type.

named object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list, PivotTable® report, chart, or range that can be referenced by name. A sheet is not a type of named object.

named item view.translation: dạng xem mục đã đặt tên
named item view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Web Part that renders named objects or named items in a workbook, such as tables, charts, slicers or a named range of cells.

navigation structure.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hierarchical organization of links between related content, such as lists within a site.

new form.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A form that allows for the creation of a list item.

office sharepoint server search service.translation: Dịch vụ Tìm kiếm trên Office SharePoint Server
office sharepoint server search service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The farm-wide service that either responds to query requests from front-end Web servers or crawls items.

open item permission.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An authorization that allows a user to retrieve an entire file.

open web permission.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A requisite permission during the import or export of a SharePoint site.

operator account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The account of the user who is managing the import process for a deployment package.

page hop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process of traversing from one item to another during a crawl.

paged view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view that supports one or more visual pages. A paged view is used to break up large sets of data into smaller sets for increased performance and manageability.

parent farm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A farm that crawls content from another farm and also responds to query requests from that farm.

parent list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that contains a list item or list folder.

personal site.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of SharePoint site that is used by an individual user for personal productivity. The site appears to the user as My Site.

pivotchart filter pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user interface element that displays a list of active fields in a PivotChart® view and is used to apply filters to those fields.

pivottable data field.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A PivotTable® field that is in the PivotTable area where the data values are shown.

pivottable field list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user interface element that displays a list of all PivotTable® fields. A PivotTable field list can be used to populate a PivotTable report and to manipulate the fields.

pivottable item.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A single member of a PivotTable® field.

pivottable member.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An individual data item within a specific dimension as it is displayed in a PivotTable® report. For example, a member in the Geography dimension might be North America.

portal content.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The main search catalog, which contains content sources and settings that are related to a crawl.

privacy level.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A setting that specifies the category of users who are allowed to view the personal information of other users, such as user profile properties, colleagues, or memberships.

propagation share.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A share that is located on a query server and whose purpose is to allow files to be copied to it by an indexer.

provisioned.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to an object that was created and deployed successfully.

published item.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A specific named object in a workbook that is published.

published version.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The version of a list item that is approved and can be seen by all users. The user interface (UI) version number for a published version is incremented to the next positive major version number and the minor version is zero. and minor version.

publishing page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document that binds to a page layout to generate an HTML page for display to a reader. Publishing pages have specific fields that contain the content that is displayed in an HTML page.

query logging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of recording information about user searches, such as search terms and time of access.

query result.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A result for a given query, which contains the title and URL of the item, and can also contain other managed properties and a hit-highlighted summary.

group policy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of specifying software behavior by system administrators. Administrators set policies that are used to control how software features behave.

query table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A two-dimensional table that presents data from an external data source.

query text.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The textual string portion of a query. Frequently, a user enters query text, but it can be programmatically amended and is not guaranteed to be exactly what the user typed.

ranking parameter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A value that is used to influence the algorithm that determines the rank of an item.

reference style.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system for specifying cells or ranges of cells and that is used in formulas. A reference style is used to specify a specific cell in a two-dimensional table by identifying the row and column that contain that cell or range of cells.

register directive.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An element of markup in a page that defines a relationship between binary files on the server that implements Web Parts and Web controls. The register directive also serves as the namespace of the markup in the Web Part Page that will refer to those binary files.

relevant result.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A search result that is relevant to a query term based on rank. By default, the higher the rank, the higher the item appears in the query results.

reranking.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event in which various statistics are calculated and recorded in the main catalog.

role identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An integer that uniquely identifies a role definition within a site.

root document.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document in the root folder of a site.

scheduled.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A status that is applied to a list item or document that specifies a time when the item or document will be published or unpublished.

schema version.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An integer value that represents the version number of the schema for a deployment package.

search application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique group of search settings that is associated, one-to-one, with a shared service provider.

search catalog.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: All of the crawl data that is associated with a given search application. A search catalog provides information that is used to generate query results.

search database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu tìm kiếm
search database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that stores search-related information, including stored procedures and tables that are used for crawler data, document metadata, and administration information.

administration port.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Internet Information Services (IIS) virtual server and port used for SharePoint Central Administration.

search service instance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that represents the specifications of the search service on one particular server.

search service account.translation: tài khoản dịch vụ tìm kiếm
search service account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user account under which the search service runs.

search shared application object.translation: đối tượng ứng dụng chia sẻ tìm kiếm
search shared application object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instance of a shared application for search that holds search-specific settings.

second-stage recycle bin.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A container for items that have been deleted from a first-stage Recycle Bin. Items in a second-stage Recycle Bin are visible only to site collection administrators.

secret key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A symmetric encryption key shared by two entities, such as between a user and the domain controller (DC), with a long lifetime. A password is a common example of a secret key. When used in a context that implies Kerberos only, a principal's secret key.

security group identifier.translation: mã định danh nhóm bảo mật
security group identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An integer that uniquely identifies a security group from all other security principals and site groups within the same site collection.

session view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The rendering of the contents of a workbook that are associated with a particular session.

shared documents library.translation: thư viện Tài liệu Chia sẻ
shared documents library.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document library that is included by default in the Team Site site template.

sheet view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of display settings, such as which cells are shown, and the zoom level for a sheet window.

single sign-on administrator.translation: người quản trị đăng nhập duy nhất
single sign-on administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security principal who is authorized to change a single sign-on (SSO) configuration and obtain master secrets from a master secret server.

sso administrator.translation: người quản trị đăng nhập duy nhất
sso administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security principal who is authorized to change a single sign-on (SSO) configuration and obtain master secrets from a master secret server.

single sign-on ticket.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A token that contains the encrypted identity of a single sign-on (SSO) user in the form of a security identifier string and a nonce.

sso ticket.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A token that contains the encrypted identity of a single sign-on (SSO) user in the form of a security identifier string and a nonce.

site collection administrator.translation: người quản trị tuyển tập site
site collection administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user who has administrative permissions for a site collection.

site collection flag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A 4-byte unsigned integer bit mask that specifies the properties that are global to a site collection. One or more values can be set for this bit mask.

site collection quota.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option for a site collection that allows administrators to set levels for maximum storage allowed, maximum number of users allowed, and warnings that are associated with the maximum levels.

site column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A field that can be associated with a content type or list within a site or site collection.

site content type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A named and uniquely identifiable collection of settings and fields that store metadata for lists within individual sites.

site definition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A family of site definition configurations. Each site definition specifies a name and contains a list of the site definition configurations.

site definition version.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A zero-based integer that indicates the version number of the site definition. Every time a site definition is updated, it is suggested that the version number be increased.

site identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that is used to identify a site in a SharePoint site collection.

web identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that is used to identify a site in a SharePoint site collection.

site membership.translation: tư cách thành viên của site
site membership.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status of being a member of a site and having a defined set of user rights for accessing or managing content on that site.

site property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A name/value pair of strings that serves as metadata for a site, such as the title or default language.

site template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML-based definition of site settings, including formatting, lists, views, and elements such as text, graphics, page layout, and styles. Site templates are stored in .stp files in the content database.

start address.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A URL that identifies a point at which to start a crawl. Administrators specify start addresses when they create or edit a content source.

subtotal column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A column that uses a summary or subtotal function to display the total of detail items in a PivotTable® field.

subtotal row.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A row that uses a summary or subtotal function to display the total of detail items in a PivotTable® field.

trusted authentication.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mechanism whereby a user account or a process account can be used to perform operations on behalf of the current user.

ui culture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The language that is used to display strings and other graphical elements in a user interface.

user display name.translation: tên hiển thị của người dùng
user display name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user profile property that can contain the preferred name of a user.

user profile change entry log.translation: nhật ký mục nhập hồ sơ người dùng
user profile change entry log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A repository that logs all of the changes that take place in a user profile.

user profile change event.translation: sự kiện thay đổi hồ sơ người dùng
user profile change event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An event that occurs when a property of any user profile is changed.

user profile import.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of importing records from a directory service to the user profile store.

user profile record identifier.translation: mã định danh bản ghi hồ sơ người dùng
user profile record identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An integer that uniquely identifies a user profile record.

user profile store.translation: lưu trữ hồ sơ người dùng
user profile store.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that stores information about each user profile.

remote reference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A reference to data stored in a document from another program.

genre.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A category for grouping or describing multimedia or games, such as music categorized as "classical" or "jazz".

visible scope.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A search scope that is displayed to site collection administrators and users.

web application identifier.translation: Mã định danh ứng dụng Web
web application identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that identifies a Web application.

web control.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server-side component that encapsulates user interface and related functionality.

web discussion comment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An individual comment that is added within a Web discussion.

web part connection.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An element in a Web Parts page that defines a provider-consumer data relationship between two Web Parts. When a Web Parts page is rendered, data provided by one Web Part can affect how and what is rendered by the other Web Part.

web part property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A configurable characteristic of a Web Part that determines the behavior of the Web Part.

work item process.translation: quy trình khoản mục công việc
work item process.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process that runs a work item.

work item type identifier.translation: mã định danh loại khoản mục công việc
work item type identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that is used to identify a work item type.

workbook file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains a byte stream representation of a workbook.

workbook object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that is associated with a workbook.

workbook parameter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A single cell that is designated to receive input from a user.

workbook view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of display settings, such as the height and width, for the windows in a workbook.

workflow association.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An association of a workflow template to a specific list or content type.

workflow configuration file.translation: tệp cấu hình dòng công việc
workflow configuration file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An implementation-specific file that is a part of a workflow. The workflow configuration file contains information that is necessary to create a workflow template from the specified workflow markup and rules files, and to associate it to a specific list.

workflow history item.translation: khoản mục lịch sử dòng công việc
workflow history item.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list item that stores information about the current status of, and past actions for, a document or item that is associated with a workflow.

workflow history list.translation: danh sách lịch sử dòng công việc
workflow history list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that stores the history of actions or tasks for a business process.

workflow identifier.translation: mã định dang dòng công việc
workflow identifier.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A GUID that is used to identify a workflow.

workflow markup file.translation: tệp đánh dấu dòng công việc
workflow markup file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains markup to specify the functional behavior of a workflow.

workflow task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An action or task in a sequence that is related to a built-in or user-defined business process.

workflow task list.translation: danh sách nhiệm vụ dòng công việc
workflow task list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A list that stores the sequence of actions or tasks for a business process.

worksheet image.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart image that is embedded in a worksheet or chart sheet.

worksheet object.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An object that is associated with a worksheet.

wsdl operation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An abstract description of an action that is supported by a WSDL service, as specified in WSDL.

wsdl port type.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A named set of abstract operations that is supported by one or more endpoints, as specified in WSDL.

built-in function.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A function that is native to an application and is made available for use in formulas.

central administration site.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A special SharePoint site where an administrator can manage all sites and servers in a farm that is running Microsoft® SharePoint® Products and Technologies.

search query.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of keywords or terms that form a search topic by defining languages, sources, search terms, inclusions, and exclusions.

search query log.translation: nhật ký truy vấn tìm kiếm
search query log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A record of information about user searches, such as search terms and time of access.

user search security filter.translation: bộ lọc bảo mật tìm kiếm người dùng
user search security filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The user search security filter that specifies group and user permissions for a specific FAST Search user. FAST Search Authorization (FSA) filters out inappropriate search results by intersecting the user’s query with the user's search security filter, and checking each document’s access control list to determine if the user has permission to view that document. The user search security filter is FSA's primary means of enforcing document-level security ("security trimming"), which helps to ensure that search results display only documents that the user has permissions to read.

discussion server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A computer that stores discussion text and information about the location of the file being discussed.

standard indicator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An indicator set that can be used when either the "increasing is better" or "decreasing is better" scoring patterns are selected when you edit the band settings.

performancepoint web services.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of Web services that determines how PerformancePoint Services operates.

performancepoint web parts.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Functionality in PerformancePoint Services that makes it possible to display dashboard views that were defined in Dashboard Designer and then published to SharePoint Server.

performancepoint trusted location.translation: vị trí tin cậy của PerformancePoint
performancepoint trusted location.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A location within Microsoft SharePoint Server from which dashboard content can be run. By default, all locations are trusted, but can be changed by a PerformancePoint Services administrator.

attribute filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In a column definition, the list of attributes that limit the data that is available for a report.

base period.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The reporting period specified in the report definition. The column definition can refer to the base period in order to specify report columns for relative time periods. For example, if the column definition specifies BASE in the Period cell, then the actual period is defined at the time the report is generated.

dimension value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique identifier for a given dimension. The length of a dimension value is variable. The values for a given dimension can have different numbers of characters. For example, a division dimension might have values San Francisco and Denver.

active cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The selected cell in which data is entered when you begin typing. Only one cell is active at a time. The active cell is bounded by a heavy border.

current cell.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The selected cell in which data is entered when you begin typing. Only one cell is active at a time. The active cell is bounded by a heavy border.

print control.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An option in the column definition that enables special printing characteristics, such as non-printing and reversed credit and debit signs, when reports are generated.

scroll arrow button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A component of a scroll bar that allows the information to be scrolled by defined increments when the user clicks it. The direction of the arrow indicates the direction in which the information scrolls.

The term can refer to almost any kind of computer, from a centralized mainframe that is a host to its terminals, to a server that is host to its clients, to a desktop PC that is host to its devices, such as printers and scanners.

authority key identifier.translation: Mã định danh Khóa Thẩm quyền

Definition: A certificate extension used by the certificate chaining engine to determine what certificate was used to sign a presented certificate. The AKI can contain the issuer name, serial number, public key information, or no information at all. By matching the information in a certificate’s AKI extension to a CA certificate’s Subject Key Identifier (SKI) extension, a certificate chain can be built.

standby server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server instance containing a copy of a database that can be brought online if the source copy of the database becomes unavailable. Log shipping can be used to maintain a "warm" standby server, called a secondary server, whose copy of the database is automatically updated from log backups at regular intervals. Before failover to a warm standby server, its copy of the database must be brought fully up to date manually. Database mirroring can be used to maintain a "hot" standby server, called a mirror server, whose copy of the database is continuously brought up to date. Failover to the database on a mirror server is essentially instantaneous.

windows desktop application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application that is built using the traditional Win32 app model, typically makes use of the COM or .NET runtime, and runs only on the desktop of Windows.

classic windows application.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An application that is built using the traditional Win32 app model, typically makes use of the COM or .NET runtime, and runs only on the desktop of Windows.

handwriting panel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The input panel where users can input text through handwriting. The system converts the handwriting to text that users can insert into the active text area.

windows mail.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft app for sending and receiving email.

main app.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The wider of the two apps that can appear on the screen simultaneously after a second app is snapped to the screen.

windows messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates SMS and instant messaging.

messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The use of computers and data communication equipment to convey messages from one person to another, as by email, voice mail, or fax.

microsoft messaging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates SMS and instant messaging.

windows reader.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates the reading of PDF and XPS files.

reader.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A person who is allowed to view and read content.

windows people.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates contact list and social update management.

microsoft people.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates contact list and social update management.

windows photos.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that enables the users to view, organize, edit and share all of their photos from multiple sources.

microsoft photos.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that enables the users to view, organize, edit and share all of their photos from multiple sources.

photos preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that enables the users to view, organize, edit and share all of their photos from multiple sources.

pinch.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To move two (or more) fingers toward each other.

refresh windows.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To reset the Windows operating system using a method that restores PC settings to defaults but retains a user's files and personalization touches.

reset windows.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To reset the Windows operating system so that all user customizations are removed.

slide gesture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture represented by placing a finger on the screen, moving the finger in one or more directions, and then taking the finger off the screen.

resize handle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A handle that enables resizing of a row, column, window or other object.

snapped app.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The narrower of the two apps that can appear on the screen simultaneously after a second app is snapped to the screen.

swipe.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture represented by a quick slide of a finger over a short distance.

swipe gesture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture represented by a quick slide of a finger over a short distance.

tap gesture.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture represented by placing a finger or stylus on the screen and then lifting it up, normally within about 0.1 second.

text suggestion.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A word that's suggested as users type, which they can select to quickly insert.

thumb keyboard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A split on-screen keyboard that is optimized for thumb typing.

keyboard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An input device that consists of individual keys and that is used to convey information from the user to a computer or data communication circuit.

video.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Sway button that allows users to insert a video card.

xbox video.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The brand name of the video offering from Xbox Live.

windows to go.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Windows that provides a predefined image of a PC from a USB flash drive instead of installing the image on the PC.

music.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-fidelity music mode in Teams that offers a richer sound experience when the user transmits music to listeners.

windows camera.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The app that facilitates the capture of photos and videos by using the PC.

master data services configuration manag.translation: Trình quản lý Cấu hình Dịch vụ Dữ liệu Chính
master data services configuration manag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SQL Server configuration manager used to create and configure Master Data Services databases, Web sites, and Web applications.

contact linking.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of linking contacts that represent the same person. This enables you to view information from multiple contacts in a single contact card.

format object task pane.translation: Ngăn tác vụ Định dạng Đối tượng
format object task pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A task pane that provides functionality for formatting objects.

topic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A phrase or term that is organizationally significant or important, one that has specific meaning to the organization and has resources related to it that can help people understand what it is and find more information about it.

sql server agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Microsoft Windows service that executes scheduled administrative tasks, which are called jobs, and stores the information in SQL Server.

sql server configuration manager.translation: Trình quản lý Cấu hình SQL Server
sql server configuration manager.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool to manage the services associated with SQL Server, to configure the network protocols used by SQL Server, and to manage the network connectivity configuration from SQL Server client computers.

sql writer service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A service that permits Windows backup programs to copy SQL Server data files through the Volume Shadow Copy Service framework, while SQL Server is running.

line width.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The length of a line of type measured from the left margin to the right margin on a piece of paper or on a computer screen. microsoft sql server playback capture wi.translation: Microsoft SQL Server Playback Capture Wizard
microsoft sql server playback capture wi.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A wizard that supports the capture of information about an event for later analysis.

narrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that audibly reads the text on the screen aloud and describes some events to users.

assembly cache.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A machine-wide code cache used for side-by-side storage of assemblies. There are two parts to the cache: the global assembly cache contains assemblies that are explicitly installed to be shared among many applications on the computer; the download cache stores code downloaded from Internet or intranet sites, isolated to the application that triggered the download so that code downloaded on behalf of one application/page does not impact other applications.

quick explore.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables single-click access to trend and contribution patterns within a PivotTable or PivotChart report.

team work center.translation: Trung tâm Công việc theo Nhóm
team work center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: ​A Web Part that combines a search list of projects in a site collection along with a timeline that shows how those projects relate to one another.

theme family.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of variants on a single theme.

sql server store for office applications.translation: SQL Server Store cho các Ứng dụng Office

theme variant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the variations of a theme that make up a theme family.

message journaling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ability to record all communications, including email communications, in an organization for use in the organization's email retention or archival strategy.

journaling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An ability to record all communications, including email communications, in an organization for use in the organization's email retention or archival strategy.

sql server data mining content viewer.translation: Trình xem Nội dung Khai thác Dữ liệu SQL Server
sql server data mining content viewer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The viewer that displays the content that is contained in the content schema rowset of the mining model.

sql server data mining content viewer co.translation: Điều khiển Trình xem Nội dung Khai thác Dữ liệu SQL Server

windows push notification service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature of Windows for sending tile updates and notifications to users.

wns.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature of Windows for sending tile updates and notifications to users.

shape-level validation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The act of checking a visual workflow to ensure that the shapes and connections are valid.

synchronous conversion.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mode of Word Automation Services in which requests are processed synchronously, rather than in batches.

backward compatibility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The capability of source code or programs developed on a more advanced system or compiler version to be executed or compiled by a less advanced (older) version.

touch selection handle.translation: núm điều khiển chọn cảm ứng
touch selection handle.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A handle that enables touch selection scenarios that are not possible or are difficult to accomplish with standard touch gestures alone.

visual designer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Visio-based design surface that enables users to create and edit workflows visually by manipulating shapes that represent actions and conditions.

app name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The name of a product in the store that appears to customers. To the end user, this is the name of the product.

app package.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains the app manifest, executable files, text and image resource files, and other files that make up the app for a single platform.

app summary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Collected data about an app, such as analytics of download, usage, in-application transaction, customer ratings provided by the Windows Store developer portal. This type of information helps developers clearly understand how their applications are doing in the Windows market.

app update.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Windows Store service that enables end users to update apps one at a time or all at the same time for all apps purchased through the Windows Store.

certification status.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The stage of an app in the certification process.

deep link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A link that takes you to a precise location, such as a slide within a presentation, a section of a document, or a specific page within a site, instead of to the main page of the web site.

powerpoint xml format.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The formal name for PowerPoint 12 file format. This format has an open, royalty-free specification, and is the technology licensed to external parties. This license is the subject in the messaging points where “Open, royalty-free license” is discussed.

business intelligence center.translation: Trung tâm Nghiệp vụ Thông minh
business intelligence center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A SharePoint site template that provides an entry point for users to access the business intelligence ecosystem.

web.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The prefix displayed on a badge indicating the search result originates from the Web.

in-app offer.translation: tính năng mua trong ứng dụng
in-app offer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that a developer provides in an app for consumers to buy from within the app through an in-app purchase transaction.

in-app purchase.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A transaction performed by a consumer from within the context of an app to buy additional features for that app.

shortcut group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of shortcuts to folders that can be displayed in the Shortcuts pane.

microsoft license terms for consumers.translation: Điều khoản Cấp phép Microsoft cho Người tiêu dùng
microsoft license terms for consumers.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Applications in Windows Store are distributed with user-based licensing model. Windows runtime and application model will only allow applications that are for user-based license as well as signed by Windows Store to be installed/run on Windows 8.

microsoft account logins.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows 8 all windows portal experiences support and persist Live ID logins streamlining the partner experience when working with multiple services and sites.

raw notification.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of notification sent via the Microsoft Push Notification Service to an app running on Windows Phone. The format and meaning of the data is determined by the app.

purchase at download.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To purchase an app just before downloading and installing it.

extensible stylesheet language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML vocabulary that is used to transform XML data to another form, such as HTML, by means of a style sheet that defines presentation rules.

xsl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML vocabulary that is used to transform XML data to another form, such as HTML, by means of a style sheet that defines presentation rules.

touchscreen.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A touch-sensitive screen on your device that can recognize the location of a touch (of a fingertip or stylus, for example) on its surface and translate that touch into a desired action (such as opening an item or moving the cursor).

purchase after trial.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To purchase an app after downloading, installing and trying it out.

promotional image.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image uploaded by the developer that Microsoft can use as a part of promotion via Featured lists and/or marketing campaigns.

payout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The money a developer receives from app and add-on sales in the Windows Store, including advertising revenue.

onboard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To add a device to a service.

windows 8 consumer preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The beta release of the Windows 8 operating system.

convex hull.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest convex set that contains X in the Euclidean plane or Euclidean space.

flyout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A control to expose lightweight, contextual UI.

global default.translation: giá trị mặc định toàn cục
global default.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A default that is defined for a specific database and is shared by columns of different tables.

assignment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A process-related task that is delegated to a particular user.

lab.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unit of work that a student is expected to complete.

algorithm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule or procedure for solving a problem.

educator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A person who is responsible for teaching a class.

class schedule.translation: Dạng xem theo Lịch biểu Lớp

post grades.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To publish grades and feedback so that they are available to students.

student.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A person who is enrolled in a class.

syllabus.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A summary of class information, such as the course name and description, a schedule of lessons and assignments, and evaluation criteria.

text-based designer.translation: Trình thiết kế Dựa trên Văn bản

check out.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To retrieve a writable copy of a file or project from a source repository. This locks the file for editing to prevent others from overwriting or editing it inadvertently.

fallback action.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The action that an Exchange Server 2007 transport rule takes if a disclaimer cannot be applied to an email message as, for example, when a message is encrypted.

federation member.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that contains parts of the federation's data and is there to provide the computational and storage capacity for parts of the federation's workload and data.

snap.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To open an app in a snapped state or to shift an app to the side of the screen.

action items.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that identifies a possible question or requested action in an email message and enables the user to take action on it from within the message.

attachment reminder.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that alerts the user before an email message is sent if it detects that an attachment may have been omitted from the message.

change hint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A vertical bar in the margin of a document that shows where changes have been tracked and displays those changes when clicked.

chart element.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the distinct pieces that make up a chart, such as a title, axis, legend, trendline, or error bar.

comment hint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A visual indicator that denotes the presence of a comment and opens the comment when clicked.

comments pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane beside the document that displays all comments made in the document.

continuous crawl.translation: tìm kéo nội dung liên tục

data grid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instance of Excel that has minimal UI and that enables a user to insert or edit chart data within the context of a non-Excel Office document.

evaluation criteria.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The categories of assignments for a given class, along with a percentage value that indicates how much each category weighs into the overall grade. Other factors, such as class participation, may also be considered.

faceted navigation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of refining a search for information by filtering on individual properties or facets of the items being searched.

javascript api for office.rule: Microsoft Terminology. lesson.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unit of learning that addresses a portion of the content for a class and may include assignments, materials, and other lessons.

live layout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A layout that is updated in real time as an object on the page is moved, resized, or rotated, enabling the user to preview the end result before the action is completed.

sdk.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of routines (usually in one or more libraries) designed to allow developers to more easily write programs for a given computer, operating system, or user interface.

software development kit.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of routines (usually in one or more libraries) designed to allow developers to more easily write programs for a given computer, operating system, or user interface.

materials.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Content and resources that are made available as part of a class and that can be associated with individual lessons or assignments.

class materials.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Content and resources that are made available as part of a class and that can be associated with individual lessons or assignments.

navigation bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A surface that appears on the phone screen with a “soft” key for the Back, Start and Search button.

online video.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that lets you insert a video from a web-based source into your document and play it back without leaving the document.

thesaurus pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane that provides synonym lookup and display functionality.

trend chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart that shows the change in data over time.

accents.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The title of a screen displaying the list of accent colors.

my notes.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A OneNote notebook that is automatically created for every student and every educator. It contains tabs for each of their classes.

present online.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables users to present a document to remote viewers in a web browser or in Lync.

slide navigator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables the user to visually browse for and navigate to other slides without leaving Slide Show view.

open geospatial consortium.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The standards body that defines standards for describing and communicating geospatial data.

ogc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The standards body that defines standards for describing and communicating geospatial data.

ellipsoidal coordinate system.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A coordinate system in reference to a flattened sphere.

battery saver.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature to help monitor and save on battery usage.

bio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A biography of an artist whose music is in Groove.

line string.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a single path in a coordinate system. It uses linear interpolation between control points for the definition of line which is appropriate to the coordinate system.

camera roll.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An album that contains a continuous roll of live viewfinder and captured photos and videos that have not been archived or moved to other folders.

cdma network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) network, used by phones that do not have SIM cards.

cellular data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The cellular network service provided by Transatel for use with a Microsoft SIM card.

customer service center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A business department that deals with routine inquiries and complaints from customers.

customer support.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A business department that deals with routine inquiries and complaints from customers.

dark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A theme setting that consists of a black background.

light.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image filter that increases the brightness of the image.

object explorer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The section of the Visual Studio integrated development environment (IDE) that contains nodes that represent database objects.

filetable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that provides internal storage to the core SQL Server product.

office telemetry agent.translation: Tác nhân Đo từ xa cho Office
office telemetry agent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of the Office Telemetry Dashboard that supports collection and upload of inventory and usage data for Office related solutions on client computers across an organization.

rsfx driver.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file-system filter driver to aid access to the data through the NTFS Streaming APIs for the filestream data type.

windows 8 upgrade assistant.translation: Bộ trợ giúp Nâng cấp Windows 8
windows 8 upgrade assistant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A downloadable app that helps users choose which edition of Windows 8 is right for them, determine if their hardware can support it, determine the compatibility of apps and devices and assist with any changes that are needed, and then purchase and install it from within the app.

geography.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Excel feature that takes a cell with a city name, adds a link to the selected city’s demographic information, and displays that information in a card.

template.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pre-defined, reusable set of conditional statements to create a specific type of flow.

template file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A file that contains some pre-defined formatting, layout, and/or text and graphics and that serves as the basis for new content with a similar look or purpose.

planar coordinate system.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system of coordinates in reference to a planar space.

geometry.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An abstract data type that is the base type for all geospatial data types in planar coordinate systems.

geographic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to data types in an ellipsoidal coordinate system.

geospatial.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to the relative position of things in an area on Earth.

microsoft active protection service.translation: Dịch vụ Bảo vệ Chủ động của Microsoft

spatiotemporal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to something that exists both in space and time.

observational.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to data that represents a set of observations and their associated space-time regions, typically on the earth.

spatial.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to the relative position of things in an area.

vocabulary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of related terms used to express concepts in a technical application.

geospatial collection.translation: bộ sưu tập không gian địa lý

spot corruption handling.translation: Xử lý Hư hỏng Tại chỗ

spot fixer.translation: Trình xử lý lỗi Tại chỗ

snap windows.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that allows users to arrange all of their open windows on their screen using the mouse, keyboard, or the Snap Assist feature.

surface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a continuous area in a coordinate system.

multi-surface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a union of all the positions in a set of surfaces.

polygon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a single area in a coordinate system. multi-polygon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a union of all the positions in a set of polygons.

multi-point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a union of a set of positions in a coordinate system.

multi-line string.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shape representing a union of all the positions in a set of line strings.

geometric.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to data types in a planar coordinate system.

quick analysis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables single-click access to top data analysis features such as formulas, conditional formatting, sparklines, charts and PivotTable reports.

read mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mode that is optimized for reading or viewing content and does not support edit functionality.

double-click.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To press and release a mouse button twice in rapid succession without moving the mouse. Double-clicking is a means of rapidly selecting and activating a program or program feature.

network configuration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An arrangement of network devices that defines which devices are connected together.

directions.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The instructions for how to get from one location to another, either driving or walking.

metered network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mobile broadband or other network for which the provider bills according to data used, such as megabytes downloaded, messages sent, or webpages viewed.

how-to video.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instructional video showing how to perform certain functions on Windows Phone.

incoming.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The label that indicates a call made to the phone.

outgoing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The label that indicates a call made from the phone.

local scout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature accessed from Search or Maps that displays things to see and do, shopping, and restaurants in a user's current location and the surrounding area.

microsoft tag.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-capacity color barcode (HCCB) with encoded information.

my windows phone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The free online service that's accessible through www.windowsphone.com. The main feature of this service is that users can find a lost phone.

member database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu thành phần

sync loop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A series of synchronizations that is repeated until a terminating condition is reached.

synchronization loop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A series of synchronizations that is repeated until a terminating condition is reached.

on mute.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A status showing on the phone when the speaker is turned off and the person on the other line can't hear you.

sync job.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A scheduled synchronization task.

synchronization job.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A scheduled synchronization task.

force removal.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A link that allows the user to trigger removal of a database from a group of databases.

pairing request.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A requisition to connect a phone and an accessory.

pre-boot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Before Windows loads.

com.translation: Mô hình Đối tượng Thành phần

component object model.translation: Mô hình Đối tượng Thành phần

sql azure data sync preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The preview version of SQL Data Sync.

sql data sync preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The preview version of SQL Data Sync.

photos & camera.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature in Settings that provides options such as launching the camera, adding location info, and uploading pictures.

wall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An area in Microsoft Dynamics CRM where information is displayed about the user and the records that the user follows.

slide up.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The text displayed at the bottom of a locked phone screen during an incoming call.

microblogging.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A form of blogging that emphasizes brief posts.

object layout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The positioning of an object, such as a chart, shape, image or text box, on a page, along with related options such as text-wrapping styles.

resume reading.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that shows users their position in a document the last time they were reading, and lets them return there in a single action.

spotlight.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A home page pane with links to online services, program-specific features, help topics, or other information.

mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Compatibility/Statistical Excel function that returns the most common value in a data set.

burn.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A general-purpose image filter with medium brightness, contrast, and saturation.

start page.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A screen that gives users quick access to recent documents and recommended templates when an Office application starts.

definitions callout.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A callout that is invoked through contextual UI to display reference data, such as definitions and synonyms, for the word selected.

play in background.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An audio style that sets your audio to play in the background as a soundtrack to your presentation.

weather bar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Outlook calendar feature that can be enabled to display the weather forecast for a selected location.

top-level property grid.translation: lưới thuộc tính mức cao nhất
top-level property grid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A property grid that only displays the properties that appear in the sentence-level view of an action.
