csrf.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An attack where a malicious website makes an HTTP request to a target website in such a way that the website thinks that the request is part of a legitimate user’s session.

canary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A predetermined value that must be present in a client-server request for the request to be considered valid.

canary value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A predetermined value that must be present in a client-server request for the request to be considered valid.

office telemetry dashboard.translation: Bảng điều khiển Đo từ xa cho Office
office telemetry dashboard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that enables IT pros to monitor usage, error, and compatibility issue information from Office related solutions on client machines across an organization.

alwayson availability groups.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-availability and disaster-recovery solution that provides protection for a set of user databases across multiple machines and data centers using SQL Server to replicate the data.

alwayson.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-availability and disaster-recovery solution that provides protection for a set of user databases across multiple machines and data centers using SQL Server to replicate the data.

always on.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-availability and disaster-recovery solution that provides protection for a set of user databases across multiple machines and data centers using SQL Server to replicate the data.

always on availability groups.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The high-availability and disaster-recovery solution that provides protection for a set of user databases across multiple machines and data centers using SQL Server to replicate the data.

automatic failover set.translation: tập chuyển đổi dự phòng tự động
automatic failover set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Within a given availability group, a pair of availability replicas (including the current primary replica) that are configured for synchronous-commit mode with automatic failover, if any.

availability database.translation: cơ sở dữ liệu dự phòng
availability database.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A database that belongs to an availability group.

availability group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that supports a failover environment for a discrete set of user databases, known as availability databased.

availability group listener.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server to which clients can connect in order to access a database in a primary or secondary replica of an availability group.

availability replica.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An instantiation of an availability group that is hosted by a specific instance of SQL Server and that maintains a local copy of the set of availability databases that belong to the availability group.

cluster resource.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A internal entity that can be owned by a Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) node, brought online and taken offline, moved between nodes, and managed as a cluster object. A cluster resource can be owned by only a single node at any point in time.

entire failover set.translation: toàn bộ tập chuyển đổi dự phòng
entire failover set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Within a given availability group, the set of all availability replicas whose operational state is currently ONLINE, regardless of availability mode and of failover mode.

forced manual failover.translation: chuyển đổi dự phòng thủ công bắt buộc
forced manual failover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: For an availability group, a form of failover (with possible data loss) that can be initiated by a database administrator in response to the loss of the primary replica when automatic failover did not occur.

forced failover.translation: chuyển đổi dự phòng thủ công bắt buộc
forced failover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: For an availability group, a form of failover (with possible data loss) that can be initiated by a database administrator in response to the loss of the primary replica when automatic failover did not occur.

conditional visibility.translation: khả năng hiển thị có điều kiện
conditional visibility.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of conditional formatting that allows you to specify when a control is visible on the form.

forced quorum.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process to start a WSFC cluster even though only a minority of the elements that are required for quorum are in communication.

planned manual failover.translation: chuyển đổi dự phòng thủ công theo kế hoạch
planned manual failover.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: For an availability group, a failover without data loss that is initiated by a database administrator, typically, for administrative purposes.

primary replica.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An availability replica that makes the primary databases of an availability group available for read-write connections from clients and sends transaction log records for each primary database to every secondary replica.

quorum mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The WSFC quorum configuration in a failover cluster that determines the number of node failures that the cluster can sustain.

cluster resource group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An internal collection of cluster resources managed as a single cluster object in the WSFC cluster.

secondary replica.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An availability replica that maintains a secondary copy of each availability database, and serves as a potential failover target for the availability group.

synchronous-commit failover set.translation: tập chuyển đổi dự phòng cam kết đồng bộ
synchronous-commit failover set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Within a given availability group, a set of two or three availability replicas (including the current primary replica) that are configured for synchronous-commit mode, if any.

key filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A metadata column or field in a Key Filters control.

app monitor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A dashboard where admins can track the overall health of the apps in a site collection or tenancy.

excel interactive view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An online view of data that provides an enhanced visual experience through tables, slicers, charts, and other Excel objects.

interactive view gallery.translation: bộ sưu tập dạng xem tương tác
interactive view gallery.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gallery of objects that provides different ways of visualizing data.

people peek.translation: Tóm tắt liên hệ ưa thích
people peek.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A contextual summary of the user's favorite contacts and People search functionality, which is displayed in a callout without switching to the People view.

query rule.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A rule that an administrator can configure and apply to query processing to help optimize results and create an enhanced user experience.

immersive.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to the chrome-free UI presentation mode that fills all or a portion of the display.

internet-facing url.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A URL that is directly accessible over the Internet and that does not require special credentials or network access to connect to it.

public-facing url.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A URL that is directly accessible over the Internet and that does not require special credentials or network access to connect to it.

analytics service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The service that performs analytics processing for search in SharePoint.

mahjong tile one of characters.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Unicode character U+1F007, which represents a Mahjong tile.

digram for heavenly earth.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Unicode character U+1D301, which represents a Tai Xuan Jing symbol.

tetragram for defectiveness or distortio.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Unicode character U+1D30F, which represents a Tai Xuan Jing symbol.

parenthesized latin capital letter a.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Unicode character with hex value U+1F110

windows communications apps.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The download package that includes People, Messaging, Mail, and Calendar.

flattened rowset.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A multidimensional data set presented as a two-dimensional rowset in which unique combinations of elements of multiple dimensions are combined on an axis.

crypto escrow key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A secondary encryption key that provides the ability for an authorized IT Helpdesk administrator to open an encrypted document when the password is lost.

dynamic canary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A canary whose value changes depending on the request context.

app switch.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Internet Explorer 10 that allows users to easily switch between websites and their corresponding apps.

document parsing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of detecting the file type of an item during content processing, and converting the item to text.

entity extraction.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of extracting information from unstructured text in an item and storing that information as additional managed properties for the item.

property extraction.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of extracting information from unstructured text in an item and storing that information as additional managed properties for the item.

flow.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any of the different members of the Flow dimension.

index replica.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A copy of a search index within an index partition.

ranking model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML document that describes how to rank items in search results.

update group.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of managed properties that are updated together in the search index.

queryable managed property.translation: thuộc tính được quản lý có thể truy vấn
queryable managed property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed property that can be queried against. The query must contain the managed property field name, either in the query itself or programmatically.

refinable managed property.translation: thuộc tính được quản lý có thể lọc
refinable managed property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed property that can be used as the basis for a refiner for search results.

retrievable managed property.translation: thuộc tính được quản lý có thể truy xuất
retrievable managed property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed property that can be displayed in search results.

searchable managed property.translation: thuộc tính được quản lý có thể tìm kiếm
searchable managed property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed property whose value can be returned by a query.

sortable managed property.translation: thuộc tính được quản lý có thể sắp xếp
sortable managed property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A managed property whose result set can be sorted based on the property before the result set is returned.

right outer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An outer join in which all the records from the right side of the RIGHT JOIN operation in the query's SQL statement are added to the query's results, even if there are no matching values in the joined field from the table on the left.

right outer join.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An outer join in which all the records from the right side of the RIGHT JOIN operation in the query's SQL statement are added to the query's results, even if there are no matching values in the joined field from the table on the left.

custom extraction dictionary.translation: từ điển trích xuất tùy chỉnh
custom extraction dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user defined dictionary that lists single words or phrases that the system matches to words in the content in either a case-sensitive way or a case-insensitive way, depending on the type of dictionary that is used.

exact word extraction dictionary.translation: từ điển trích xuất chính xác theo từ
exact word extraction dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom extraction dictionary that lists words or phrases that are matched to exact words in the content in a case-sensitive way. For example, the system matches "anchor" to "anchor," but not to "Anchor" or "Anchorage."

exact word part extraction dictionary.translation: từ điển trích xuất chính xác theo phần từ
exact word part extraction dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom extraction dictionary that lists words or phrases that are matched anywhere in the content in a case-sensitive way. For example, the system matches "anchor" and "anchorage," but not "Anchor."

word extraction dictionary.translation: từ điển trích xuất theo từ
word extraction dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom extraction dictionary that lists words or phrases that are matched to exact words in the content in a case-insensitive way. For example, the entry "anchor" will match "anchor" and "Anchor," but not "anchorage."

word part extraction dictionary.translation: từ điển trích xuất theo phần từ
word part extraction dictionary.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A custom extraction dictionary that lists words or phrases that are matched anywhere in the content in a case-insensitive way. For example, the entry "anchor" will match "anchor," "Anchor," and "anchorage."

search schema.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A data structure that describes crawled properties, managed properties, and the mapping between them.

index partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A logical portion of the search index.

windows essentials 2012.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of apps that includes Messenger, Photo Gallery, Movie Maker, OneDrive, Mail, Writer, and Family Safety. (Family Safety is only included in Windows 7 downloads; it's built in to Windows 8.)

office deployment tool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool in Office 365 that enables IT professionals to manage how Office is installed for their users. Users receive the correct language and configurations individually tailored to them automatically, without the need to install anything themselves.

visibility mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mode in which SharePoint Server is the primary source for all the project details. Project Server scheduling, time and status, and advanced functionality are disabled.

proximity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Windows feature that enables users to connect computers with a simple tap gesture or by browsing for computers within wireless range. If two computers come within 3-4 centimeters of each other, or are tapped together, the operating system of each computer becomes aware of the other computer. Also, a user can browse for computers within wireless range that are advertising for a peer connection. The user can then connect the two computers to share content such as photos or links, or create a multi-player experience. If the connection is made using a tap gesture, the user can also publish and subscribe to messages transmitted during the tap.

application page request.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The option that specifies events triggered by the service application when locating a server for loading a PowerPivot data source and communicating with other servers in the farm.

intermediate ca.translation: thẩm quyền xác thực trung gian
intermediate ca.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A certification authority that has the ability to issue the intermediate certificates needed to certify the subject identified by the end certificate.

intermediate certification authority.translation: thẩm quyền xác thực trung gian
intermediate certification authority.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A certification authority that has the ability to issue the intermediate certificates needed to certify the subject identified by the end certificate.

credential locker.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Windows where a user's credentials are securely stored.

folder pane.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pane in the Outlook window that contains folders for each view, such as Mail or Calendar.

jump list.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of Windows that provide right-click access from taskbar program buttons to the documents, pictures, songs, or websites a user frequently accesses.

internet explorer 10 consumer preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A nonfinal release of Internet Explorer 10.

video mail.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A short video sent as an email message to someone in the contact list.

video message.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A message with a video attached.

stabilization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A technique that increases sharpness and fidelity by compensating for some effects that camera movement has on images in videos.

image stabilization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A technique that increases sharpness and fidelity by compensating for some effects that camera movement has on images in videos.

usage event.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user action that is counted and analyzed by the recommendations algorithm in the Analytics Service.

key filters.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A metadata navigation control that enables users to limit the items displayed in a list or library to those that match selected values.

dependency.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directed relationship between two objects, such as components, objects, or features. For example, if feature A depends on feature B, B is a dependency of A.

in-place hold.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that allows for preservation of content documents, pages, and messages in Exchange and SharePoint so that when they are modified or deleted, the original version can still be accessed for electronic discovery and other legal purposes.

lock screen.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A visual interface where users enter a passcode, use a certain button combination or perform a certain gesture in order to activate the full functionality of a device.

mail migration add-on.translation: ứng dụng bổ sung Mail Migration
mail migration add-on.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that allows users to upload email messages, email folders, and contacts from an email account on their PC to the cloud to facilitate access from multiple devices.

wobble correction.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image stabilization technique used to remove wobbled distortions from a video captured with a rolling shutter camera that's exposed to large accelerations or jitter.

anti-shake.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image stabilization technique that's used to reduce the appearance of camera shake in a video image.

anti-shake feature.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image stabilization technique that's used to reduce the appearance of camera shake in a video image.

microsoft jdbc driver v4.0 for sql serve.translation: Microsoft JDBC Driver v4.0 cho SQL Server
microsoft jdbc driver v4.0 for sql serve.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) 4.0 compliant driver that provides robust data access to Microsoft SQL Server databases.

discovery and risk assessment.translation: Phát hiện và Đánh giá Rủi ro
discovery and risk assessment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office product that identifies business-critical Excel spreadsheets and Access databases by discovering files across network shares and SharePoint libraries, and that provides flexible risk assessment and categorization based on relevance, materiality and business impact.

spreadsheet inquire.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office product that provides interactive diagnostics to identify errors, deviations from spreadsheet best practices and insights into data flow in and out of the spreadsheet.

spreadsheet compare.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office product that detects and categorizes changes between two spreadsheets to facilitate review and approval processes.

database compare.translation: So sánh Cơ sở dữ liệu
database compare.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office product that detects and categorizes changes between two databases to facilitate review and approval processes.

audit and control management server.translation: Máy chủ Quản lý Kiểm soát và Kiểm nghiệm
audit and control management server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft Office product that provides non-intrusive auditing of changes made to Excel spreadsheets and Access databases, and supports alerts, notifications and automatic workflows based on user activities such as macro or formula changes.

lync meeting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Denotes the experience with Lync that can be scheduled, or ad-hoc. A Lync Meeting provides the ability to interact with people through video, audio, instant messaging, and content sharing.

video quality notifications.translation: thông báo về chất lượng video
video quality notifications.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Alerts to Lync users about the quality of the network, computer, camera, and lighting conditions.

onenote share.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The feature that lets users create and share OneNote meeting notes in a Lync Meeting. Notes appear as docked in a Lync Meeting, with participant lists that can be updated in meeting notes for participants to see.

shared data source item.translation: mục nguồn dữ liệu chia sẻ
shared data source item.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Data source connection information that is encapsulated in an item. Can be managed as an item in the report server folder namespace.

personal preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A video preview for a Lync user that provides options to answer with video from within the notification.

internet explorer for the desktop.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The web browser component of Windows that provides a traditional and familiar browsing experience.

internet explorer 10.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The touch-optimized, immersive web browser for Windows.

enhanced presenter controls.translation: điều khiển trình bày nâng cao
enhanced presenter controls.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of Lync Meeting host and presenter controls that optimizes for the type of meeting, size of audience, content, and/or video sources available to participants.

lync meeting window.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Denotes the Conversation window that handles escalations (peer-to-peer to conference) and scalable views that display people and content together inside a Lync Meeting.

persistent chat.translation: trò chuyện có nhiều người tham gia liên tục
persistent chat.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of chat in which messages are posted to a chat room where they can be viewed and responded to in real time by multiple participants. Users can search for other rooms by name, member/owner, keywords, and content across groups from Lync.

quick lync.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A menu bar that appears beside the picture area of a contact in the Lync Contacts list that shows the available communication modes: IM, Call, Video, and View card.

event property.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A named attribute of a control, form, report, data access page, or section you use to respond to an associated event.

active monitoring.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Gives Lync system administrators the ability to monitor pools, servers, and networks across data centers through the public Internet.

lync 2013 vdi plug-in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Provides the ability to have softphone-based audio, video, and meetings (peer-to-peer and multiparty) without the problems of latency, jitter, and packet loss.

lync online administrator controls.translation: Điều khiển Người quản trị Trực tuyến Lync
lync online administrator controls.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Provide Lync Online administrators with the ability to run Lync Online PowerShell cmdlets and assign role-based access control (RBAC) roles to other administrators in the organization.

scalable video coding.translation: Mã hóa Video Có thể mở rộng
scalable video coding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A video compression standard that encodes high-quality video bitstreams. Support for the capability enables the conferencing server to determine how bitstreams should flow among receiving clients, based on the capabilities and bandwidth of the receiving endpoint.

cut and paste.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A procedure in which the computer acts as an electronic combination of scissors and glue for reorganizing a document or for compiling a document from different sources. In cut and paste, the portion of a document to be moved is selected, removed to storage in memory or on disk, and then reinserted into the same or a different document.

client version filter.translation: bộ lọc phiên bản máy khách
client version filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Restricts the client versions that are used in a Lync Server environment.

front end pool.translation: Tập hợp Máy chủ Ngoại vi
front end pool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of Front End Servers, configured identically, that work together to provide services for a common group of users.

call park orbit.translation: Số gán cho Cuộc gọi Tạm dừng
call park orbit.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number assigned to a parked call by the Call Park application.

onedrive for business.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document service that enables organizations to provision and manage online storage for their users.

microsoft onedrive for business.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document service that enables organizations to provision and manage online storage for their users.

onedrive business.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A document service that enables organizations to provision and manage online storage for their users.

working set.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A container that holds a list of documents within a case where they can be indexed and analyzed by Advanced eDiscovery to identify the most important documents for litigation, investigation, public data request, or government inquiry.

standard toolbar.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A toolbar that contains buttons that allow users to perform some of the most common tasks in a Microsoft Office program, such as opening, saving, and printing files.

measured boot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that validates, signs, and stores boot information in the Trusted Platform Module chip to verify the integrity of the PC.

dial-out conferencing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature whereby the A/V Conferencing Server calls the user, and the user answers the phone to join the conference.

publishing table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The table at the Publisher in which data has been marked for replication and is part of a publication.

data conferencing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of real-time communication wherein participants share and collaborate on several data and document types. The session can be hosted on an in-house server, an Internet-based service, or both.

quick notes.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A section in the default OneNote notebook where certain notes are stored by default.

unfiled notes.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A section in the default OneNote notebook where certain notes are stored by default.

my office.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tab available to users who are signed in on Office.com where they can launch Office on Demand and access their most recently used online documents and folders.

deselect.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To reverse the action of selecting a range of text, cells or objects.

places.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The workplace platform that provides solutions that coordinate where work happens, modernize the office with intelligent technology, and optimize the workplace.

my watchlist.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature of the Bing Finance app that lets users choose stocks to watch and personalize the app with these choices.

local printer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A printer that is directly connected to one of the ports on a computer.

azure active directory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The identity service in Microsoft Azure that provides identity management and access control capabilities through a REST-based API.

microsoft azure ad.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The identity service in Microsoft Azure that provides identity management and access control capabilities through a REST-based API.

azure ad.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The identity service in Microsoft Azure that provides identity management and access control capabilities through a REST-based API.

microsoft azure ad graph.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capability of Microsoft Azure Active Directory that accesses user, group, and role objects within a social enterprise graph to easily surface user information and relationships.

microsoft azure active directory graph.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capability of Microsoft Azure Active Directory that accesses user, group, and role objects within a social enterprise graph to easily surface user information and relationships.

microsoft azure ad rights management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capability of Microsoft Azure Active Directory that extends an existing on-premises AD to Microsoft Azure.

microsoft azure rights management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capability of Microsoft Azure Active Directory that extends an existing on-premises AD to Microsoft Azure.

azure rights management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capability of Microsoft Azure Active Directory that extends an existing on-premises AD to Microsoft Azure.

tap and do.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A gesture that enables proximity-based authentication between two devices.

microsoft ole db provider for db2.translation: Microsoft OLE DB Provider cho DB2
microsoft ole db provider for db2.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An OLE DB provider that allows the user to create distributed applications targeting IBM DB2 databases.

form view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A window that displays a form to either show or accept data. Form view is the primary means of adding and modifying data in tables. You cannot change the design of a form in this view.

sharepoint add-in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A web-based solution that integrates rich, scenario-focused content and services into a SharePoint environment.

flip ahead.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature in Internet Explorer that enables users to go to the next page on a site quickly by swiping across the page or clicking the Forward button.

power.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Strength exerted; might.

system file.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A resource file on the Macintosh that contains the resources needed by the operating system, such as fonts, icons, and default dialog boxes.

netiquette.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Principles of courtesy observed in sending electronic messages, such as email and Usenet postings.

network etiquette.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Principles of courtesy observed in sending electronic messages, such as email and Usenet postings.

form mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The option that lets users choose, be default, what mode they will view records in forms in.

read-optimized.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Type of form that is not editable, so viewers can quickly see data, but not modify it.

web services description language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML format for describing Web services. WSDL allows Web service providers and users of such services to work together easily by enabling the separation of the description of the abstract functionality offered by a service from concrete details of a service description such as "how" and "where" that functionality is offered.

wsdl.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An XML format for describing Web services. WSDL allows Web service providers and users of such services to work together easily by enabling the separation of the description of the abstract functionality offered by a service from concrete details of a service description such as "how" and "where" that functionality is offered.

office telemetry processor.translation: Bộ xử lý Đo từ xa cho Office
office telemetry processor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Windows service application that reads data files uploaded by the Office Telemetry Agent and inserts the data into SQL Server.

grade values.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An assignment property that indicates whether grades for the assignment are numeric or non-numeric.

record wall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A part of the Activity Feeds solution, where the posts about records are displayed.

social channel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An account on a social networking site such as Facebook or Twitter that you connect to from Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

bulk log backup.translation: sao lưu nhật ký hàng loạt
bulk log backup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A backup that includes log and data pages changed by bulk operations. Point-in-time recovery is not allowed.

conversion.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An action by which a subscription (the source subscription) is replaced by a new subscription, both owned by the same billing account, along a preconfigured conversion path. The source subscription is canceled and the destination subscription is the new subscription.

destination subscription.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A new subscription that is created as a result of a conversion or a merge.

source subscription.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A subscription that is canceled to create a new subscription as a result of a conversion or merge.

merchant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A business or organization that has provided a coupon that can be used at their store.

merge.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To combine two or more items, such as lists, in an ordered way and without changing the basic structure of either.

windows rt.rule: Microsoft Terminology. windows 8 enterprise.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An edition of Windows 8 that is available only through volume licensing.

email header.rule: Microsoft Terminology. mail header.rule: Microsoft Terminology. microsoft data categorization and recomm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. recommendation service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature in the PowerPivot add-in for Excel that identifies the categories of data in your Excel workbook (such as cities, sports teams, or animals), sends those data categories online to Microsoft, and recommends other sets of similar data that might interest you.

external access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Authenticated access that can be granted to external partners and clients to enable sharing of selected SharePoint Online content.

guest link.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique link that provides external users anonymous access to selected documents stored in SharePoint Online, with no sign in required.

power view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A feature that enables rich visualizations for interactive data exploration, presentation and reporting in SharePoint and Excel.

windows 8 release preview.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The release candidate release of the Windows 8 operating system.

proactive scanner.translation: Máy quét Công nghệ tiên phong
proactive scanner.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An automated proactive scan that triggers when NTFS detects a corruption. aggressive address acquisition retry.translation: thử nhận lại địa chỉ linh hoạt
aggressive address acquisition retry.rule: Microsoft Terminology. central publishing service.translation: dịch vụ Phát hành Trung tâm
central publishing service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. pin sign-in.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The capability to sign in to a PC by using a four-digit code.

foreground color.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A color that that is currently selected for drawing or displaying text on the screen.

rotation lock.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software setting that disables display rotation.

office automation services.translation: Dịch vụ Tự động hóa Office

uls.translation: Dịch vụ Ghi nhật ký Hợp nhất

unified logging service.translation: Dịch vụ Ghi nhật ký Hợp nhất

open with.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A menu item that lets the user open a document using a different application than the one associated with the document type.

diagnostic data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Data that shows how products are used including where, how often, with which other software and hardware. scorecard element.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Any one of the individual components of a scorecard, such as key performance indicators (KPIs), members, properties, actuals, targets, or MDX expressions.

recipient.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The entity designated to receive something.

join launcher.translation: Công cụ khởi động Gia nhập

outbound translation rule.translation: quy tắc chuyển đổi số điện thoại bên ngoài

bypass call.translation: cuộc gọi trực tiếp không qua máy chủ trung gian

office xml handler.translation: Bộ xử lý XML của Office

long message.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A message in a persistent chat room that exceeds the character limit. If the character limit is exceeded, the message will show as "long message."

oobe application.translation: ứng dụng có cài đặt dễ dàng

bmr.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The amount of energy that is needed to support the body's most basic functions when at rest. The Basal metabolic rate (or BMR) is the number of calories a person needs per day to stay alive.

beats per minute.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The number of heartbeats per minute.

bpm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The number of heartbeats per minute.

blood glucose meter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An electronic device used to measure a person's blood glucose level.

work or school account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user account and associated credentials that is used to access Microsoft’s and 3rd parties’ business services, such as Office 365. Work or school accounts are usually assigned to end users by their organization (work, school, non-profit) and managed by the admin. However, some business services like Yammer support work or school accounts that were created by end users, without IT involvement. We sometimes refer to these accounts as “viral” AAD accounts but we don’t use this term externally. Work or school accounts are stored in Azure Active Directory (AAD) and managed by Microsoft on behalf of the organization. One of the key difference with a Microsoft account is that users don’t own the account and will typically loose access to it if they leave the organization. Other aspects like password policies are imposed by admins.

ai flow.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of flow that is created using the AI flows feature.

ai flows.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An LLM-enabled process automation feature in Power Automate that allows users to execute to an end result by describing in natural language what they want to achieve with parameters for the flow to work within.

cloud connector.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A connector that allows desktop flows to interact with various cloud services and applications. flowbot.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software robot that automates repetitive tasks within business processes, such as data entry, order processing, or customer service responses.

hosted process capacity.translation: dung lượng xử lý được lưu trữ

initialization vector.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A non-secret, random value used to ensure that identical plaintexts encrypt to different ciphertexts, thus enhancing the security of the encryption process.

max bots.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The setting in a hosted machine group that determines the maximum number of hosted bots it can auto-allocate itself to turn on hosted machines.

process capacity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A capacity allocated to a cloud flow that enables it, along with all its associated cloud flows, to use premium connectors and execute actions up to a specified daily limit.

default zone.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The zone to which all Macintosh clients on the network are assigned by default.

accessibility aid.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A utility that makes a computer easier to use for people with disabilities.

legend keys.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Symbols in legends that show the patterns and colors assigned to the data series (or categories) in a chart. Legend keys appear to the left of legend entries. Formatting a legend key also formats the data marker that's associated with it.

joke program.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program designed to amuse or scare a user, for example by imitating the actions of a virus, without actually harming the computer.

quartz.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The container service for microservices built by Power Platform Policy team.

accessory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device, such as a disk drive, printer, modem, or joystick, that is connected to a computer and is controlled by the computer's microprocessor.

peripheral.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device, such as a disk drive, printer, modem, or joystick, that is connected to a computer and is controlled by the computer's microprocessor.

bucket tool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that allows the user to change the color of a group of pixels at once.

fill with color tool.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tool that allows the user to change the color of a group of pixels at once.

localization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of adapting a product and/or content (including text and non-text elements) to meet the language, cultural, and political expectations and/or requirements of a specific local market (locale).

vba.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The macro-language version of Visual Basic that is used to program many Windows applications and is included with several Microsoft applications.

visual basic for applications.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The macro-language version of Visual Basic that is used to program many Windows applications and is included with several Microsoft applications.

budget monitoring.rule: Microsoft Terminology. internet protocol.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A routable protocol in the TCP/IP protocol suite that is responsible for IP addressing, routing, and the fragmentation and reassembly of IP packets.

ip.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A routable protocol in the TCP/IP protocol suite that is responsible for IP addressing, routing, and the fragmentation and reassembly of IP packets.

web browser.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A software program used to display webpages and to navigate the Internet.

carbon copy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directive to an email program to send a complete copy of a given piece of mail to another individual. In a cc directive, the fact that this recipient received the mail is printed in the mail header and is thus known to all other recipients.

courtesy copy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A directive to an email program to send a complete copy of a given piece of mail to another individual. manual.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Pertaining to a process that is performed by a person, rather than automated.

offline mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A state in which users fill out forms when working offline.

cable modem.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device that enables a broadband connection to the Internet by using cable television infrastructure. Access speeds vary greatly, with a maximum throughput of 10 megabits per second (Mbps).

cell reference.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The set of coordinates that a cell occupies on a worksheet. For example, the reference of the cell that appears at the intersection of column B and row 3 is B3.

request throttling.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method of preventing a denial of service attack by limiting the number of requests that can be made to a system.

video capture device.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A device that converts analog images (for example, from a television or VCR) into digital images.

variance.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The difference between two values, such as the difference between estimated and actual expenses.

saved networks.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Control Panel item that allows the user to view saved networks and reconnect to them.

windows basics.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A tutorial outlining basic Windows features, workflow and information.

wireless lan.rule: Microsoft Terminology. structural editing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Editing that occurs within a structured document such as a well-formed XML document.

microsoft® core cal suite.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft client access license (CAL) that combines the access licenses for popular Microsoft servers. These include Windows Server, Exchange Server, Office SharePoint Server and Systems Management Server.

scheme color.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: One of the colors defined in a set of chosen colors. If you fill an object with a scheme color, the object's color changes whenever you choose another color scheme for that publication.

set up.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To prepare a computer, a device, a software program or application to operate.

legacy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Of or pertaining to documents, data, software, or hardware that existed prior to a certain time.

control point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A handle that can be dragged to change the curve or symmetry of a segment.

status alert.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A notification that is sent when one of the user's tagged contacts changes status to Available or Offline.

constraint.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A limitation or a restriction.

tab key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. autoformat.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A built-in format that can be applied to a range of data, or to controls and sections in a form or report to change their appearance.

username.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string that uniquely identifies a user in a computer system for the purpose of logging into said system and identifying oneself to other users.

user name.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A string that uniquely identifies a user in a computer system for the purpose of logging into said system and identifying oneself to other users.

worksheet.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A primary document used in Excel to store and work with data. A worksheet consists of cells that are organized into columns and rows; a worksheet is always stored in a workbook.

home use rights.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A Microsoft software licensing option for employers that enables employees to obtain and use a copy of Microsoft Office applications at home.

code access security.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mechanism provided by the common language runtime whereby managed code is granted permissions by security policy and these permissions are enforced, helping to limit the operations that the code will be allowed to perform.

thousand separator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A symbol that separates thousands from hundreds within a number that has four or more places to the left of the decimal separator.

vbscript.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A scripting language that is used to create interactive or animated content for the Internet, such as games or advanced financial applications and that is based on Microsoft Visual Basic syntax.

visual basic scripting edition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A scripting language that is used to create interactive or animated content for the Internet, such as games or advanced financial applications and that is based on Microsoft Visual Basic syntax.

silent.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A status displayed when the phone sound volume is set to 0 and vibration is off.

touch pad.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A variety of graphics tablet that uses pressure sensors, rather than the electromagnetics used in more expensive high-resolution tablets, to track the position of a device on its surface.

touchpad.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A variety of graphics tablet that uses pressure sensors, rather than the electromagnetics used in more expensive high-resolution tablets, to track the position of a device on its surface.

asynchronous transfer mode.rule: Microsoft Terminology. scorecard.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report type that depicts organizational performance by displaying a collection of key performance indicators (KPIs) together with performance targets for those KPIs. A scorecard can be organized hierarchically.

subscription scheduled rule.translation: quy tắc đăng ký theo lịch trình

point-in-time recovery.translation: phục hồi về thời điểm xác định

regression analysis.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A form of statistical analysis used for forecasting. Regression analysis estimates the relationship between variables so that a given variable can be predicted from one or more other variables.

odbc.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the Microsoft WOSA (Windows Open System Architecture) structure, an interface providing a common language for Windows applications to gain access to a database on a network.

open database connectivity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In the Microsoft WOSA (Windows Open System Architecture) structure, an interface providing a common language for Windows applications to gain access to a database on a network.

localhost.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The name used to represent the same computer on which a TCP/IP message originates. If you access a server-based web site by using http://localhost, the request does not actually go out to the Internet.

updateable snapshot.translation: ảnh chụp nhanh có thể cập nhật

updatable snapshot.translation: ảnh chụp nhanh có thể cập nhật

receive data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A line used to carry received serial data from one device to another, such as from a modem to a computer. Pin 3 is the RXD line in RS-232-C connections.

stack pointer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A register that contains the current address of the top element of the stack.

index role.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The role name of a server that services indexing in the farm topology.

active document.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The document in which you are working.

sql statement.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An SQL or Transact-SQL command, such as SELECT or DELETE, that performs some action on data.

linear fraction.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A fraction that is written on a single line: the numerator is placed on the left, followed by the fraction bar, and the denominator on the right. Example: 3/4

record source.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The underlying source of data for a form, report, or data access page.

installation point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Network share from which users install Office.

anonymous user access.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability to gain access to a Web server on which one does not have an account.

hvac plan.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A drawing that shows the layout of heating, ventilation, and cooling ductwork. A type of building plan.

polling interval.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A value that defines the frequency of the polling process.

optional hyphen.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hyphen that is used to control where a word or phrase breaks if it falls at the end of a line. For example, you can specify that the word "nonprinting" breaks as "non-printing" rather than "nonprint-ing."

busy.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The status that users can select to indicate that they are currently busy.

personal address book.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The customizable address book used to store frequently used email addresses

assigned task.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A task that has been sent to someone as a task request in an email message.

array constant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A set of constants that is a component of an array formula.

enhanced document availability.translation: Khả năng truy nhập tài liệu nâng cao

global assumption.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An assumption that can be referenced by all models within a PerformancePoint Server application.

network server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity that hosts web pages and responds to commands from a client.

symmetric key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The cryptographic key used to both encrypt and decrypt protected content during publishing and consumption.

linked dimension.rule: Microsoft Terminology. mailbox delivery queue.translation: sự xếp hàng đợi phân phối hộp thư

master page gallery.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A collection of pages with the .master extension that define shared page elements and content place holders.

linq.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A query syntax that defines a set of query operators that allow traversal, filter, and projection operations to be expressed in a direct, declarative way in any .NET-based programming language.

color model.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A way of defining color both for onscreen display and print. Colors can be described by using several different color models: HSV (hue, saturation, and value); CMY (cyan, magenta, and yellow); and RGB (red, green, and blue).

competitor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity that sells similar products or services and competes for the same customer segment.

ease of access center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An area within the Control Panel that provides accessibility options and settings to help users interact more easily with the computer.

bit-wise comparison.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A bit-by-bit comparison of identically positioned bits in two numeric expressions.

bitwise comparison.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A bit-by-bit comparison of identically positioned bits in two numeric expressions.

coordinate pair.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A pair of values representing the x- and y-coordinates of a point that are stored in a two-dimensional array that can contain coordinates for many points.

subheading.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A heading in a document, worksheet or other type of content that is subordinate to another heading.

backup.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A duplicate of a program, a disk, or data, made either for archiving purposes or for safeguarding files.

current record.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The record in a recordset that you can modify or retrieve data from. There is only one current record in a recordset, but a recordset may have no current record, for example, after a record has been deleted from a dynaset-type recordset.

knowledge management.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A system for managing shared corporate knowledge.

subnet mask.rule: Microsoft Terminology. referring domain.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: On the Internet and intranets, the address of a network location from which site visitors follow a hyperlink to your Web site.

regular expression.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A concise and flexible notation for finding and replacing patterns of text. You can use regular expressions to quickly parse large amounts of text to find specific character patterns; extract, edit, replace, or delete text substrings; or to add the extracted strings to a collection in order to generate a report.

regex.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A concise and flexible notation for finding and replacing patterns of text. report footer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report section used to place information that normally appears at the bottom of the page, such as page numbers, dates, and sums.

list index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The sequence of numbers for items in a list, starting with 0 for the first item, 1 for the second item, and so forth.

single stepping.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A debugging technique where the user steps through code one line at a time.

sub-report.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A report that is displayed in a second window when a user clicks an item in a report.

file size.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The length of a file, typically given in bytes.

line chart.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A chart that shows trends in data at equal intervals, with values from one or more sets of data connected by lines.

set function.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A function that performs a calculation on multiple values and returns a single value.

digital handwriting.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Text that is entered by drawing or writing on a screen, rather with a keyboard.

information service.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A group of settings that enable users to send, store, and receive email, and that define how to store and use addresses.

complete the merge.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The heading for the last Mail Merge step, which allows the user to select how the merged publication or letters are produced.

voice comment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A recording that is attached to your document.

system rating.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number that gives a general indication of the performance capability of your computer's hardware.

total field.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A field that summarizes data from the underlying record source. A total field might use a summary function, such as Sum or Count, or use an expression to calculate summary values.

action button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A ready-made button that the user can insert into his/her presentation and define hyperlinks for.

supplicant.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An entity at one end of a point-to-point LAN/WLAN segment that is requesting authenticated access to the network.

affiliate marketing.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An agreement between two owners to promote content in different places.

writable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Capable of recording data that has been edited or entered.

bulk-logged recovery model.translation: mô hình phục hồi ghi nhật ký hàng loạt

clustered index.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A B-tree-based index in which the logical order of the key values determines the physical order of the corresponding rows in a table.

ras.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of a system or device to be usable when it is needed. When expressed as a percentage, high availability is the actual service time divided by the required service time.

ha.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The ability of a system or device to be usable when it is needed. When expressed as a percentage, high availability is the actual service time divided by the required service time.

managed content settings.translation: thiết đặt nội dung được quản lý

encoding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of turning data into a stream of bits. Encoding is part of the serialization process that converts data into a stream of ones and zeros.

fuzzy matching.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A lookup methodology that uses an approximate matching algorithm to locate similar data values in a reference table.

compressed drive.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A hard disk whose apparent capacity has been increased through the use of a compression utility, such as Stacker or Double Space.

home address.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A postal address at which a person is normally resident.

pivotchart view.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A view that shows a graphical analysis of data in a datasheet or form. You can see different levels of detail or specify the layout by dragging fields and items or by showing and hiding items in the drop-down lists for the fields.

active content.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Interactive or animated content used on the Internet. Active content includes ActiveX controls and web browser add-ons.

prior period adjustment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An adjustment made in the current fiscal period that corrects an error in accounting for an economic event that occurred in a prior fiscal period.

flattened interface.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An interface created to combine members of multiple interfaces.

case key.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The element of a case by which the case is referenced within a case set.

web farm.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A network load balancing cluster of servers that support client Web site requests.

document map.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A vertical pane along the left edge of the document window that displays an outline of the document's headings, and enables the user to navigate to or manipulate different parts of the document.

deterministic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In computing, being able to predict an outcome or to know in advance how data will be manipulated by a processing system. A deterministic simulation, for example, is one in which a certain input always produces the same output.

date navigator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The small calendar that displays the current month in Calendar and that provides a quick and easy way to move appointments and to view other dates.

web beacon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A snippet of software placed in an advertisement or email message, or on a Web page to help measure delivery of the item to a Web browser and to track a user's actions in general.

web server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server computer that hosts Web pages and responds to requests from browsers.

http server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server computer that hosts Web pages and responds to requests from browsers.

model association.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A relationship that allows users to define links between reference data elements to enable fact data movement.

cross-model association.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A relationship that allows users to define links between reference data elements to enable fact data movement.

protection point.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A record of the computer's system settings and files at a specific moment in time.

fill factor.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An attribute of an index that defines how full the SQL Server Database Engine should make each page of the index.

web folders.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A shortcut you use to save, open, copy, or delete files on a Web or FTP server. Some Web folders, such as document libraries, have functionality not available with local folders. You'll find Web folders in My Network Places or Web Folders.

pin code.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique and secret identification code similar to a password that is assigned to an authorized user and used to gain access to personal information or assets via an electronic device.

personal identification number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A unique and secret identification code similar to a password that is assigned to an authorized user and used to gain access to personal information or assets via an electronic device.

someone@address.com.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A sample email address used in Microsoft software and Help files for demonstration purposes.

binder divider.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A page size type. A small paper piece that is inserted into a transparent plastic tab which divides binder sections or paper files.

standard account.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A type of user account that allows users to install software and change system settings that do not affect other users or the security of the computer. This account type is recommended for daily use.

picture element.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest element used to form the composition of an image on a computer monitor.

pixel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest element used to form the composition of an image on a computer monitor.

pel.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The smallest element used to form the composition of an image on a computer monitor.

banding.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The use of bands to represent ranges of performance based on thresholds.

scripting language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A simple programming language designed to perform special or limited tasks, sometimes associated with a particular application or function.

other contacts.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A default contact group name that Lync and Communicator use for all contacts who have not been placed in a user-defined contact group.

close button.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In Windows-based programs, the box that has an × at the upper-right corner of the screen that, when clicked, closes the window.

user account control.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A security feature that helps prevent unauthorized changes to a computer, by asking user for permission or administrator credentials before performing actions that could potentially affect the computer's operation or that change settings that affect multiple users.

uac.rule: Microsoft Terminology. referential integrity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Rules that you follow to preserve the defined relationships between tables when you enter or delete records.

garbage collector.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The part of the operating system that performs garbage collection.

report server administrator.translation: quản trị viên máy chủ báo cáo
report server administrator.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A user with elevated privileges who can access all settings and content of a report server. document center.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An enterprise-wide storage location for documents.

audio/video conferencing server.translation: Máy chủ Hội thảo qua Âm thanh/Video
audio/video conferencing server.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A server running Lync Server or Office Communications Server that mixes and manages audio and video inputs from multiple sources for multiparty audio and video conferences.

heading style.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Formatting applied to a heading. Microsoft Office Word has nine different built-in styles: Heading 1 through Heading 9.

gatherer log.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A log that is updated each time Microsoft Office SharePoint Portal Server updates a content index. Log entries contain data about URLs accessed while creating an index.

mailbox user.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A mail-enabled Active Directory user object that has mailbox attributes.

field value.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The contents of a database field displayed inside a database results region, as shown in a Web browser.

ethical wall.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A zone of non-communication between distinct departments of a business or organization to prevent conflicts of interest that might result in the inappropriate release of sensitive information.

prioritize.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: To give a unique cardinal position to each entry, as in stack rank.

binary number.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A number expressed in binary form, or base.

ua.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A program that helps a client connect with a server.

manual line break.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A nonprinting mark you insert to end the current line and continue the text on the next line.

child workflow.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A workflow instance that is generated by a parent workflow instance.

pixel shader.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A graphics function which calculates computer image effects pixel by pixel allowing control of the lighting, shading and color of each individual pixel.

vector artwork.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image generated from a mathematical description that determines the position, length, and direction in which lines are drawn. A vector graphic is created as a collection of lines rather than as a pattern of individual dots or pixels.

vector graphic.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An image generated from a mathematical description that determines the position, length, and direction in which lines are drawn. A vector graphic is created as a collection of lines rather than as a pattern of individual dots or pixels.

hardware configuration.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Resource settings that have been allocated for a specific device. external customer.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An outside organization or individual that submits a sales order for goods or services.

system table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table that stores the data defining the configuration of a server and all its tables.

ad-hoc network.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A temporary network used for sharing files or an Internet connection. In an ad hoc network, computers and devices are connected directly to each other instead of to a hub or router.

direct synchronization.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A method used to synchronize data between replicas that are connected directly to the local area network and are available through shared network folders.

target partition.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An Analysis Services partition into which another is merged, and which contains the data of both partitions after the merger.

word generation.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of determining other forms of the word(s) specified in a search.

paragraph mark.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The nonprinting ¶ character that Microsoft Office Word inserts when you press ENTER to end a paragraph. The paragraph mark stores the formatting you apply to the paragraph.

public variable.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A variable you declare with the Public keyword in the Declarations section of a module. A public variable can be shared by all the procedures in every module in a database.

many-to-many dimension.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A relationship between a dimension and a measure group in which a single fact may be associated with many dimension members and a single dimension member may be associated with a many facts. To define this relationship between the dimension and the fact table, the dimension is joined to an intermediate fact table and the intermediate fact table is joined, in turn, to an intermediate dimension table that is joined to the fact table.

ip address mask.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A range of IP addresses defined so that only computers with IP addresses within the range are allowed access to an Internet service. To mask a portion of the IP address, replace it with the asterisk wild card character (*).

capitalized letter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In some languages, a distinct, and usually larger, form of a letter. May be used in word-initial position in certain cases, or for emphasis.

capital letter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In some languages, a distinct, and usually larger, form of a letter. May be used in word-initial position in certain cases, or for emphasis.

uppercase letter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: In some languages, a distinct, and usually larger, form of a letter. May be used in word-initial position in certain cases, or for emphasis.

descender.translation: phần chữ thụt xuống dòng dưới
descender.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The portion of a lowercase letter that falls below the baseline of the bottom part of the lowercase Latin letters g, j, p, q, and y.

extended support.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: Customer support for business and development software that is beyond the Mainstream support period. Extended support includes all paid support options, as well as security-related hotfix support which is provided at no charge.

follow-up activity.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An activity created using the Follow Up form in the Form Assistant.

internet directory.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An online directory that contains information such as websites and email addresses.

lease.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The length of time for which a DHCP client can use a dynamically assigned IP address configuration. Before the lease time expires, the client must either renew or obtain a new lease with DHCP.

lease time.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The length of time for which a DHCP client can use a dynamically assigned IP address configuration. Before the lease time expires, the client must either renew or obtain a new lease with DHCP.

dhcp lease.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The length of time for which a DHCP client can use a dynamically assigned IP address configuration. Before the lease time expires, the client must either renew or obtain a new lease with DHCP.

subcontact.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A secondary contact for an Account (that is, not the primary contact).

sub-contact.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A secondary contact for an Account (that is, not the primary contact).

programming language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An artificial language that specifies instructions to be executed on a computer. The term covers a wide spectrum, from binary-coded machine language to high-level languages.

computer language.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An artificial language that specifies instructions to be executed on a computer. The term covers a wide spectrum, from binary-coded machine language to high-level languages.

event cascade.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A sequence of events caused by an event procedure directly or indirectly calling itself.

udp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A connectionless transport protocol in the TCP/IP protocol stack that is used in cases where some packet loss is acceptable, for example, with digital media streams.

underlying table.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A table referenced by a view, cursor, or stored procedure.

computed column.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A virtual column in a table whose value is computed at run time.

login.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of identifying oneself to a computer after connecting to it over a communications line.

logon.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The process of identifying oneself to a computer after connecting to it over a communications line.

path segment.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A portion of a line, defined by its beginning and ending points.

voice message.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: An electronic message with a primary content of digitized audio.

link control protocol.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A PPP control protocol that negotiates link and PPP parameters to dynamically configure the data-link layer of a PPP connection.

lcp.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A PPP control protocol that negotiates link and PPP parameters to dynamically configure the data-link layer of a PPP connection.

character data.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: All the textual content of an element or attribute that is not markup. XML differentiates this plain text from binary data. In the XML OM, character data is stored in text nodes, which are implemented as DOM text objects.

interface implication.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: If an interface implies another interface, then any class that implements the first interface must also implement the second interface. parameterized row filter.translation: bộ lọc hàng được tham số hóa
parameterized row filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A row filter available with merge replication that allows you to restrict the data replicated to a Subscriber based on a system function or user-defined function (for example: SUSER_SNAME()).

dynamic filter.translation: bộ lọc hàng được tham số hóa
dynamic filter.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: A row filter available with merge replication that allows you to restrict the data replicated to a Subscriber based on a system function or user-defined function (for example: SUSER_SNAME()).

ascending order.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The arrangement of a sequence of items from lowest to highest, such as from 1 to 10 or from A to Z. a to z.rule: Microsoft Terminology. Definition: The arrangement of a sequence of items from lowest to highest, such as from 1 to 10 or from A to Z.
